etymology.historical_story: Samaran grows from samar, meaning indistinct or concealed, through the suffix -an. Its meanings connect a hidden name with a physical disguise: both prevent immediate recognition. This offers a useful bridge from clothing and coverings to online pseudonyms. The connection is a transparent morphological and semantic explanation, not evidence for a particular date of origin. Sources: [DBP samar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=samar), [DBP samaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=samaran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: samar＝看不清、认不明；加 -an，变成让人认不出真相的东西：nama samaran＝遮住真名的化名。

morphology.pattern_note: 未核实为规范马来语词条，不按马来语词缀拆分。词尾 -an 在此不是马来语后缀；所列为英语英式 IPA，美式读音通常保留 /r/。

senses.en_definition: Very plain and austere, with few comforts or luxuries.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, menggambarkan kehidupan, tempat tinggal atau makanan yang sangat sederhana dan kurang memberikan keselesaan atau kemewahan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形容词的释义；未核实其规范马来语收录资格，因此不标为 official。其语气比普通的 sederhana 更强，可能暗示清苦或条件不足。依据 [Cambridge：spartan](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/spartan)。以下搭配为马来语对应表达。

senses.zh_definition: 英语中指古希腊斯巴达的、与斯巴达人有关的；此义通常首字母大写。
senses.en_definition: Of or relating to ancient Sparta or its people, normally capitalized Spartan.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, berkaitan dengan Sparta purba atau penduduknya; lazimnya dieja dengan huruf awal besar, Spartan.

etymology.historical_story: English Spartan comes through Latin Spartanus from the name Sparta, the ancient Greek city. The historical adjective developed figurative associations with discipline, endurance and austere living. Modern lowercase spartan commonly describes accommodation or routines with very few comforts. This English history does not establish that the word has become an officially accepted Malay borrowing. Sources: [historical dictionary](https://www.wehd.com/87/Spartan.html), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/spartan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: spartan 联想“斯巴达式生活”：床、桌子、基本用品，舒适享受很少。

senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada institusi atau tempat murid menerima pendidikan; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah sekolah.
senses.nuances: 此处仅处理教育机构义，不构成完整英语多义词条。school 可出现在马英夹杂对话中；正式马来语正文通常使用 sekolah，机构正式名称或英语引文除外。以下搭配提供标准马来语对应表达。

etymology.historical_story: School is an English word, whereas sekolah is the standard Malay term for the educational institution. In a multilingual Malaysian conversation, speakers may switch languages within one sentence. That conversational choice does not establish school as an official Malay headword. Its English pronunciation should therefore be distinguished from the pronunciation of sekolah.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: school /skuːl/ → 学校 → 马来语 sekolah；记住意义对应，不把两种拼写混为一词。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】一些、若干或某些，表示未明确说明的数量或整体中的一部分；马来语须按语境译为 sedikit、beberapa、sejumlah 或 sesetengah。
senses.en_definition: English: an unspecified quantity or number, or an unspecified portion of a whole.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada jumlah atau bilangan yang tidak dinyatakan, atau sebahagian daripada sesuatu keseluruhan; padanannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 未核实为正式马来语词条，因此不能据频率排名将 status 标为 official。本项解释英语词在马来语学习中的对应关系，不冒充 DBP 马来语释义。英语现代语法通常将名词前的 some 分析为限定词；此处 adjective 沿用传统词类标签以适配所给枚举。下列 ms 字段提供马来语对应搭配。参见 [Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/some)。

etymology.historical_story: English some continues Old English sum, a word used for an unspecified person, thing, or quantity. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay derivation. For a trilingual learner, the useful lesson is contextual translation: Malay distinguishes a little substance, several items, and part of a group through different expressions. See [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=some).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /sʌm/，只记“数量没说死”：水可用 sedikit，几个物件可用 beberapa，群体中的某些成员可用 sesetengah。

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成表示光辉、发射现象或其产物的名词；词根拼写保持不变。接元音后缀后，r 在音节划分中成为末音节的声母：si.na.ran。

senses.zh_definition: 光线；光辉；由光源发出的明亮光芒。
senses.en_definition: Light, rays or radiance emitted by a source.
senses.ms_definition: Sinar atau pancaran cahaya.
senses.nuances: 日常和文学语境常译为‘光线、光辉’，不必一律译成带危险联想的‘辐射’。释义依据 [DBP：sinaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=sinaran)。

senses.zh_definition: 以波的形式发射、传播并传递能量的辐射；可指电磁波，也可见于声学语境。
senses.en_definition: The emission and propagation of energy as waves through space or a medium.
senses.ms_definition: Pancaran dan rambatan gelombang yang membawa tenaga melalui ruang atau sesuatu medium.
senses.nuances: 物理义比‘可见光’广。须结合修饰语区分电磁辐射、声辐射等；不能把所有 sinaran 都理解成放射性辐射。

senses.zh_definition: 由运动粒子构成、传递能量的粒子辐射，例如阿尔法粒子、贝塔粒子或中子流。
senses.en_definition: Radiation consisting of moving particles, such as alpha particles, beta particles or neutrons.
senses.ms_definition: Aliran zarah seperti zarah alfa, beta, elektron atau neutron.
senses.nuances: 属于物理术语义。粒子辐射与波动辐射在科学说明中应按类别区分；表达发射物或辐射本身时用 sinaran，强调照射处理过程时常用 penyinaran。

etymology.historical_story: Sinaran combines sinar, meaning a ray or light, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary entry places familiar brightness beside the technical language of waves and particles. This makes the word a useful bridge between everyday descriptions of sunlight and scientific discussion of energy. That connection explains its semantic range without requiring an unverified borrowing story. [DBP: sinaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=sinaran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sinar 是‘一道光’，加 -an 后把光芒或放射现象整体看待：sinaran matahari 是阳光，sinaran alfa 是阿尔法辐射。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词是独立词根。派生 menyapa 时，meN- 在 s 前实现为 meny-，词根首辅音 s 脱落；派生 sapaan 时，词根末尾 a 与后缀 -an 的 a 均保留。

etymology.historical_story: Sapa is recorded as a Malay root for greeting or addressing another person. Its cultural importance is visible in tegur sapa, the familiar expression for exchanging greetings and conversation. The dictionary also preserves a literary sense of affability, illustrated through a ruler's manner towards his people. These recorded uses connect a small verbal gesture with a broader quality of social warmth. [DBP: sapa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=sapa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa-pa 记成见面时轻轻开口的两拍：先 sapa，才熟络。看到 tegur sapa，就想到‘打个招呼、寒暄两句’。

etymology.historical_story: Sunny developed in English from sun plus the adjective-forming suffix -y and is recorded from the early fourteenth century. Its literal association with abundant light also supports figurative descriptions of cheerful people. When inserted into a Malay conversation, it remains an English expression; cerah and ceria provide different Malay equivalents for those two meanings. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sunny); [Cambridge usage](https://dictionaryblog.cambridge.org/2013/09/23/happiness/?amp=1)

etymology.historical_story: Sukses illustrates how neighbouring national varieties can share a dictionary word while favouring different everyday choices. DBP marks it as Indonesian usage and records both success as a result and succeeding as an outcome. In Malaysian communication, kejayaan and berjaya usually occupy those roles. Its dictionary inclusion therefore needs to be understood together with its regional label.

etymology.historical_story: Simpanlah combines the verb simpan with the attached particle -lah, rather than introducing a separate lexical root. The particle makes a bare instruction usable as encouragement, reassurance, or insistence, depending on delivery. Meanwhile, simpan connects practical safekeeping with saving money and holding secrets or feelings, linking physical storage with things kept privately in the mind.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: simpan＝收好；加上 lah，联想中文“收好啦”。“啦”只是语气记忆桥梁，实际礼貌程度仍由上下文决定。

word_family.gloss: 长子或长女；第一个孩子

senses.zh_definition: 在兄弟姐妹或某一明确亲属类别中排行第一、年龄最大的。
senses.en_definition: Firstborn or eldest within a specified group of siblings.
senses.ms_definition: Yang pertama dilahirkan atau yang tertua dalam kalangan adik-beradik atau kumpulan saudara yang dinyatakan.
senses.nuances: 不限定性别：anak sulung 可以是长子或长女。anak perempuan sulung 可指女儿中年龄最大者，不必然表示她是全家第一个孩子。核心释义依据：[DBP PRPM：sulung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sulung)。

collocations.zh: 第一个孩子；长子或长女

senses.ms_definition: Yang terdahulu atau yang mula-mula sekali terhasil, muncul atau dilakukan.

senses.zh_definition: 家中排行第一的孩子；anak sulung 的省略说法。

etymology.historical_story: Sulung connects family order with beginnings elsewhere: an eldest child, a first crop, and a debut work all occupy the first position. Malay kinship terms preserve a related cultural connection in Long, used in familiar titles such as Kak Long and Pak Long. Usage varies between families and regions. [DBP: kinship terms](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sulung).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sulung 记成队伍最前面的“老大”：孩子是老大，作品是首作，演讲是首次。

senses.zh_definition: 为传达信息、指示行动或表明意图而发出的信号、示意或暗号。
senses.en_definition: A sign or cue used to convey information, indicate an intention, or prompt an action.
senses.ms_definition: Tanda untuk menyatakan sesuatu, isyarat atau semboyan.
senses.nuances: 可指手势、灯光、声音等示意。马来西亚日常驾驶交流中的 bagi signal 常指打转向灯。正式表达通常使用 memberi isyarat；signal 本身已见于所给《Kamus Dewan》词条。

senses.zh_definition: 通信设备发送或接收的信号；口语中也指手机等设备的信号接收状况。
senses.en_definition: A signal transmitted or received by communications equipment; informally, reception or network coverage.
senses.ms_definition: Isyarat yang dihantar atau diterima oleh alat komunikasi; dalam percakapan, keadaan penerimaan isyarat telefon dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 这是一般“信号”义在通信语境中的具体用法。口语 signal lemah 或 tak ada signal 分别表示信号弱或没有信号；正式技术文本通常使用 isyarat。手机有信号不一定表示互联网连接正常。

etymology.historical_story: Signal is an English loanword used alongside Malay isyarat. Its everyday settings make its meaning easy to follow: a driver indicates a turn, a colleague gives a cue, or a phone receives a transmission. The common thread is information conveyed through a recognizable sign, whether that sign is visible, audible, or electronic.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 直接连接英语 signal：转向灯一闪是 signal，手机信号格也是 signal。记住“传达信息的信号”。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 在这里表示数量一；词根首音 p 保留，不发生鼻音同化。patah 在本结构中是计算词语的量词。

word_family.gloss: 一个词一个词地；断续地说

senses.zh_definition: 一个词；一句极简短的话，常用于强调连一个字也没有说。
senses.en_definition: A single word or minimal utterance, especially in expressions emphasizing silence.
senses.ms_definition: Satu patah perkataan; satu kata yang diucapkan atau ditulis.
senses.nuances: 严格说是数词与量词组成的数量结构；本字段以 noun 表示其所指的言语单位。sepatah kata 通常指一个词或一句话，不宜一律理解为现代语音学意义上的一个音节。否定结构中常与 pun 连用。[DBP：sepatah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sepatah)

senses.zh_definition: 简短的开场致辞、引言或几句话；主要见于 sepatah kata、sepatah dua kata。
senses.en_definition: A few introductory words or brief remarks.
senses.ms_definition: Kata pendahuluan atau pengantar yang ringkas, terutama dalam ungkapan sepatah kata atau sepatah dua kata.
senses.nuances: 属于固定表达中的引申义。sepatah dua kata 是谦称简短发言，并不要求只说一两个词。[DBP：sepatah kata 与 sepatah dua kata](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sepatah)

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses classifiers to count different kinds of things, and patah counts words or brief units of speech. Adding se-, meaning one here, produces sepatah. The expression sepatah dua kata also serves a social purpose: it presents a speech modestly as just a few words, even when the speaker offers several sentences.

etymology.historical_story: Sparta belongs to the geographical vocabulary of ancient Greece rather than to a productive Malay word family. The name also survives for the modern city, established in 1834 near the ancient remains. Its appearance in Malay historical writing therefore preserves a foreign place name; it does not establish a separate Malay adjective meaning strict or austere. [Municipal tourism account](https://realsparta.gr/en-us/discover/highlights/sparta-the-legendary-city).

etymology.historical_story: Sejuta combines the Malay prefix se-, meaning one, with juta, a numeral of Sanskrit origin. Historical dictionaries connect juta with Sanskrit ayuta, whose numerical value was ten thousand, whereas Malay juta denotes one million. The comparison illustrates how borrowed number words can acquire different values. Modern sejuta is transparently formed in Malay, rather than borrowed as an indivisible whole. [Historical dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/A_manual_of_the_Malay_language._With_an_introductory_sketch_of_the_Sanskrit_element_in_Malay_%28IA_manualofmalaylan00maxwrich%29.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: SpongeBob is an English character name combining sponge with Bob. Creator Stephen Hillenburg had developed an earlier character called Bob the Sponge while teaching marine biology. That connection between sea life and animation helps explain the name's imagery. Malay speakers retain the character's name when discussing the cartoon rather than treating it as a Malay derivative. [Nickelodeon Animation](https://www.nickanimation.com/content/spongebob-squarepants/)

senses.nuances: 在夹杂英语的交流中可听到 peak season 等表达；正式马来语通常改用 musim 或明确的时间短语。以下提供规范马来语搭配。

etymology.historical_story: English season came through Old French seson from Latin satio, meaning sowing. The connection is agricultural: sowing belongs to an appropriate time of year. The modern word also names periods of sport and groups of television episodes. In Malay, musim supplies the corresponding noun across these familiar contexts. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/season_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ˈsiːzən/ 的 season 连到追剧画面：一季有多集；换成规范马来语，就是 musim。

etymology.historical_story: English staff has an Old English ancestor, stæf, associated with a stick or support. Modern English also uses staff for a body of workers. Malay writes the personnel term as staf, with one final f. This spelling distinction helps learners separate an English form encountered in messages from its established Malay counterpart. [English origin](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/staff?s=t), [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=staf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staff 想成一起撑起办公室的一群员工；写马来语时把双 f 收成一个：staf。这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词规则。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于相关宗教叙述、讲座和日常信仰交流。不要把它当作普通人的通用尊称、玩笑标签或商业装饰，也不要与用于其他人物或用于真主之后的敬语混用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是尊敬先知的宗教祈愿语。书写时通常置于 Nabi Muhammad 或 Rasulullah 之后；朗读时宜读出完整祈愿语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于相关宗教叙述、讲座和日常信仰交流。不要把它当作普通人的通用尊称、玩笑标签或商业装饰，也不要与用于其他人物或用于真主之后的敬语混用。

etymology.historical_story: SAW abbreviates an Arabic prayer conventionally written after the name of the Prophet Muhammad. Malay dictionaries give its expanded form as Sallallahualaihiwasallam. Its role is devotional: it expresses a wish for blessing and peace rather than adding a surname or academic title. DBP guidance specifies uppercase SAW, preserving a recognizable written convention. [DBP guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Sallallahualaihiwasallam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到名字后的 SAW，就把三个字母展开成一句祝祷：Sallallahualaihiwasallam，愿真主赐福并赐予他平安。

headword.status_note: 此字段按指定格式保留；spesis 是非规范拼写，规范词形为 spesies，不应将 official 理解为 DBP 认可该拼写。
headword.pronunciation_note: 规范拼写 spesies 的 DBP 标音为 spé.sis，因此读作两个音节；拼写中的 ie 不要求另读一个音节。输入未提供 Jawi 或音节划分。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留整词分析；规范对应词 spesies 同样不作马来语词缀拆分。末尾 s 是词形的一部分，并非马来语复数词缀；拼写改正不属于派生构词。

senses.zh_definition: 物种；具有共同特征的一类生物。spesis 为规范词 spesies 的非规范拼写。
senses.en_definition: A species: a taxonomic category of organisms below genus; a nonstandard spelling of Malay spesies.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ejaan tidak baku bagi spesies, iaitu golongan organisma yang mempunyai ciri bersama.
senses.nuances: DBP 明确规定使用 spesies；本条解释 spesis 所指的词义，不将错误拼写列为规范变体。一个物种可说 satu spesies，多个物种可说 beberapa spesies。下列搭配保留目标词形，仅供识别；正式写作均应改为 spesies。拼写依据 [DBP 拼写答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=spesis)，释义和读音依据 [DBP spesies 条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=176312&keyword=spesies)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 学校作业、科普、新闻及正式报告使用 spesies。用物种词比喻某类人时可能显得贬低或去人化，尤其不宜用于族群或社会群体。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 纠正拼写时可说 Ejaan bakunya ialah spesies，直接说明规范形式即可，避免嘲笑对方的语言能力。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 学校作业、科普、新闻及正式报告使用 spesies。用物种词比喻某类人时可能显得贬低或去人化，尤其不宜用于族群或社会群体。

etymology.historical_story: The international term species ultimately reflects Latin species, associated with appearance or kind. Malay writes the corresponding term spesies, while DBP records its pronunciation as spé.sis. That spelling–sound difference helps explain why spesis can seem plausible to learners, but it remains a spelling error rather than a separate biological category. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/species), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=176312&keyword=spesies)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 spé-sis，写 spesies：发音两拍，拼写别漏掉第二个 e。一个或多个物种都用同一个规范词形 spesies。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入；se- 不是这里的马来语前缀。首音节的 e 读 /ə/。

senses.nuances: 马来西亚日常交流通常用 kasut；sepatu 可见于文学、旧式表达及印度尼西亚语境。词义及下列引申义见 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sepatu)。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam rangkai kata bunga sepatu atau kembang sepatu, pokok bunga raya, Hibiscus rosa-sinensis.
senses.nuances: 这是带印度尼西亚地域标记的固定植物名称；不能据此把单独的 sepatu 普遍解释为“花”。马来西亚一般说 bunga raya。

etymology.historical_story: Sepatu is a Portuguese loanword associated with sapato, meaning shoe. It belongs to the vocabulary carried into the Malay world through contact with Portuguese speakers. The borrowed word became a Malay root in its own right, allowing bersepatu, meaning to wear shoes. Its history illustrates how an everyday object can preserve evidence of language contact. [DBP loanword classification](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=sepatu); [Portuguese dictionary](https://www.infopedia.pt/dicionarios/lingua-portuguesa/sapato).

senses.zh_definition: 特定的；专门针对某一对象、领域或用途的；具体而明确的。
senses.en_definition: Specific or particular; relating to a clearly identified subject, purpose, or requirement.

etymology.historical_story: Spesifik belongs to an international vocabulary of precise description. Its English counterpart, specific, traces to Late Latin specificus and Latin species. In Malay, the borrowed initial cluster sp is retained, illustrating how loanwords expanded familiar sound patterns. The Malay formation kespesifikan then expresses the quality of being specific through the productive circumfix ke-...-an.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spesifik 和英语 specific 配对：要求越 spesifik，脑中的画面越具体。

morphology.pattern_note: 加 meN- 时，词首 s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/，构成 menyalin；peN- 同样形成 penyalin。原形常见于指令、祈使句和口语。

word_family.gloss: 分娩；也可指更换衣服等

senses.zh_definition: 抄写；复制：依照原文或原有内容制作相同的文字、资料或副本。
senses.en_definition: To copy or transcribe text, information, or other content.
senses.ms_definition: Menghasilkan tulisan atau kandungan yang sama berdasarkan sumber asal.
senses.nuances: 包括手抄文字及数字内容复制。正式主动陈述通常用 menyalin；指令可直接用 salin，如 Salin ayat ini。复制通常保留原内容，区别于移动或剪切。各动词义参见[DBP 的 salin 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=salin)。

senses.zh_definition: 更换；换成别的，尤指换衣服。
senses.en_definition: To change or replace something, especially clothing.
senses.ms_definition: Menukar sesuatu dengan yang lain, khususnya pakaian.
senses.nuances: salin baju 在马来西亚日常口语中表示换衣服。正式叙述可用 menyalin pakaian。bersalin 单独出现时通常指分娩，不能把该派生义直接归给原形 salin。

senses.zh_definition: 转装；把液体等从一个容器移入另一个容器。
senses.en_definition: To transfer something, especially a liquid, into another container.
senses.ms_definition: Memindahkan isi daripada sesuatu bekas ke dalam bekas yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常见于 menyalin air 等表达，指改变容器，不是复制液体。现代日常表达也常用 tuang 或 pindahkan，具体取决于动作。

collocations.ms: salin minyak ke dalam bekas lain
collocations.zh: 把油转装进另一个容器

senses.zh_definition: 翻译；将作品或文字转换成另一种语言。
senses.en_definition: To translate a text into another language.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalihkan teks daripada sesuatu bahasa kepada bahasa yang lain.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的用法，多见于较旧的书面语及 menyalin 的使用。现代一般语境用 menterjemah 或 menterjemahkan 更清楚；须有语言转换的上下文，避免与“抄写”混淆。

collocations.ms: menyalin buku ke dalam bahasa Melayu

senses.zh_definition: 在固定表达 salin tak tumpah 中，指与某人或原物十分相像，简直一模一样。
senses.en_definition: In salin tak tumpah: exactly resembling someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan salin tak tumpah, sangat menyerupai seseorang atau sesuatu yang asal.
senses.nuances: 此处 adjective 标示整个固定表达的描述功能，不表示 salin 单独就是表示“相像”的自由形容词。词典也记录 sesalin tak tumpah 这一形式。

etymology.historical_story: Salin connects several kinds of change: replacing clothes, transferring contents, and reproducing writing. The dictionary's manuscript-copying example places menyalin in the world of hikayat transmission. Its translation sense likewise concerns carrying a text into another language. These connections offer a useful cultural account of its meanings without establishing an unsupported ancient root or borrowing history. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=salin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把内容“换到另一处”：文字到另一页是抄写，水到另一瓶是转装，身体换另一套衣服是 salin baju。

senses.zh_definition: 叹气；发出可听见的长呼吸以表达疲倦、失望、悲伤或宽慰等情绪。是英语 sigh 的第三人称单数现在时形式。

senses.en_definition: Plural of sigh: audible, prolonged breaths expressing emotion, or sounds resembling them.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak kata nama bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada beberapa helaan nafas panjang atau bunyi yang menyerupainya.
senses.nuances: 复数不自动表示悲伤，仍须由上下文判断是疲惫、失望还是宽慰；文学语言也可指轻柔的风声。马来语无需机械地用重叠形式表达每一个英语复数。名词义见 [Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/sigh)。

etymology.historical_story: English sigh continues a word recorded in Old English as sīcan, through changing Middle English forms. Modern sighs adds an ordinary grammatical ending, rather than creating a separate root. In online conversation, writers also place the verb between asterisks to represent an action that readers cannot hear, making a written message carry an imagined breath. Historical source: [Merriam-Webster](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/sigh).

etymology.historical_story: Malay turns the brief movement of an eyelid into a measure of time. The kelip family connects blinking eyes with flickering lights, while sekelip mata presents one blink as an almost vanishing interval. Its expressive force comes from everyday bodily experience: something can disappear before the eye has properly opened again.

etymology.historical_story: Sorry enters these exchanges as an English expression within a Malay sentence. A speaker may use it to acknowledge a delayed reply, interrupt gently, or repair a misunderstanding. Its cultural interest lies in multilingual conversation: the apology comes from English, while Malay pronouns, particles, and sentence patterns carry the surrounding interaction.

etymology.historical_story: Sampailah combines sampai with the emphatic particle -lah. Kamus Dewan illustrates arrival with an older narrative about reaching Riau, showing how the form fits storytelling. Its meanings also include reaching goals and limits. The particle highlights its host rather than creating a separate lexical root. [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sampai), [DBP particle guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=perlu+lah).

etymology.historical_story: Sakura is the Japanese name for cherry blossoms. In Japanese culture, these flowers are closely associated with spring and hanami, the custom of gathering to admire blossoms. Malay uses the same recognizable name for the flower. dual_scenarios.zh: 无论采用的技术多么先进，仍须培训员工，以确保运作顺畅。

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Saya nak main sehebat awak, tapi kena banyak berlatih lagi lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak bermain sehebat awak, tetapi saya masih perlu banyak berlatih.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我也想打得像你那么厉害，不过还得多练啊。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to play as well as you, but I still need a lot more practice.
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式
kena 在此表示必须或需要
lah 缓和语气
口语可省略后半句重复的主语

messages.speaker: Amir (球友)
messages.ms_spoken: Saya nak main sehebat awak. Awak selalu latihan kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak bermain sehebat awak. Di manakah awak biasanya berlatih?
messages.zh: 我也想打得像你那么厉害。你平时在哪儿练？
messages.en: I want to play as well as you. Where do you usually practise?

messages.speaker: Farah (球友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat dewan dekat rumah je. Jom ikut saya esok!
messages.ms_standard: Saya berlatih di dewan berhampiran rumah sahaja. Marilah berlatih bersama saya esok!
messages.zh: 就在我家附近的礼堂练。明天一起来吧！
messages.en: Just at the hall near my house. Come along tomorrow!

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于真诚赞美通常自然得体；说对方 tidak sehebat yang disangka 可能显得贬低。在职场宜说明评价的是哪项表现。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合比较能力、表现或力量。避免把含糊的人身比较当作客观评价；正式反馈可改为具体说明成果、技能或改进空间。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于真诚赞美通常自然得体；说对方 tidak sehebat yang disangka 可能显得贬低。在职场宜说明评价的是哪项表现。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合比较能力、表现或力量。避免把含糊的人身比较当作客观评价；正式反馈可改为具体说明成果、技能或改进空间。

etymology.historical_story: Sehebat is formed within Malay from se- and hebat. In this construction, the prefix establishes equality of degree, allowing speakers to compare ability, power, intensity, or impressiveness. Malay can then extend that comparison into a concession with mana pun: even exceptional ability does not remove a limitation. No separate historical borrowing needs to be proposed for the complete form. [Formation: DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=se)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se- 联想到 sama，把 hebat 记成“厉害”：sehebat awak 就是“跟你一样厉害”，不是“最厉害”。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着代词，在此充当比较对象，严格说并非派生后缀；按给定字段归入 suffix。直接连写，无鼻音同化或删音。音节与宽式 IPA 根据构词补全，不标固定重音。输入 Jawi سڤرتي 只对应 seperti；完整形式补上 کو。依据 [DBP：seperti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=seperti)及 [DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=ku)。

word_family.gloss: 像他、她或它一样；另有词汇化用法

senses.zh_definition: 像我一样；与我相似或处于与我相同的情况。
senses.en_definition: Like me; resembling me or sharing my circumstances.
senses.ms_definition: Sama atau serupa dengan aku; mempunyai keadaan atau sifat yang menyerupai aku.
senses.nuances: 由 seperti 的比较义与 -ku 组合而成，并非输入资料已证实的独立 DBP 释义。此处 -ku 表示“我”，不是“我的”。常见于抒情、自述及亲近语境；正式陈述通常用 seperti saya。不能把 seperti 的所有其他义项机械套入 sepertiku。释义据 [DBP：seperti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=seperti)与 [DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=ku)合成。

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam wawancara itu, beliau berkata, "Program ini membuka peluang kepada orang sepertiku untuk melanjutkan pelajaran."
dual_scenarios.zh: 在那次访谈中，他说：“这项计划为像我这样的人提供了继续求学的机会。”

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Orang sepertiku pun boleh belajar benda ni, kau mesti boleh juga lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Orang seperti aku pun boleh mempelajari perkara ini. Engkau tentu boleh mempelajarinya juga.
dual_scenarios.zh: 连我这样的人都学得会，你肯定也行啦。
dual_scenarios.en: If someone like me can learn this, you can too.
spoken_features: sepertiku 在此保留略带抒情或自嘲的个人语气；普通聊天也常说 macam aku。
ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式。
lah 在此加强鼓励语气。
kau 是熟人之间使用的第二人称形式。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Orang sepertiku pun boleh belajar benda ni, kau mesti boleh juga lah.
messages.ms_standard: Orang seperti aku pun boleh mempelajari perkara ini. Engkau tentu boleh mempelajarinya juga.

messages.ms_spoken: Okey, aku nak cuba juga. Nanti ajar aku sikit ya.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, aku mahu mencubanya juga. Tolong ajar aku sedikit nanti.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 相关，适合亲近、自述或文学语境。对上司、客户或不熟悉的人作普通正式陈述时，seperti saya 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于歌曲、诗歌、私人信息及个人经历引述。正式报道可以在原话中保留 sepertiku；公函正文通常采用 seperti saya。它不自带谦卑、悲伤或自负含义，具体态度取决于上下文。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 相关，适合亲近、自述或文学语境。对上司、客户或不熟悉的人作普通正式陈述时，seperti saya 通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于歌曲、诗歌、私人信息及个人经历引述。正式报道可以在原话中保留 sepertiku；公函正文通常采用 seperti saya。它不自带谦卑、悲伤或自负含义，具体态度取决于上下文。

etymology.historical_story: Sepertiku illustrates how Malay attaches a shortened personal pronoun to another word. Here, seperti supplies comparison and ku supplies the speaker: literally, like me. Its compact shape suits personal reflection, lyrics, and intimate writing. This explains the present formation without claiming an independently documented historical origin for the complete form. See [DBP: ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=ku).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: seperti＝像，-ku＝我；把两块拼起来：sepertiku＝像我一样。

morphology.pattern_note: 音节为 se.lé.koh：第一个 e 读 /ə/，第二个 é 读 /e/。selekoh 是完整词根，不拆作 se- + lekoh；派生 menyelekoh 时，meN- 在词首 s 前变为 meny-，s 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 道路或河流弯曲；车辆转弯

senses.zh_definition: 道路、河流等改变延伸方向的弯曲处；弯道，河湾。
senses.en_definition: A bend or curve in a road, river, or similar course.
senses.ms_definition: Lengkok, kelok, liku atau siku pada jalan, sungai dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 表示具体的弯曲路段或河段，不要求形成直角。与 simpang（岔路口）不同；表达“转弯”的动作通常用 membelok 或 menyelekoh。释义依据：[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=selekoh)。

senses.zh_definition: 城墙或防御工事向外突出的转角、角隅。
senses.en_definition: An outward-projecting corner or angle of a defensive wall.
senses.ms_definition: Sudut atau penjuru benteng yang menganjur keluar.
senses.nuances: 主要见于 selekoh kota，属于城防建筑语境；此处 kota 指城堡或防御工事。该义及其搭配在现代日常交流中较少见。依据：[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=selekoh)。

collocations.zh: 城堡防御墙向外突出的转角
collocations.en: a projecting corner of a fortification

collocations.zh: 防御墙向外突出的角隅
collocations.en: an outward-projecting corner of a defensive wall

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Papan tanda amaran akan dipasang sebelum selekoh tajam itu bagi meningkatkan keselamatan pengguna jalan raya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 有关方面将在该急弯前设置警示牌，以提高道路使用者的安全保障。
dual_scenarios.en: Warning signs will be installed before the sharp bend to improve safety for road users.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat kedai lepas selekoh tu. Kau kat mana?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai di kedai selepas selekoh itu. Awak di mana?
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经到过了那个弯的那家店了。你在哪儿？
dual_scenarios.en: I'm at the shop just past that bend. Where are you?
spoken_features: aku、kau 是熟人之间使用的非正式人称代词。
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 在这里相当于标准语的 di。
tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
nak 是 hendak 的口语缩略形式；lah 用于缓和提醒语气。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat kedai lepas selekoh tu. Kau kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai di kedai selepas selekoh itu. Awak di mana?
messages.zh: 我已经到过了那个弯的那家店了。你在哪儿？
messages.en: I'm at the shop just past that bend. Where are you?

messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak sampai dah. Tunggu kat situ dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya hampir sampai. Tunggu di situ dahulu.
messages.zh: 我快到了。你先在那儿等一下啊。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: selekoh 是中性标准词，适用于正式报告和日常指路。与长辈、客户或陌生人交谈时，可用 Encik、Puan 等称呼，并以 Sila berhati-hati di selekoh itu 礼貌提醒。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 常用于描述路况、说明位置和提醒驾驶者注意弯道，本身没有禁忌含义。指路时要区分 selekoh（弯道）与 simpang（岔路口），并说明弯道前后或左右位置；aku、kau 宜用于关系熟悉且接受这种称呼的人之间。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: selekoh 是中性标准词，适用于正式报告和日常指路。与长辈、客户或陌生人交谈时，可用 Encik、Puan 等称呼，并以 Sila berhati-hati di selekoh itu 礼貌提醒。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 常用于描述路况、说明位置和提醒驾驶者注意弯道，本身没有禁忌含义。指路时要区分 selekoh（弯道）与 simpang（岔路口），并说明弯道前后或左右位置；aku、kau 宜用于关系熟悉且接受这种称呼的人之间。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary meanings of selekoh connect winding routes with defensive architecture: a road or river has a bend, while a fortification can have an outward-projecting corner. These senses share the idea of a course changing direction. This is a connection between recorded meanings, rather than proof of which developed first; the cited DBP entry supplies no historical derivation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=selekoh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟读 sə–le–koh，同时用手指画一条弯道：走到 selekoh，路线就拐弯。把声音与弯道画面一起记住。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不按现代马来语词缀拆分。派生形式 menyobat 中，meN- 遇词根首字母 s，s 脱落并出现 ny。

senses.zh_definition: 朋友、伙伴，尤其指关系亲近的朋友；也可用作亲切称呼。
senses.en_definition: A friend or close companion; also a familiar form of address.
senses.ms_definition: Sahabat yang rapat, kawan atau teman; digunakan dalam bahasa percakapan.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为 bp，即口语。词典收录不表示适合所有正式场合。在马来西亚一般交流中，kawan、teman 或 sahabat 往往更自然；sobat 可带文学色彩或使人联想到印尼用语。以下为自然组合示例，不代表已核实的搭配频率。[DBP：sobat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sobat)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道 / 用语说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam cerpen tersebut, perkataan sobat digunakan untuk menggambarkan hubungan persahabatan yang erat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那篇短篇小说用 sobat 一词来描写亲密的朋友关系。
dual_scenarios.en: In the short story, the word sobat is used to portray a close friendship.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sahabat, adakah kamu sudah makan?

kau 是熟人之间的第二人称形式。
dah 相当于 sudah；句末 ke 构成口语是非问句。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合彼此熟悉、接受这种称呼的朋友。初次见面的长辈、客户或上司，优先使用姓名、职衔或恰当敬称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 公文正文通常改用 sahabat、rakan 或 kawan，具体依关系而定。不要把 sobat 当作全马来西亚通用的日常称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合彼此熟悉、接受这种称呼的朋友。初次见面的长辈、客户或上司，优先使用姓名、职衔或恰当敬称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 公文正文通常改用 sahabat、rakan 或 kawan，具体依关系而定。不要把 sobat 当作全马来西亚通用的日常称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Sobat belongs to a family of companionship words associated with Arabic sahabat. A historical dictionary of the Dutch East Indies traces sobat through Malay from Arabic, showing how a familiar word could travel between languages. Its present Malay meaning remains personal and affectionate, while DBP explicitly identifies its register as colloquial. [Historical dictionary: sobat](https://www.ensie.nl/uit-oost-en-west/sobat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sobat 和 sahabat 并排记：都与朋友有关；sobat 两拍 so-bat，想象向老友轻松打个招呼。这是记忆联结，不是现代构词公式。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为词汇化组合整词记忆；组合时无须删除或替换音段。这里不把 se- 单独分析为现代生产性前缀。

senses.zh_definition: 正如；按照……的方式或情况。用于引出作为参照的说明、事实或既定安排。
senses.en_definition: As; in the way or manner that; just as.
senses.ms_definition: Sebagaimana, seperti.
senses.nuances: 常见于 sepertimana yang dinyatakan 等表达，表示与前述内容一致，不表示原因。此处按连接参照分句的功能标为 conjunction。《Kamus Dewan》第四版收录连写形式，DBP 咨询记录也出现分写建议；有统一文体要求时可采用 sebagaimana 或 seperti yang。见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sepertimana)。

etymology.historical_story: Sepertimana brings together seperti, meaning like or as, and mana in a conventional expression of manner. Its dictionary meaning is close to sebagaimana. Malaysian dictionary and language-advice records document both joined and separated spellings, illustrating how established usage and editorial guidance can differ. For learners, its central function is to connect an action or statement with an agreed or described reference. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sepertimana)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seperti＝“如同”连到一个参照上：sepertimana yang dijanjikan＝“正如承诺的那样”。

etymology.historical_story: Salvatore connects an Italian personal name with the idea of rescue. Italian salvatore means a saviour and continues Late Latin salvator, related to salvare, to save. Christian usage also applies the word to Christ. In a Malay conversation, however, the capitalized form normally identifies a person rather than describing someone who performs a rescue. [Italian etymology](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/salvatore/).

senses.nuances: 这里的词性是按所给分类对功能词组合的近似归类；准确地说，sudah 是体貌助动词，pun 是小品词。马来文释义为编辑综合释义，并非 DBP 原文引述。DBP 明确要求分写；下列搭配和例句采用规范拼写。[DBP 拼写答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudahpun)

etymology.historical_story: This entry illustrates an orthographic boundary rather than a newly derived word. Malay uses sudah to express an already realized event, while pun adds emphasis in this combination. DBP's language advisory explicitly requires the spelling sudah pun. The joined form therefore should not be taught as an independently established root or an affixed word.

etymology.historical_story: The cleansing word sabun belongs to a widely travelled family of soap names. Comparable forms occur in Arabic, Persian, South Asian languages, and Portuguese. Scholars have proposed different routes into Malay, so an exact borrowing path should not be treated as settled. Its history offers a memorable example of an everyday object crossing linguistic boundaries. See [Bauer’s discussion](https://sealang.net/sala/archives/pdf4/bauer1992soap.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Sedemikian combines the Malay prefix se- with demikian, meaning 'thus' or 'like that'. Its cultural interest lies in how it links shared information: a writer can refer back to an entire situation without repeating it. DBP records both manner and degree uses, explaining its usefulness in reports, explanations, and carefully worded correspondence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedemikian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demikian 记成“这样”，前面加 se-，整词抓住“就像所说的这样”：keadaan sedemikian＝这样的情况。

etymology.historical_story: Shelley has more than one surname history. English families may take the name from places called Shelley, while an Irish lineage is associated with Ó Sealbhaigh. These distinct histories explain why one spelling cannot establish a particular person's ancestry. In Malay texts, Shelley functions as a retained personal name rather than a productive Malay root. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/shelley).

etymology.historical_story: Sebilik brings together bilik, a room, and the productive prefix se-, which can express one or sameness. That small combination connects two everyday perspectives: counting a room and sharing it. Accommodation language makes the connection especially clear, moving from a price for one room to an arrangement involving people in the same room.

etymology.historical_story: Sengsara comes from Sanskrit saṃsāra, associated with worldly existence and the cycle of rebirth. In Malay, the inherited cultural association with suffering became an everyday meaning: misery and hardship. Modern speakers can use the word without invoking a religious doctrine. This makes it a useful example of an older philosophical term acquiring a general emotional meaning. Reference: [IIUM discussion of sengsara and saṃsāra](https://centre.iium.edu.my/centris/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/10/MKH_SEJAHTERA-FALAH-TRULY-FINAL-6July2020.docx-1.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 seng-sa-ra 联想成“生活苦，三声叹”：苦难接连而来，就是 sengsara。此为记忆联想，并非词源拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是疑问助词，不是派生词缀；与 sudah 连写，词根读音不变。

senses.zh_definition: 是否已经……；……了吗？询问动作是否完成，或某种状态是否已经成立。
senses.en_definition: Used to ask whether an action has already occurred or a state has been reached.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk pertanyaan yang menanyakan sama ada sesuatu perbuatan telah berlaku atau sesuatu keadaan telah tercapai.
senses.nuances: 在马来语语法中，sudah 常归为 kata bantu aspek；此处因限定词性列表而映射为 adverb。-kah 标示疑问，不能逐字译为独立的“吗”后再重复添加疑问。正式表达常用 Sudahkah anda ...；日常口语多用 Dah ... belum?。

senses.zh_definition: 完成了吗；结束了吗？询问某件事是否已经办妥或告终。
senses.en_definition: Finished or completed, in a question asking whether something is done.
senses.ms_definition: Telah siap atau selesai, dalam bentuk pertanyaan tentang selesainya sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 强调“完成”这一状态，与 sudah 作为体貌标记的用法相关。语境明确时可单说 Sudahkah?，但正式写作通常补出所指事项。

etymology.historical_story: Sudahkah is a transparent combination of sudah and the interrogative particle -kah, rather than a separate historical root. It turns the familiar idea of completion into a question. In contemporary Malaysian interaction, its careful written shape suits questionnaires, reminders, and public messages, while conversation often expresses the same question with dah and belum.

etymology.historical_story: Sanjay is a modern form of Sanjaya, a Sanskrit name associated with complete victory or triumph. Sanjaya is also the name of a royal official in the Mahabharata. The modern name occurs across several South Asian language traditions. In a Malay sentence, however, it identifies a person; its historical meaning is not translated as an ordinary descriptive word. [Behind the Name：Sanjaya](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sanjaya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Sanjay，先在脑中放一张人的名牌；读作两拍 san-jay，记住它指人，不把词源中的胜利当作现代马来语词义。

senses.zh_definition: 车站；供火车、巴士等公共交通工具停靠及乘客上下车的场所。现行标准拼写为 stesen。
senses.en_definition: An older spelling of stesen: a station where trains, buses, or other passenger vehicles stop.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi stesen: tempat kereta api, bas atau kenderaan penumpang lain berhenti untuk mengambil dan menurunkan penumpang.

senses.zh_definition: 设有专门设备、提供特定服务或开展特定活动的站点或设施。

senses.nuances: 包括供油、发电及广播等设施；不能把所有办公地点或普通建筑都称为 stesen。以下搭配使用标准拼写。[DBP stesen 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=stesen)

senses.zh_definition: 广播电台；通过特定频率播送节目的广播服务。
senses.en_definition: An older spelling of stesen: a radio broadcasting station or service.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi stesen: saluran atau perkhidmatan penyiaran radio.
senses.nuances: 可指听众收听的广播服务，不一定指其实体建筑。现代书写采用 stesen。[DBP stesen 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=stesen)

etymology.historical_story: Stesyen records an older spelling associated with English station. DBP explains that it survives in a small amount of older terminology, while modern dictionaries use stesen. This makes the word useful when reading historical documents or inherited labels: recognition matters, but new writing should follow the current standard. [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=stesyen)

senses.zh_definition: 感恩；对所获恩惠、福祉或平安怀有的感谢，尤其指对上天的感谢。

senses.nuances: 重在感念恩惠，常有宗教或精神层面的意味。日常直接感谢别人时，terima kasih 更常用。马来语释义依据 DBP 义项整理，并非逐字引文。[DBP：syukur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=syukur)

senses.zh_definition: 谢天谢地；幸好；用于表达事情顺利或避过不幸后的感恩与庆幸。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing gratitude or relief that something has turned out well.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan yang menyatakan rasa terima kasih atau lega kerana sesuatu yang baik berlaku atau keburukan dapat dielakkan.
senses.nuances: 实际词类为感叹词 kata seru；因给定词类枚举没有 interjection，归入 particle。可独立说 Syukur!，也常接庆幸的具体事情。[DBP：syukur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=syukur)

collocations.en: thank God; praise be to Allah

senses.zh_definition: 有幸的；幸运的；因获得好结果或难得的机会而感到庆幸的。
senses.en_definition: Fortunate or blessed, especially in feeling thankful for a favourable outcome or opportunity.
senses.ms_definition: Beruntung, mujur atau bertuah kerana memperoleh sesuatu yang baik.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 所列 beruntung、mujur、bertuah 义，常见于 berasa syukur。并非任何表示幸运的地方都可用 syukur 直接替换 bertuah；作一般谓语时，bersyukur 往往更自然。[DBP：syukur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=syukur)

collocations.en: feel fortunate to be able to meet

etymology.historical_story: Syukur belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of gratitude. Arabic shukr denotes thankfulness, a concept prominent in Islamic religious language. In Malay, the borrowed base supports local formations such as bersyukur and kesyukuran. Its everyday force ranges from acknowledging divine blessings to expressing relief when someone arrives safely, linking religious vocabulary with ordinary expressions of care. [Arabic root reference](https://corpus.quran.com/qurandictionary.jsp?q=%24kr)

senses.zh_definition: 能够发出响亮长鸣或呼啸声、通常用于示警的警报器。
senses.en_definition: A device that produces a loud wailing sound, usually as a warning signal.
senses.ms_definition: Alat yang menghasilkan bunyi raungan kuat, biasanya untuk memberikan amaran.
senses.nuances: 指发声装置本身，常见于救护车、消防车和警报系统。不能仅因某装置发出提示音，就一概称为 siren；penggera 的涵盖范围更广。

senses.zh_definition: 警报器发出的响亮长鸣声或呼啸声。
senses.en_definition: The loud wailing sound produced by a siren.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi raungan kuat yang dikeluarkan oleh alat siren.
senses.nuances: 通过语境区分装置与声音：memasang siren 通常指安装装置，mendengar siren 通常指听到警报声。此处不引申为英语中神话塞壬或诱惑者的意义。

etymology.historical_story: The international word behind Malay siren connects warning technology with the Sirens of Greek mythology, whose voices drew sailors toward danger. European usage later applied the name to sound-producing devices. In Malay, the everyday meanings focus on the warning apparatus and its wailing sound, making this a useful example of technological vocabulary with a much older cultural background. [Etymonline: siren](https://www.etymonline.com/word/siren)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 si-ren 两个音节配上警报由高到低的长鸣声：一听 siren，就想到“警报器”和“警报声”。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 与 akan 相接，保留相邻元音所属的音节；不能拆成 sea + -kan。这里的 akan 不宜机械理解为将来时标记。Jawi 按元音起首词根接受 se- 的规则补写。[DBP：seakan-akan 的词根与 Jawi 规则](https://pdigital.dbp.gov.my/storage/majalah/67e10e9e23f4b_majalah.pdf)

senses.en_definition: Like; similar in appearance or character to.
senses.ms_definition: Seperti atau hampir menyerupai seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 引出比较对象，如 wajahnya seakan wajah ibunya。seakan 与 seakan-akan 意义相近；日常口语更常使用 macam。此处按引出名词性比较对象的功能标注词性。

senses.zh_definition: 仿佛；好像，从表面迹象看似乎存在某种状态或即将发生某事。
senses.en_definition: Seemingly; as if or as though.
senses.ms_definition: Seolah-olah berada dalam sesuatu keadaan atau hendak melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 表示印象或推测，不确认其后内容属实；seakan hendak menangis 是“好像要哭”，并非已经哭了。释义参照完整形式的词典解释。[DBP：seakan-akan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=seakan-akan)

etymology.historical_story: Seakan belongs with the fuller expression seakan-akan, whose formation DBP explains through the base akan and the prefix se-. Its comparative meaning must be learned as a whole rather than calculated from the familiar future marker akan. The expression supports both concrete resemblance and the imagined situations of narrative and conversation.

etymology.historical_story: Steven belongs to the same name tradition as Stephen, ultimately from Greek Stephanos, associated with a wreath or crown. Christian tradition helped spread the name across languages. In contemporary Malaysian Malay, Steven identifies a person; its ancient meaning does not describe that person's character, occupation, or social standing. Sources: [Steven](https://www.behindthename.com/name/steven), [Stephen](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stephen).

etymology.historical_story: Sebetulnya belongs to the Malay family built around betul, meaning correct or true. Its formation turns that familiar judgment into a statement about reality: actually or in fact. Rather than requiring an exotic origin story, the word shows how Malay builds useful expressions from ordinary roots. DBP records it alongside the wider betul family. [DBP: betul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=25872&keyword=betul).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 betul“正确、真实”：se-betul-nya，就是把“真实情况”说出来——其实。

etymology.historical_story: Malay selebriti corresponds to English celebrity, whose earlier history runs through French and Latin vocabulary associated with fame and public recognition. English developed a sense referring to a famous person alongside the abstract sense of fame. Malay uses selebriti principally for the person, making it especially useful in entertainment reporting. See [Collins: celebrity](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/celebrity).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: selebriti 与英语 celebrity 音形相近：想象镜头齐刷刷对准一个人，就记住“名人”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身没有词缀。构成 menyakukan 时，meN- 在 s 前实现为 meny-，词根起首 s 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 衣服、裤子等上用来装随身物品的口袋。
senses.en_definition: A pocket in clothing for carrying small objects.
senses.ms_definition: Kocek pada baju, seluar dan sebagainya; kantung.
senses.nuances: 与 kocek、poket 同义。wang saku 指零用钱；kamus saku 指便于随身携带的小型词典。DBP 另收印尼旧用同形词 saku II，其派生词表示隔离、分开，不应混入“口袋”这一词族。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: wang saku 常用于孩子、学生或个人的小额日常开支；正式讨论薪金、报销或专项津贴时，应使用对应的 gaji、bayaran balik 或 elaun。

etymology.historical_story: A small clothing pocket supplies a useful cultural image for saku. In wang saku, it holds a person's everyday spending money; in kamus saku, it becomes a measure of portability. These established expressions connect clothing, money, and reading through one familiar object. They illustrate the word's cultural reach without establishing its ultimate historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 sa-ku 两拍，配上“手伸进口袋、取出零钱”的动作：saku 是口袋，wang saku 是零用钱。

morphology.formula: ∅ + seimbang → seimbang（按数据包词基记录）
morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 和无词缀标注保留数据包的词基记录；语言学上可分析为 se- + imbang → seimbang，DBP 将它列于 imbang 词族。se- 不引发鼻音替换；se.im.bang 中 e 为 /ə/，词尾 ng 为 /ŋ/。[DBP：imbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=imbang)。

senses.zh_definition: 处于平衡状态的；重量、力量或各方面的分配均衡，没有明显偏向一方的。
senses.en_definition: Balanced or in equilibrium; equal in weight or strength, or without undue emphasis on one side.
senses.ms_definition: Setimbang, sama berat, tidak berat sebelah.
senses.nuances: 既可描述物理平衡，也可描述力量对比、观点或资源配置。各部分均衡不一定意味着数量完全相等。此义及后续义项据 DBP 对 seimbang 的释义区分。[DBP：imbang／seimbang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=imbang)。

senses.zh_definition: 与另一事物相称、相当或成合理比例的，尤指回报、报酬或处罚与其依据相称。
senses.en_definition: Proportionate, commensurate or comparable to something else.
senses.ms_definition: Setimpal, sebanding, sepadan.
senses.nuances: 常用 seimbang dengan 引出比较对象；重点是程度或价值相称，不要求两者在性质或数值上相同。

collocations.en: a reward commensurate with the contribution
a punishment proportionate to the offence

senses.zh_definition: 各组成部分或相关方面配合适当、符合需要的；也指彼此协调或相合的。
senses.en_definition: Suitably proportioned or harmoniously matched; appropriate to the needs concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuai, cocok.
senses.nuances: makanan seimbang 强调营养组合符合身体需要，不表示各种食物必须等量；广义上也可描述生活安排或发展中各方面协调。

collocations.zh: 营养均衡的食物或膳食

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合教育、饮食、工作与公共政策讨论。评价个人生活安排时宜提出具体建议，避免仅凭 seimbang 一词对他人的生活方式下结论。

etymology.historical_story: DBP places seimbang within the word family of imbang, connecting it with balance and equivalence. The prefix se- supplies a sense of sameness or correspondence. The dictionary records both physical balance and proportional suitability, allowing the same word to describe matched forces, fair recompense and balanced food. These are related meanings, not evidence for a dated sequence of development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=imbang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 联想“一样”，imbang 联想“天平”：两边配得合适，就是 seimbang。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来专名整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。正文应写作 Stuart。所列 IPA 是一种英式英语读法，并非已核实的马来语标准读音；输入包缺失的音节和爪夷文保留为 null。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang atau keluarga; dalam konteks sejarah, nama keluarga diraja Stuart.
senses.nuances: 按专有名词处理，这是依据现有资料作出的识别，并非已确认的马来语普通词释义。DBP 百科资料出现 Kerabat Stuart 及人名中的 Stuart；未据此认定小写 stuart 是获认证的普通词，因此不标为 official。搭配是专名组合，不代表普通词的高频搭配。释义为编写者概括。参见：[DBP：Kerabat Stuart](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=kerabat)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接称呼时遵循本人偏好的姓名和称谓。正式场合可使用 Encik Stuart，但须先确认 Stuart 是对方适合被称呼的姓名部分。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于介绍人物、称呼个人及讨论历史家族。不要仅凭姓名推断对方的国籍、族群、宗教或王室血统，也不要把它当作职业名称使用。

etymology.historical_story: Stuart is a spelling variant associated with Stewart, a Scottish surname derived from the office of steward. An administrative title thus became a family name and, through that family's rise, a royal designation. Malay historical writing retains Stuart as a proper name rather than translating its occupational ancestry. [Dictionaries of the Scots Language: stewart](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/stewart).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /stjuː.ət/ 与“斯图尔特”这个人名连起来记；首字母大写提示它首先是专名。

morphology.pattern_note: 添加 -an 后，词根末尾的 r 在音节划分中进入下一音节：sa.yur → sa.yu.ran；拼写 y 表示辅音 /j/。此处 -an 构成表示各种蔬菜的集合名词。

senses.zh_definition: 各种蔬菜；作为一类食材或农产品统称的蔬菜。
senses.en_definition: Vegetables of various kinds, considered collectively.
senses.ms_definition: Bermacam-macam jenis sayur.
senses.nuances: 与 sayur-mayur、sayur-sayuran 同义，核心是蔬菜种类的集合，并非专指某一种蔬菜数量很多。日常买菜也常直接说 sayur。不要把它理解为包括肉类在内的一切菜肴。参见：[DBP：sayuran 及用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sayuran)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性日常词，可用于市场购物、餐饮和农业报告。向摊主购买时加上 boleh、tolong 或 terima kasih，语气更友好。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 蔬菜名称本身不能说明整道菜是否适合素食者；点餐时若有饮食限制，应另外询问是否含肉、虾酱或其他动物性配料。

etymology.historical_story: Sayuran is formed from sayur with the suffix -an. Malay also has sayur-mayur and sayur-sayuran for vegetables of various kinds. These parallel expressions offer a useful glimpse of how the language groups familiar foods through different word-building patterns. The documented relationship is morphological; it does not require an invented story about a foreign source. [DBP: sayur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=sayur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 sa-yu-ran 时，想象菜篮依次装进三种蔬菜：sayur 是菜，sayuran 是各种蔬菜。

morphology.formula: se- + potong → sepotong（一片／一块／一段）
morphology.pattern_note: se- 在这里表示 satu；接在 potong 前不引起词根辅音变化，e 读 /ə/。原包中的 ڤوتوڠ 是词根拼写，完整派生词加写 س，成为 سڤوتوڠ；音节和 IPA 按标准形式补全。

word_family.gloss: 切下的一块；剪裁；扣减额

senses.zh_definition: 一片、一块或一段切下的东西；用于计算切片或切块物的数量结构。
senses.en_definition: One piece, slice, or cut section of something.
senses.ms_definition: Satu kerat, hiris atau ketul daripada sesuatu benda yang dipotong.
senses.nuances: 严格语法分析中是 se- 表示数量一，加上量词 potong 的结构；此处 noun 是给定词类选项中的近似归类。译作“片”“块”或“段”取决于所指物，并非所有物件都能用 potong 计数。[DBP 的 potong 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=potong)

senses.zh_definition: 一段或一小部分话语、句子或引文；用于语言材料的片段。
senses.en_definition: A short passage or fragment of an utterance or text.
senses.ms_definition: Satu bahagian pendek daripada ayat, ujaran atau teks yang dipetik atau disampaikan.
senses.nuances: 将实体的“切下一段”延伸到语言材料。DBP 在比较 sebaris ayat 与 sepotong ayat 时，将后者解释为从完整句子中取出的一部分；它不以文字是否排成一行为判断依据。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=potong)

collocations.zh: 一段句子；一句中的片段

senses.zh_definition: 一件衣物；potong 用作衣物量词时的口语用法。
senses.en_definition: One item of clothing, in colloquial classifier usage.
senses.ms_definition: Satu pakaian, seperti baju atau seluar, apabila potong digunakan sebagai penjodoh bilangan dalam bahasa percakapan.
senses.nuances: 原包所附《Kamus Dewan》将此量词用法标为 bp，即 bahasa percakapan。正式学习和一般书面表达中，衣物通常采用 sehelai 等合适量词；不能把 sepotong baju 理解成剪下来的一块布。

etymology.historical_story: Sepotong has a transparent Malay formation: se- contributes the meaning one, while potong supplies the idea of a cut piece. The same image extends from food portions to fragments of language. DBP explicitly distinguishes sepotong ayat, a portion of a sentence, from sebaris ayat, which concerns its arrangement on a line. [DBP explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=potong)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se-＝一，potong＝切：切下来的一份就是 sepotong；蛋糕是一块，肉是一块，话语则是一段。

senses.en_definition: Sharon, a personal name of Hebrew geographical origin, also used as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berasal daripada nama tempat dalam bahasa Ibrani; juga digunakan sebagai nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 在英语姓名中常见于女性，希伯来语姓名中可用于不同性别；不能仅凭名字确定性别。这里的马来语定义为编辑释义，并非输入包中的 DBP 定义。来源：[Behind the Name：Sharon](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sharon)。下列为自然的姓名短语，不是固定词汇搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 沙仑：与该姓名来源相关的以色列地中海沿岸平原地名。
senses.en_definition: Sharon, a coastal plain in Israel associated with the origin of the personal name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah dataran pesisir di Israel yang menjadi asal nama orang Sharon.
senses.nuances: 地名用法须由地理或历史上下文确认，不能自动套用于每一次人名出现。中文地名常译“沙仑”，人名常译“莎伦”，具体人物应采用其通行译名。来源：[Reform Judaism：Sharon](https://reformjudaism.org/baby-names/sharon)。以下为地理说明短语。

etymology.historical_story: Sharon began as a Hebrew geographical name associated with a fertile coastal plain. Its later use as a personal name carried that landscape into naming traditions beyond Hebrew. English commonly uses it for women, while Hebrew also uses it for men. In Malay conversation, the name identifies a person rather than translating as a landscape.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sharon 与中文人名“莎伦”连读记忆；词源联想一片平原，实际称呼时仍按本人姓名使用。

etymology.historical_story: Skru is an English borrowing from screw, adapted to Malay spelling while retaining its compact consonant cluster. It illustrates how a borrowed workshop term can become an ordinary Malay root: speakers can add native affixes to form berskru and menskru. The spelling records the pronunciation more directly than the English original. [Sources: DBP Morfologi](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf), [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=skru)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 screw 的读音对应到马来文 skru：一边念 skru，一边想象螺丝旋转着拧进去。

etymology.historical_story: The standard form selesema has been linked in scholarship to Sanskrit śleṣman, meaning mucus or phlegm. That connection offers a memorable semantic path from a bodily substance to an illness associated with nasal discharge. The shorter spelling selsema reflects a reduced form in everyday use; it is not a separate disease name. [Sanskrit loanword study](https://asianethnology.org/downloads/ae/pdf/a150.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 selsema 想成聊天时缩短的 selesema：少写一个 e，意思仍与感冒有关；正式落笔记得恢复 selesema。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 的元音读作 /ə/；词根 daya 的起首 /d/ 保留，不发生鼻音替换。整体表示尽其能力或尽力。

senses.zh_definition: 尽力；竭尽所能，调动全部能力和办法去做某事；通常用于 sedaya upaya。
senses.en_definition: To the utmost of one's ability; with every possible effort, usually in sedaya upaya.
senses.ms_definition: Sedaya: sama dengan sedaya upaya, iaitu seberapa yang dapat diusahakan dengan segenap akal atau sepenuh ikhtiar.
senses.nuances: 重点是努力的程度，不保证结果一定成功。现代常用完整表达 sedaya upaya；不要把它理解为 se- 表示数量“一”的机械组合。马来语释义依据 DBP 释义展开。

etymology.historical_story: Sedaya belongs to the Malay daya family, whose meanings include strength, ability, and resourcefulness. The prefix se- combines with daya, while the established expression sedaya upaya brings together ability and effort. DBP explains the expression through the full use of one's ingenuity and endeavour, making commitment to effort its central cultural image.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: daya 是“能力”，sedaya upaya 就是“把能力全用上”：听到 se-da-ya，想到“使大力呀”。谐音仅用于记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 表示一，与量词 biji 连写；e 读 /ə/，词根不变，j 读 /d͡ʒ/。口语中的相似义须整词记忆。

word_family.gloss: 谷粒、豆类等籽实的统称

senses.zh_definition: 一粒；一颗；一个：表示以 biji 为量词计算的单个物件，如水果、球或种子。
senses.en_definition: One item counted with the classifier biji, such as a fruit, ball, or seed.
senses.ms_definition: Satu unit benda yang dibilang dengan penjodoh bilangan biji, misalnya buah, bola atau benih.
senses.nuances: 语法上是 se-（一）与量词 biji 的组合，通常接物件名称；并非适用于所有名词的通用“一个”。biji 的适用范围由马来语习惯决定，不能直接照搬汉语量词。[DBP 量词研究](https://jurnal.dbp.my/index.php/jurnalbahasa/ms/article/view/9144)

etymology.historical_story: Sebiji combines se-, meaning one, with biji, a word for a seed and a classifier for various discrete objects. Alongside this transparent counting expression, Malaysian conversation uses sebiji for striking resemblance. The two uses create a memorable cultural pairing: sebiji epal counts an apple, while sebiji macam ayahnya compares someone closely with their father.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 se-＝一、biji＝粒：sebiji epal 是一个苹果；再记 sebiji macam… 是口语里的“简直一模一样”。

etymology.historical_story: South descends from Old English sūth and belongs to the Germanic vocabulary of direction. Its appearance in a Malaysian text does not by itself make it a Malay loanword: it may be quoted English, part of a name, or code-switching. Standard Malay expresses the direction with selatan. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/south_2), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=south)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 S = south = selatan = 南；读 /saʊθ/ 时，结尾舌尖轻触上下齿之间送气，不读成 /s/ 或 /t/。

etymology.historical_story: English sky comes from Old Norse ský, meaning cloud. Its meaning broadened from a cloud to the overhead expanse associated with clouds and weather. This creates a useful historical image: a word for something floating overhead became the name for the whole visible space above us. Malay uses langit for that space. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sky)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /skaɪ/ 与“抬头看 sky”绑定：sky 是英语“天空”，马来语说 langit；联想只用于记忆，不是词源。

senses.zh_definition: 信封；用来装信件、文件、钱款等的纸质封套。
senses.en_definition: An envelope or paper sleeve for letters, documents, money, or similar contents.
senses.ms_definition: Sarung daripada kertas untuk mengisi surat, dokumen, wang atau benda seumpamanya.
senses.nuances: sampul surat 明确指信封；语境清楚时可简称 sampul。sampul duit 指装礼金的纸封套，通常不指钱包。此义属于 sampul“外套、包封物”的常见具体用途。依据 [DBP：sampul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=sampul)。

senses.zh_definition: 封皮、封套或包裹物品的外层；可由纸、塑料、布等材料制成。
senses.en_definition: A cover, wrapper, or casing enclosing or protecting an object.
senses.ms_definition: Lapisan daripada kertas, plastik, kain atau bahan lain yang menyarungi atau membungkus sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 通常通过后接名词明确所包覆的物件，如 sampul buku、sampul bantal；说枕套也常用 sarung bantal。该词并非所有“盖子”的通用译词，容器盖通常用 penutup。依据 [DBP：sampul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=sampul)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 节庆或婚礼中的 sampul duit 可承载礼金；收取时宜致谢，是否当面拆开应观察主人及家庭习惯。sampul duit 泛指礼金封套，不能一律译为红色红包。

etymology.historical_story: A useful cultural picture of sampul is something placed around something else: a letter, a book, or a pillow. The same enclosing function appears in sampul duit, the paper envelope used for money gifts at celebrations. This connects ordinary packaging with social exchange. It explains the word's range without inventing a historical donor language. See [DBP: sampul](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=sampul).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sam.pul 记成“给物品套一层”：信套是 sampul surat，书套是 sampul buku，礼金封套是 sampul duit。

headword.orthography_note: sehat 不是现代马来西亚标准拼写；应使用 sihat。status 按指定模板保留，不表示 DBP 认可 sehat 为规范拼写。以下马来西亚搭配与例句统一使用 sihat。输入未提供 sehat 的 Jawi，故保留 null。
headword.pronunciation_note: 所列 IPA 对应输入词形 sehat；马来西亚规范词形 sihat 读作 /sihat/。音节划分为补列。

morphology.formula: ∅ + sehat → sehat；马来西亚规范对应词：sihat
morphology.pattern_note: sehat 应整词识记，不能分析为 se- + hat；输入的词根 hat 属误拆。以下词族采用马来西亚规范词基 sihat。规范拼写依据 [DBP《Pedoman Umum Ejaan Bahasa Melayu》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 身体健康、没有患病的；也指病后已经康复的。
senses.en_definition: Healthy or well; also recovered from illness.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak sakit atau berada dalam keadaan tubuh yang baik; juga sudah pulih daripada penyakit.

senses.zh_definition: 思想、判断或整体状况健全、合理或良好的。
senses.en_definition: Sound, sensible, or in good condition.
senses.ms_definition: Baik atau waras dari segi fikiran, pertimbangan atau keadaan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 属于 sihat 的引申义，可用于思想和经济等。具体译为“健全”“合理”或“状况良好”，应依被修饰的对象决定。

senses.zh_definition: 活动或行为良好、有益，不造成有害后果或恶性冲突的。
senses.en_definition: Wholesome, beneficial, or conducted without harmful consequences.
senses.ms_definition: Baik dan bermanfaat serta tidak membawa keburukan atau persengketaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于生活方式和竞争关系。persaingan sihat 强调竞争有建设性、不过度损害他人，并非竞争者身体健康。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Awak sihat? 是常见的关心问候；对长辈或正式对象可说 Apa khabar, puan? Semoga puan sihat.
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 学校作业、公文、新闻及职场文件应写 sihat。sehat 在印度尼西亚语中使用，遇到跨境材料时应按语言规范判断；引用品牌或专名时保留其正式拼写。

etymology.historical_story: Sehat and sihat belong to an established vocabulary of health with Arabic ancestry. An older Malay vocabulary explicitly cross-references sehat to sihat and labels sihat Arabic. Modern Malaysian spelling guidance selects sihat. This history explains why learners encounter both forms in regional or older material, while Malaysian public writing consistently requires the standard spelling. [Historical vocabulary](https://ms.wikisource.org/wiki/Malay-English_Vocabulary/S), [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把“身体”里的“体”联想到字母 i：在马来西亚，说身体健康写 sihat。整词记忆，别拆成 se- 和 hat。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 表示使成为一体；此形式可用于祈使句或第一、第二人称被动结构。词根不发生音变；menyatukan 中的 s 脱落由 meN- 引起。数据包中的 ساتو 是词根 satu 的 Jawi，此处补为完整词形 ساتوکن。

senses.zh_definition: 把分开的事物合并为一个整体；把不同的人或群体团结起来。
senses.en_definition: Combine separate things into one whole, or bring people together in unity.
senses.ms_definition: Jadikan beberapa benda atau kumpulan sebagai satu keseluruhan; himpunkan dan eratkan hubungan antara orang atau golongan.
senses.nuances: 可指文件、组织等的合并，也可指人与群体的团结。独立使用常带祈使语气；陈述主动行为通常用 menyatukan。释义据 [DBP satu 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyatukan+1) 改写，非逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 使目标、决心或力量协调一致；把力量集中到共同方向。
senses.en_definition: Align aims or resolve, or concentrate efforts on a shared purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Selaraskan tujuan atau tekad dan tumpukan tenaga ke arah matlamat yang sama.
senses.nuances: 侧重共同方向和行动的一致性，不要求参与者组成同一个机构。常见于号召、演说或团队动员。此义据 [DBP menyatukan 的相关义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyatukan+1) 改写。

senses.zh_definition: 使两人结为夫妻；以委婉方式表示为两人缔结婚姻。
senses.en_definition: Join two people in marriage.
senses.ms_definition: Kahwinkan atau nikahkan dua orang; digunakan sebagai ungkapan halus.
senses.nuances: 属于婚姻语境中的委婉表达，不能把所有“让两个人在一起”的情境都理解为结婚。此义据 [DBP menyatukan 的婚姻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyatukan+1) 改写。

etymology.historical_story: Satukan makes an abstract action easy to see: satu means one, and the suffix -kan turns that idea into making things one. The same family extends from joining objects to aligning determination and uniting communities. DBP also records a courteous marriage sense under menyatukan, showing how physical togetherness develops into social and ceremonial meanings. [DBP satu 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menyatukan+1)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: satu 是“一”，-kan 是“使之”：satukan 就是“让它们变成一个整体”。

etymology.historical_story: Servis adapts English service to Malay spelling and pronunciation. Its familiar settings reveal several distinct meanings: a badminton court, a vehicle workshop, and a conversation about customer treatment. Malay also gives the borrowed word its own verbal morphology in menservis. General service provision, however, is normally expressed as perkhidmatan in formal writing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: servis 联想英语 service：球场是“发球”，车厂是“保养”，店里是“服务”。

etymology.historical_story: English storm continues an Old English word and has a Germanic relative in German Sturm. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay morphology. English also extends the weather image to emotional outbursts and forceful attacks. These extensions should not automatically be transferred to Malay ribut. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/storm).

etymology.historical_story: DBP records jenak as a very short span of time and identifies sejenak as its derivative. The prefix se- turns that temporal base into a familiar expression for a brief interval. The word is especially useful in narrative: a speaker pauses, a traveller rests, or someone reflects before continuing. No more distant origin is established here. [DBP: jenak I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=jenak+I)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se- 想成“一”，jenak 想成“短时间”：sejenak 就是“一小会儿”。读到词尾 [ʔ] 时轻轻收住，像动作短暂停了一下。

morphology.pattern_note: 添加使动后缀 -kan，词根保留；可分析为 sa.kit.kan。sakitkan 可用于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构，也常在口语中替代 menyakitkan。输入 jawi ساکيت 实际对应词根 sakit，按要求原样保留；含后缀的完整拼写应为 ساکيتکن。

senses.zh_definition: 使身体某部位疼痛；弄疼。
senses.en_definition: To cause physical pain to someone or a part of the body.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang atau sesuatu bahagian tubuh berasa sakit.
senses.nuances: 属于使动动词，不等于形容词 sakit 所表示的生病或疼痛状态。输入释义对应词根 sakit；本义参照 menyakitkan 编写。正式主动陈述句通常使用 menyakitkan。[PRPM：menyakitkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=menyakitkan)

senses.zh_definition: 使人感情受伤、难过、气愤或受到冒犯，尤用于 sakitkan hati。
senses.en_definition: To hurt someone's feelings, upset them, or cause offence.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang berasa tersinggung, sedih, geram atau tidak senang hati.
senses.nuances: sakitkan hati 的 hati 指情感，不指肝脏疾病。口语主动句常省略 meN-；正式表达按句式使用 menyakitkan，或在合法的无前缀结构中保留 sakitkan。[DBP：menyakitkan hati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan)

senses.zh_definition: 使人看着难受或反感，尤用于 sakitkan mata。
senses.en_definition: To offend the eye or be unpleasant to look at.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan rasa tidak senang apabila dilihat kerana buruk atau tidak menyenangkan.

etymology.historical_story: Sakitkan combines sakit, describing pain or illness, with the causative suffix -kan. The formation shifts attention from experiencing pain to causing it. Malay also speaks of emotional injury through hati, the inner seat of feeling. The fuller active form menyakitkan connects this everyday expression with standard written grammar.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sakit 是“痛”，加 -kan 就是“让……痛”；sakitkan hati 是让心里难受，而非让肝脏生病。

etymology.historical_story: Sindiket belongs to the international word family represented by English syndicate and French syndicat. Historically, that family concerns representatives acting for a group. English later developed both commercial and organized-crime meanings. Malay likewise preserves a neutral sense of joint enterprise alongside the criminal sense familiar from news reports. The shared idea is coordinated collective action. [Etymonline: syndicate](https://www.etymonline.com/word/syndicate).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sindiket 与英语 syndicate 配对记：一群人联合行动；看上下文，可能是诈骗团伙，也可能是合法商业联合体。

etymology.historical_story: Siku belongs to an old Austronesian family of words for the elbow. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary connects Malay siku with related forms across the region. Its Malay meanings reveal an accessible shape association: an elbow bends, a road turns, and a carpenter's square forms an angle. These connections help explain the vocabulary without inventing modern affixes. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary: *sikux](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30777).

etymology.historical_story: Sheikh represents Arabic shaykh, associated with seniority and authority. In Malay, the established spelling syeikh carries religious and traditional social meanings, including a historical role in managing pilgrims. The spelling Sheikh also survives in personal names. This distinction matters in editing: standardizing a common title and altering someone's recorded name are different decisions.

etymology.historical_story: Sehelai combines the Malay element se-, meaning one, with the classifier helai. Its usefulness lies in the way Malay groups objects for counting: paper, leaves, garments, and hair can share a classifier even though Chinese and English name their units differently. Learning the accompanying noun therefore matters as much as learning sehelai itself.

etymology.historical_story: Siling is borrowed from English ceiling, adapted to Malay spelling while retaining its recognizable sound. Its everyday architectural meaning also provides an intuitive image for an abstract maximum: a price or allocation cannot rise beyond its ceiling. Malaysian dictionary guidance explicitly accepts harga siling, connecting household vocabulary with the language of prices and administration. [Wikikamus: siling](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/siling), [DBP: siling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=siling)

etymology.historical_story: Samantha has an uncertain origin. One proposal connects it with Samuel and a name ending possibly influenced by Greek anthos, meaning flower. That proposal remains tentative. The name became much more familiar through Samantha, the central character of the television series Bewitched, which began in 1964. Its cultural history is clearer than its original construction. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/samantha)

etymology.historical_story: Strawberi is the Malay adaptation of English strawberry. Its familiar English spelling has been reshaped into a Malay word whose dictionary pronunciation is stro.bé.ri. The same headword names both the Fragaria plant and its fruit, allowing context to distinguish cultivation from food. This borrowing illustrates how an imported food name becomes ordinary vocabulary without acquiring a Malay derivational prefix.

etymology.historical_story: English sniper comes from snipe plus the agent ending -er. The shooting verb is associated with hunting snipe, birds regarded as challenging targets. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/snipe); [Malaysian police usage](https://rmp2u.rmp.gov.my/content/18-pegawai-dan-anggota-pdrm-tamat-kursus-asas-sniper-utk)

etymology.historical_story: Sepantas illustrates a productive Malay comparison pattern: se- combines with an adjective to express equal degree. Its base, pantas, covers both speed and dexterity. The familiar image sepantas kilat turns lightning into a vivid benchmark for rapid action, while sepantas mungkin applies the same degree pattern to practical requests and deadlines.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se- 记成“一样”，pantas 记成“快”：sepantas kilat，就是“和闪电一样快”。

etymology.historical_story: English square travelled through French from Latin vocabulary associated with making things square. Its early English history includes the carpenter's tool for checking right angles. The geometric figure, the mathematical square, and the urban square developed around related ideas of shape and space. In Malay contexts, these meanings require different equivalents. Source: [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/square).

etymology.historical_story: Spring is an English loan used in Malay for the resilient component found in clocks, vehicles and other mechanisms. Its borrowed spelling preserves a consonant cluster unusual in older Malay vocabulary. Malay dictionaries place it alongside pegas, illustrating how a borrowed technical label can coexist with another established term for the same object. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=spring).

etymology.historical_story: Semester belongs to an international academic vocabulary whose history reaches back to Latin semestris, meaning “lasting six months.” European universities helped establish its association with a half-year teaching period. In Malay, the whole word functions as an educational term: its historical reference to six months does not require every teaching semester to last exactly that long. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/semester)

etymology.historical_story: Seburuk illustrates a productive Malay way of comparing degrees: se- attaches to buruk, which can describe poor condition, unattractive appearance, or bad conduct. The same pattern appears in sebaik and secantik. A reassuring sentence such as tidak seburuk yang disangka uses this ordinary grammatical resource to reduce an expected negative judgment. [Malay morphology research](https://spaj.ukm.my/jws/index.php/jws/article/download/593/504/); [DBP: buruk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=buruk)

senses.zh_definition: 不经考虑、查证或选择地；随意地，胡乱地。

senses.zh_definition: 普通的、随便一个的；常用于否定结构，表示某人或某物非同一般。
senses.en_definition: Ordinary or unremarkable, especially in negative constructions meaning exceptional.

senses.nuances: 常见于 bukan orang sembarangan，意思是“不是普通人物”。这是受结构限制的用法，不能把所有 sembarangan 都译成“普通”。DBP 语言咨询确认 dia bukan orang sembarangan 的结构可用。[DBP：相关用法咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sembarang)

etymology.historical_story: Sembarangan is formed from sembarang with -an. Its meanings connect unrestricted choice with insufficient care: doing something any old way can imply failing to investigate or select properly. Yet negation changes the effect in bukan orang sembarangan, which praises someone as exceptional. Both patterns are recorded in DBP's dictionary and language advice. [DBP: sembarang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sembarang)

etymology.historical_story: Sotong belongs to the everyday vocabulary of Malay coastal life; no specific ancient source language is asserted here. Its cultural associations are especially vivid on the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia, where ketupat sotong combines squid, glutinous rice and coconut milk. This dish connects the word with fishing communities and regional cooking traditions. [JKKN cultural record](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/en/senibudaya/detail/725)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 so.tong 联想成“收进筒”：鱿鱼身体像软筒，还能塞入糯米做 ketupat sotong。只是画面助记，不是词源。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合文学、影视和熟人玩笑语境。面对不熟悉典故的人，可先说明 detektif fiksyen Sherlock Holmes；正式评价他人时宜直接描述其观察或分析能力。

etymology.historical_story: Sherlock became internationally familiar through Sherlock Holmes, introduced in Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet in 1887. Later stories in The Strand Magazine helped make the detective famous. For Malay learners, this is a literary name carried into discussion of books and adaptations, rather than a word assembled from Malay roots or affixes. [Conan Doyle Estate](https://conandoyleestate.com/news/on-this-day-in-history-arthur-conan-doyles-a-study-in-scarlet-was-first-published)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Sherlock，就想起福尔摩斯拿着放大镜寻找线索；这是人物联想，不是词源拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语人名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。通常只有一个音节，sh 表示 /ʃ/。正文中写作 Shawn；Sean、Shaun 是相关姓名拼写，不是马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 肖恩：英语人名，源于爱尔兰语姓名 Seán 的英语化拼写，通常用作男性名字。
senses.en_definition: A given name, usually masculine, representing an anglicized spelling of Irish Seán.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama lelaki, yang merupakan variasi ejaan Inggeris bagi nama Ireland Seán.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词；保留输入键名 shawn，实际书写应大写为 Shawn。输入包没有提供 DBP 普通词条释义，因此这里提供姓名说明，不冒充 DBP 原文。下列为自然的人名搭配，并非固定词组。姓名关系参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sean)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 姓名应保留本人采用的拼写，不随意改成 Sean 或 Shaun。姓名的历史来源不能用来判断当事人的国籍、族群或宗教。

etymology.historical_story: Shawn is an English spelling of Irish Seán, the Irish counterpart of John. The name belongs to a wider family descending through European forms from Hebrew Yohanan, associated with divine graciousness. Shawn makes the pronunciation more transparent to English readers, whereas Sean preserves more of the Irish spelling. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Sean).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Shawn 读作近似“肖恩”，实际是一个音节；看见 sh，先想到 /ʃ/，不要逐字母读成马来语音节。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马英混用中保留；单音节，不按马来语词缀拆分。IPA 为英语读音，实际本地发音可有差异。数据包未提供音节划分及爪夷文，保留 null；未确认常规马来语派生词，词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 速度；运动、运作或完成某项活动的快慢程度。
senses.en_definition: The rate at which something moves, operates, or happens.
senses.ms_definition: Kadar pergerakan, operasi atau pelaksanaan sesuatu; kelajuan.
senses.nuances: 此处是英语词在马英混用中的用法；正式马来语通常用 kelajuan 或按语境用 kepantasan。本马来语定义为编辑释义，status 按指定结构保留，不表示已核实其为 DBP 规范马来语词条。词义参见：[American Heritage：speed](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=speed)。

senses.zh_definition: 快速行驶；在交通语境中亦指超速驾驶。
senses.en_definition: To travel fast, especially to drive above the speed limit.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak atau memandu dengan laju, khususnya melebihi had laju.
senses.nuances: 英语动词在非正式混用句中的用法，定义为编辑释义。单凭 speed 不应脱离语境认定已经违法超速；正式马来语按意思写 memandu laju 或 memandu melebihi had laju。依据：[American Heritage：speed](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=speed)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语俚语，指安非他明等兴奋剂毒品。
senses.en_definition: Slang for a stimulant drug, especially amphetamine or methamphetamine.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah slanga bahasa Inggeris bagi dadah perangsang, terutama amfetamina atau metamfetamina.
senses.nuances: 属于英语毒品俚语，可能出现在引述或英语混用中，不是“速度”义，也不能单凭此名称确定具体化学成分。下列为说明性搭配，不宣称是马来西亚高频用语。依据：[American Heritage：speed](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=speed)。
