messages.ms_standard: Tukarlah kepada sekadar bertanya. Sekadar ialah ejaan baku.
messages.zh: 改成 sekadar bertanya 就好，规范拼写是 sekadar。
messages.en: Just change it to sekadar bertanya. Sekadar is the standard spelling.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Sekadar bertanya 可缓和提问语气，但涉及私人问题时仍应尊重对方不回答的选择。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 公文、考试与职场报告使用 sekadar。Sekadar gurauan 若用于回应他人的不适，可能显得在淡化其感受；不要用它代替必要的道歉。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Sekadar bertanya 可缓和提问语气，但涉及私人问题时仍应尊重对方不回答的选择。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 公文、考试与职场报告使用 sekadar。Sekadar gurauan 若用于回应他人的不适，可能显得在淡化其感受；不要用它代替必要的道歉。

etymology.historical_story: The standard form sekadar belongs to the kadar word family. Its meanings connect a measure or limit with expressions such as only, merely, and as much as necessary. That connection provides a useful semantic bridge between quantity and limitation. The packet does not establish a separate historical origin for sekedar, so this spelling should not receive an invented etymology. [DBP: sekadar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sekadar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kadar 是“程度、量”；sekadar 就是“只到这个量”。记住词根里的 a：se + kadar，不写 se + kedar。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，按单一词素记忆；词首 /skr/ 为借词允许的辅音群，不拆成词缀。下列 word_family 为复合词组，不是加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 卷轴；写有文字或绘有图画、可以卷起的纸张、羊皮纸等。
senses.en_definition: A roll of paper, parchment, or similar material bearing writing or pictures.
senses.ms_definition: Gulungan kertas, kertas kulit dan sebagainya yang di atasnya tertera tulisan atau lukisan.
senses.nuances: 指可卷起的文献或画作，也见于历史文物名称。核心定义及卷轴画术语参见：[DBP PRPM：skrol](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=skrol)。

senses.zh_definition: 学位或文凭证书，尤指大学毕业典礼颁发的正式证书。
senses.en_definition: An official degree or diploma certificate, especially one awarded at a graduation ceremony.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan akademik, dokumen rasmi yang mengesahkan penganugerahan ijazah atau diploma.
senses.nuances: 这是马来西亚教育行政中的常见用法，证书实物不一定卷起。它与列示课程及成绩的 transkrip 不同。实际用法参见：[UPSI 学术管理指南](https://bhea.upsi.edu.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/LAMPIRAN-C-BUKU-PANDUAN-PENGURUSAN-AKADEMIK-BPPA-UPSI-PINDAAN-2025.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 卷曲纹饰；形似卷起的纸边或翻卷波浪的装饰图案。
senses.en_definition: A decorative motif resembling a rolled edge or curling wave.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam seni bina, pola hiasan berlingkar yang menyerupai kertas kulit tergulung atau ombak bergulung.
senses.nuances: 限于美术、建筑和装饰语境，不是日常高频义项。以下为专业搭配。术语依据：[DBP PRPM：skrol，建筑艺术义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=skrol)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于使屏幕内容上下或左右移动的滚动控件。
senses.en_definition: A control used to move displayed content vertically or horizontally.
senses.ms_definition: Alat atau kawalan untuk menggerakkan teks secara menegak atau mengufuk pada skrin.
senses.nuances: 属于计算机术语用法，具体界面部件宜明确称为 bar skrol 或使用对应的 tatal 术语。参见：[DBP PRPM：skrol，屏幕控件义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=skrol)。

senses.zh_definition: 滚动屏幕内容；滑动浏览网页、信息或动态，常见于口语及数码交流。
senses.en_definition: To scroll through content on a screen, especially in informal digital communication.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan tidak formal, menggerakkan paparan untuk melihat bahagian kandungan yang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是口语及数码语境中的动词用法，不应冒充输入包的名词定义。正式说明可用 menatal；DBP 的英马词典以 menatal 对应计算机动词 scroll。参见：[DBP PRPM：scroll](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=scroll)。

etymology.historical_story: Skrol adapts English scroll into Malay spelling while retaining the recognisable initial consonant cluster. Its meanings connect several cultural settings: rolled manuscripts and paintings, decorative curls, and university certificates. Digital usage adds screen movement to this network of associations, although formal Malay also uses menatal for the action of scrolling through displayed content.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: skrol 直接联想英语 scroll：纸卷起来是卷轴，毕业时领取的是证书，在手机上则可指滚动浏览。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接加 -kan，词根保持不变；首字母 e 读 /ə/。对应主动形式 menyesuaikan 中，meN- 与词首 s 结合，s 脱落并出现 /ɲ/。输入的 سسواي 是词根拼写，完整派生词为 سسوايکن。

senses.zh_definition: 调整、修改或搭配某事物，使其符合特定需要、条件、标准或其他事物。
senses.en_definition: To adjust, adapt, or match something to particular needs, conditions, or requirements.
senses.ms_definition: Mengubah atau memadankan sesuatu supaya sesuai dan selaras dengan keperluan, keadaan atau perkara lain.
senses.nuances: 常用结构为 sesuaikan + 受事 + dengan/mengikut + 依据。Sesuai 表示“合适”，sesuaikan 表示主动使其合适；不能直接用作形容词。词义据 [DBP：menyesuaikan](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=238404) 改写。

collocations.zh: 根据工作时间调整日程
collocations.en: adjust the schedule to working hours

collocations.ms: sesuaikan kaedah pengajaran mengikut keperluan murid
collocations.zh: 根据学生需要调整教学方法
collocations.en: adapt teaching methods to pupils' needs

senses.zh_definition: 使自己适应新的环境、生活条件或社会情境，通常与 diri 连用。
senses.en_definition: With diri, to adapt oneself to a new environment, situation, or way of life.
senses.ms_definition: Mengubah cara hidup, sikap atau tingkah laku sendiri supaya dapat menghadapi keadaan atau persekitaran tertentu.
senses.nuances: 这是 sesuaikan diri 的反身用法，与调整外部事物相区别。正式陈述通常使用 menyesuaikan diri；指示或劝告可说 sesuaikan diri。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论安排、尺寸、教学和工作适应。向新同事或外地人说 Sesuaikan diri 时，应说明具体需要，避免让劝告显得像要求对方无条件迎合。

etymology.historical_story: The adjective sesuai describes things that fit or agree. Adding -kan turns that relationship into an action: make something fit. The same word family covers matching objects, adjusting arrangements, and adapting oneself to unfamiliar surroundings. This shared pattern explains why a practical instruction about a timetable and advice about settling into a community use sesuaikan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sesuai＝合适；加 -kan 就是“调到合适”。看到 diri，就把调整对象换成自己：sesuaikan diri＝适应。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的专名，规范书写为 Slytherin；th 通常读 /ð/。没有马来语词缀结构，不能拆成 sly + 马来语词缀。音标为英语来源读音。

senses.zh_definition: 〈专有名词〉斯莱特林，《哈利·波特》中霍格沃茨的四大学院之一；名称取自其创办者萨拉查·斯莱特林。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi salah satu daripada empat rumah di Hogwarts dalam siri Harry Potter, yang dinamakan sempena pengasasnya, Salazar Slytherin.
senses.nuances: 这是虚构世界专名，不是表示“狡猾”或“邪恶”的马来语普通词。资料包没有提供 DBP 释义；此处 status 按要求保留为 official，不代表 DBP 已收录。释义为编辑撰写，搭配为常见指称组合，未提供频次统计。[官方 Harry Potter 百科](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/slytherin)。

senses.nuances: 在 Salazar Slytherin 中指人物姓氏；在 rumah Slytherin 中指学院。不能根据这个姓氏推断现实人物的性格。[官方 Harry Potter 百科](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/slytherin)。

etymology.historical_story: In the fictional history of Harry Potter, Slytherin house takes its name from Salazar Slytherin, one of Hogwarts' founders. Its serpent emblem and green and silver colours make the name readily recognisable. This explains the name within the story; it does not establish a Malay derivation or a verified account of Rowling's naming process. [Official encyclopedia](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/slytherin).

etymology.historical_story: Snek is an adapted borrowing of English snack. Its compact spelling fits Malay pronunciation while retaining the recognisable initial consonant cluster. DBP accepts it as a standard word, so it can appear naturally on menus and packaging. In Malaysian usage, it covers light foods rather than only packaged crisps or sweets. [DBP: snek](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=snek)

senses.en_definition: An Indonesian form meaning station, especially a railway station or a facility serving a particular function; Malaysian Malay normally uses stesen.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records stasiun with the label IB, identifying an Indonesian–Dutch connection, and explains it through stesen. The regional difference remains useful for travellers: Indonesian transport vocabulary uses stasiun, while Malaysian Malay normally uses stesen. Recognising the pair helps readers move between neighbouring language varieties without treating either spelling as a universal replacement. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=stasiun), [Indonesian official thesaurus](https://tesaurus.kemendikdasmen.go.id/tematis/lema/stasiun).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把sta-si-un与英语station、马来西亚马来语stesen连成一组：同指“站”，到印尼看stasiun，在马来西亚通常用stesen。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或其提出的问题、疑问或试题；也可指上下文已经明确的那个问题或那些题目。

senses.ms_definition: Pertanyaan, termasuk dalam peperiksaan, yang dikaitkan dengan orang atau perkara tertentu melalui bentuk -nya.

etymology.historical_story: Malay soal comes from Arabic suʾāl, meaning a question or inquiry. Malay then uses its own suffix -an to form soalan, familiar from classrooms and examinations. Adding -nya links the question to a person or an established context. The expression therefore combines an Arabic lexical source with productive Malay grammatical elements. See [soal: etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/soal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两步记：soalan 是“问题”，加 nya 就把问题接回“他／她／前面提到的对象”：soalan + nya。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示喷出物或结果的名词，词根拼写不变。资料包将 semburan 标为词根，此处依据 DBP 的 sembur 派生词系列校正；相关词 menyembur、penyembur 中，meN-、peN- 在 s 前分别实现为 meny-、peny-，原来的 s 脱落。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=semburan)

senses.en_definition: A spray or jet of expelled material; also a spraying operation or a preparation applied as a spray.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang terpancar atau terpancut keluar; pancaran. Dalam penggunaan tertentu, turut merujuk kepada kerja menyembur atau bahan yang digunakan dalam bentuk semburan.
senses.nuances: 核心是喷出来的物质或喷射形态；penyemburan 更明确地表示过程，penyembur 表示喷洒器具。官方卫生文件也使用 semburan residu 等名称指喷洒作业。核心义见 [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=semburan)，作业用法见 [马来西亚卫生部指南](https://www2.moh.gov.my/moh/resources/Penerbitan/Garis%20Panduan/Garis%20Panduan%20Umum%28KKM%29/Prosedur_Semburan_Residu_dan_Semburan_Perimeter_Untuk_Kawalan_Denggi.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Semburan is formed from sembur with the noun-forming suffix -an. DBP records both material projected outward and angry verbal abuse. The root also appears in descriptions of traditional healing involving material blown from the mouth. These documented uses connect bodily projection, practical spraying, and the figurative image of words forcefully expelled. [Source](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=bahan+jampi)

etymology.historical_story: Malay sandwic adapts English sandwich. The English food name is associated with John Montagu, the fourth Earl of Sandwich. A familiar story says he ate meat between bread while gambling, but that episode belongs to legend rather than secure proof of invention. Bread with fillings existed before the name became popular. [University of Illinois Library](https://publish.illinois.edu/idhh-highlights/index.php/2022/08/16/a-classic-no-matter-how-you-slice-it-the-sandwich/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sandwic 就是英语 sandwich 的马来语拼写；词尾 c 发“吃”开头的 /tʃ/ 音，联想“两片面包夹着吃”。

senses.en_definition: A given name of Punjabi origin, used by both women and men and associated with continuous remembrance.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang berasal daripada bahasa Punjabi, digunakan oleh perempuan dan lelaki serta berkaitan dengan makna ingatan yang berterusan.
senses.nuances: 人名须大写为 Simran；仅凭输入词形无法确定具体人物。未核实其作为 DBP 普通词条的收录，马来语定义为编辑性说明。以下是姓名的自然组合示例，不是固定搭配。参见 [Simran 的姓名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/simran)。

senses.zh_definition: 忆念神的修持；尤指锡克教中持续忆念神及其圣名的宗教实践。
senses.en_definition: Devotional remembrance of God, especially the Sikh practice of keeping the divine Name in mind.
senses.ms_definition: Amalan mengingati Tuhan secara berterusan, khususnya dalam tradisi Sikh, termasuk mengingati atau menyebut nama Tuhan dengan penuh perhatian.
senses.nuances: 这是宗教专门用语，不是日常马来语中“记忆”的普通同义词。其内涵包括专注的忆念，不能只理解为机械重复声音。马来语定义为依据宗教资料编写的说明，参见 [Sikh Dharma International：Simran](https://www.sikhdharma.org/holding-the-remembrance/)。

etymology.historical_story: Simran is connected with Sanskrit smaraṇa, meaning remembrance, through Punjabi usage. In Sikh religious life, remembrance becomes a sustained orientation towards God rather than merely recalling information. The same meaningful word also serves as a personal name. In Malay text, capitalization and surrounding references help distinguish a person called Simran from the devotional practice called simran. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/simran), [Sikh Dharma International](https://www.sikhdharma.org/holding-the-remembrance/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simran 联想到“心里持续忆念”；大写 Simran 先看作人名，小写 simran 再结合宗教语境理解。

etymology.historical_story: Serata belongs to the Malay rata family, whose meanings connect levelness, even distribution and complete coverage. With se-, the established meaning becomes spatial totality: an entire village, country or world. A useful semantic bridge is an evenly covered surface becoming a whole area covered, although this is an explanatory connection rather than a dated historical reconstruction. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=rata)

word_family.gloss: 运动；体操活动，senaman 的实际构词基础
使身体部位活动或得到锻炼

senses.zh_definition: 为保持健康、增强体能或训练身体而进行的身体活动或锻炼。
senses.en_definition: Physical exercise or bodily training undertaken for health or fitness.
senses.ms_definition: Latihan gerak badan untuk menjaga kesihatan dan meningkatkan kecergasan.
senses.nuances: 可统称锻炼活动，也可指某一种具体练习。melakukan senaman 表示做运动，bersenam 是对应的常用动词。学习题或语言练习通常称 latihan，不称 senaman；senaman 也不限于竞技体操。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program kecergasan kakitangan itu dimulakan dengan senaman regangan sebelum aktiviti utama.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该员工健身活动在主要项目开始前，先安排了伸展运动。
dual_scenarios.en: The staff fitness programme began with stretching exercises before the main activity.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jom buat senaman ringan kat taman petang ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Marilah kita melakukan senaman ringan di taman pada petang ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 今天傍晚一起去公园做点轻松的运动吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Let's do some light exercise at the park this evening.
spoken_features: jom 用于友好邀约，对应 marilah kita。
buat senaman 是自然口语，标准对应句使用 melakukan senaman。
kat 对应 di，ni 对应 ini，je 对应 sahaja。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jom buat senaman ringan kat taman petang ni. Aku dah lama tak bersenam.
messages.ms_standard: Marilah kita melakukan senaman ringan di taman pada petang ini. Saya sudah lama tidak bersenam.
messages.zh: 今天傍晚一起去公园做点轻松的运动吧。我好久没锻炼了。
messages.en: Let's do some light exercise at the park this evening. I haven't worked out in ages.

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh! Kita mula dengan senaman regangan dulu je, lepas tu jalan santai.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Kita mulakan dengan senaman regangan dahulu, kemudian berjalan santai.
messages.zh: 可以呀！咱们先做做伸展，然后慢慢散步。
messages.en: Sure! Let's start with some stretches, then go for a gentle walk.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 邀请朋友运动可说 Jom buat senaman ringan。与不熟悉的人或长辈交谈时，使用礼貌邀约，避免直接评论体重、身材或运动能力。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合健康宣传、学校活动、办公室健身和日常邀约。集体活动应尊重参加者的身体状况、个人界限与着装习惯；先询问意愿，不强迫跟上同一强度。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 邀请朋友运动可说 Jom buat senaman ringan。与不熟悉的人或长辈交谈时，使用礼貌邀约，避免直接评论体重、身材或运动能力。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合健康宣传、学校活动、办公室健身和日常邀约。集体活动应尊重参加者的身体状况、个人界限与着装习惯；先询问意愿，不强迫跟上同一强度。

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups senaman with senam and bersenam, revealing a Malay word family for bodily exercise. The suffix -an forms the activity noun senaman. Its cultural setting extends beyond individual workouts: Malaysia's Senam Seni programme combines movements from dance and martial arts with aerobics, linking shared cultural expression and group exercise. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=senam), [JKKN](https://portal.jkkn.gov.my/en/catalog/cd-dvd-vcd-publication/638-senam-seni-malaysia-en)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一组动作链：senam 是基础，bersenam 是去锻炼，senaman 是所做的运动。可配合 senaman regangan（伸展运动）边伸手边记。

morphology.pattern_note: 用于马来语语境时作为英语整词处理；不拆成马来语词根 skip 与词缀 -er。音标采用英语非卷舌读法。

senses.zh_definition: 队长：带领运动队的成员。
senses.en_definition: The captain of a sports team.
senses.ms_definition: Kapten atau ketua sesuatu pasukan sukan.
senses.nuances: 见于体育报道及英语夹杂的交流。正式马来语通常用 kapten pasukan 或 ketua pasukan。DBP 英马词典收录的是英语词 skipper，不能据此认定其为正式马来语词形。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kapten)。

senses.zh_definition: 船长；尤指负责小型商船、渔船或游艇的人。
senses.en_definition: The person in command of a boat or ship, especially a small vessel.
senses.ms_definition: Nakhoda atau juragan yang mengetuai pengendalian sesebuah bot atau kapal.
senses.nuances: 航海语境中的英语称谓。正式马来语可依船种和职务使用 nakhoda、juragan 或 kapten kapal；不专指船主。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=juragan)。

senses.zh_definition: 机长：负责指挥飞机的驾驶员，属英语非正式称呼。
senses.en_definition: An informal English term for the captain of an aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan tidak formal dalam bahasa Inggeris bagi kapten pesawat.
senses.nuances: 英马词典将此义标为尤见于美国用法。马来语航空文件应使用 kapten pesawat 或相应正式职称。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kapten)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 体育报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Istilah Inggeris skipper dalam laporan sukan itu merujuk kepada kapten pasukan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该体育报道中的英语词 skipper 指球队队长。
dual_scenarios.en: The English term skipper in that sports report refers to the team captain.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 队友讨论训练
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Skipper kita dah sampai kat padang ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kapten pasukan kita sudah tiba di padang?
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们队长到球场了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has our captain got to the pitch yet?
spoken_features: skipper 是交流中夹用的英语称谓。
dah 对应 sudah；kat 在此对应 di。
句末 ke 表示口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Amir (队友)
messages.ms_spoken: Skipper kita dah sampai kat padang ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kapten pasukan kita sudah tiba di padang?
messages.zh: 咱们队长到球场了吗？
messages.en: Has our captain got to the pitch yet?

messages.speaker: Hakim (队友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia nak mula latihan sekarang. Cepat sikit!
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, dia mahu memulakan latihan sekarang. Sila datang dengan segera.
messages.zh: 到了，他现在就要开始训练。快点来！
messages.en: Yes, he wants to start training now. Hurry up!

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 队友熟悉的体育环境中可用作亲切称呼；正式介绍或初次接触时，使用姓名及合适职称更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合体育、航海及英语夹杂的交流。正式马来语文件优先采用 kapten、ketua pasukan、nakhoda 或 juragan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 队友熟悉的体育环境中可用作亲切称呼；正式介绍或初次接触时，使用姓名及合适职称更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合体育、航海及英语夹杂的交流。正式马来语文件优先采用 kapten、ketua pasukan、nakhoda 或 juragan。

etymology.historical_story: English skipper comes from Middle Dutch scipper, a word for a ship's master related to the word for ship. Its use later extended to sports captains. That shared idea of leadership explains why readers encounter the same word around boats and teams. Within Malay discourse, it remains useful to distinguish this English expression from formal Malay equivalents. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/skipper).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skipper 联想到掌舵的人：船上掌舵是船长，球队带头是队长。

morphology.pattern_note: 原形无词缀；派生词 bersaid 由 ber- + said 构成，词根不发生音变。这里是马来语服装词，不按英语 said 的 /sed/ 发音。

senses.zh_definition: 衣裤等经熨烫形成的折线或折痕，尤指裤子的挺直裤线。
senses.en_definition: A crease pressed into clothing with an iron, especially a trouser crease.
senses.ms_definition: Lipatan pada pakaian seperti seluar atau baju yang telah digosok atau diseterika.
senses.nuances: 重点是熨烫形成的有形折线，不泛指所有皱褶，也不指缝合线。日常解释时可说 lipatan yang diseterika，以便不熟悉此词的人理解。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场服装整理说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Pastikan said pada seluar seragam lurus dan kemas sebelum menghadiri majlis rasmi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 出席正式活动前，请确保制服裤子的裤线笔直整齐。
dual_scenarios.en: Ensure that the creases in the uniform trousers are straight and neat before attending the official function.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 家人讨论熨衣服
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Said seluar ni dah senget lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Said pada seluar ini sudah senget.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这条裤子的裤线都歪了啦。
dual_scenarios.en: The crease in these trousers has gone crooked.
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语形式。
dah 对应 sudah，表示状态已经出现。
lah 在这里表达轻微抱怨。

messages.speaker: Amir (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Kak, said seluar ni dah senget lah. Boleh tolong gosok balik?
messages.ms_standard: Kakak, said pada seluar ini sudah senget. Bolehkah kakak membantu menyeterikanya semula?
messages.zh: 姐，这条裤子的裤线歪了啦，能帮我重新熨一下吗？
messages.en: Sis, the crease in these trousers is crooked. Could you iron them again?

messages.speaker: Aina (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, letak kat sini je. Nanti akak betulkan.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, letakkan sahaja di sini. Nanti kakak membetulkannya.
messages.zh: 可以，放这里就好，等下姐姐帮你弄正。
messages.en: Sure, just leave them here. I’ll straighten it out in a bit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于衣物整理时语气中性。请别人重熨衣裤，可用 Boleh tolong…?，比直接指出对方熨得不好更委婉。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合洗衣、裁缝及制服整理情境；谈别人的穿着时宜私下提醒，并先确认该衣物本来需要保留裤线。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于衣物整理时语气中性。请别人重熨衣裤，可用 Boleh tolong…?，比直接指出对方熨得不好更委婉。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合洗衣、裁缝及制服整理情境；谈别人的穿着时宜私下提醒，并先确认该衣物本来需要保留裤线。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry records said as a crease made by ironing and bersaid as having such creases. Picture someone preparing a pair of trousers for a formal occasion: the iron creates a deliberate line that gives the garment a tidy shape. This clothing association provides a reliable memory anchor; the packet does not establish a deeper borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 said 时，想象熨斗沿裤腿一滑，留下一道笔直裤线；把声音和这条线一起记住。

headword.verification_note: 规范马来语组合形式，不必作为独立词根收录。保留数据包的 Jawi 字段，但 سوارا 仅拼写 suara，未包含 -mu；完整形式可写作 سوارامو。音节可分析为 su.a.ra.mu。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是附着在词尾的第二人称代词简式，此处表示所属；严格说属于附着代词，并非派生词缀。连写时词根不发生音变。

senses.zh_definition: 你的声音，尤指你说话、歌唱或发声时产生的声音。
senses.en_definition: Your voice, especially the sound you produce when speaking or singing.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi yang kamu keluarkan ketika bercakap, menyanyi atau bersuara.
senses.nuances: suara 在词典中还可指动物或器物的声音，但 suaramu 通常指交谈对象本人的声音。它比 suara awak 更容易带出亲近、抒情或文学色彩；IPA 采用保留 /a/ 的读法。此处马来语释义是根据词根义和 -mu 合成的释义，并非独立词条的官方原文。词根参见[DBP：suara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=319148&keyword=suara)。

senses.zh_definition: 你的意见、诉求或立场，尤其指你表达意见或参与公共事务时的声音。
senses.en_definition: Your expressed views, concerns, or voice in a discussion or public matter.
senses.ms_definition: Pendapat, pandangan atau kehendak yang kamu nyatakan dalam sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这是 suara 的引申义，并不必然涉及实际音量。选举语境中可以关联个人的政治表达，但 suaramu 不应在所有场合直接译为“你的一票”。依据[DBP：suara 的意见及表态义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=319148&keyword=suara)归纳。

dual_scenarios.context: 青年公共参与宣传
dual_scenarios.ms: Melalui kempen ini, suaramu dapat membantu membentuk dasar yang lebih peka terhadap keperluan golongan muda.
dual_scenarios.zh: 通过这项活动，你的意见能够帮助制定更关注青年需求的政策。
dual_scenarios.en: Through this campaign, your voice can help shape policies that better address young people's needs.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 熟人发送语音
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah dengar mesej tadi, tapi suaramu perlahan sangatlah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendengar mesej tadi, tetapi suaramu terlalu perlahan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才的语音我听了，不过你的声音太小了啦。
dual_scenarios.en: I listened to your message, but your voice was really quiet.
spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式
-lah 加强语气
suaramu 在聊天中带亲近色彩，suara kau 或 suara awak 也常见

messages.speaker: Nadia (好友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah dengar mesej kau, tapi suaramu perlahan sangat. Kau kat luar ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendengar mesej kamu, tetapi suaramu terlalu perlahan. Adakah kamu berada di luar?
messages.zh: 你的语音我听了，可声音太小。你在外面吗？
messages.en: I listened to your voice message, but you were really quiet. Are you outside?

messages.speaker: Aina (好友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, aku kat luar. Nanti aku hantar semula je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya berada di luar. Saya akan menghantarnya semula nanti.
messages.zh: 对，我在外面。待会儿重新发给你就好。
messages.en: Yeah, I'm outside. I'll just send it again later.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 往往体现亲近、文学表达或宣传文案中的直接诉求。正式向上级、客户或陌生长者说话时，suara tuan、suara puan 或具体姓名通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合歌词、诗歌、亲近关系和青年宣传文案。涉及宗教中的神圣称呼时，代词书写有专门的大写与连字符规范，不应直接照搬普通 suaramu。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 往往体现亲近、文学表达或宣传文案中的直接诉求。正式向上级、客户或陌生长者说话时，suara tuan、suara puan 或具体姓名通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合歌词、诗歌、亲近关系和青年宣传文案。涉及宗教中的神圣称呼时，代词书写有专门的大写与连字符规范，不应直接照搬普通 suaramu。

etymology.historical_story: Malay suara comes from Sanskrit svara, associated with sound and voice. In suaramu, that established loanword combines with the Malay attached pronoun -mu to mean your voice. The expression illustrates how a historically borrowed root functions naturally within Malay grammar, carrying both literal sound and the figurative expression of personal views. [Source: published linguistic research](https://www.pertanika.upm.edu.my/resources/files/Pertanika%20PAPERS/JSSH%20Vol.%2025%20%283%29%20Sep.%202017/11%20JSSH-1573-2016-4thProof.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suara 是“声音”，-mu 是“你的”：把“你的”贴到声音后面，suaramu 就是“你的声音”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是附着于名词后的代词性成分，可表示所属或回指已知事物；词根不发生音变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入的 سيسا 是词根拼写，完整形式为 سيساڽ；音节与音标为补充分析。

senses.zh_definition: 某物使用、食用或处理后剩下的部分；其残余或剩余物。
senses.en_definition: What remains of something after it has been used, eaten, or processed.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sesuatu yang masih tinggal selepas digunakan, dimakan atau diproses, dengan rujukan kepada sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 可理解为“它的”，也可回指前文对象，整词常译为“剩下的”。是否属于可继续利用的余物或应丢弃的废物，由语境决定。马来语释义为依据词根义编写的释义，并非 DBP 对整词的原文引述。[DBP PRPM：sisa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sisa)

senses.zh_definition: 从某一总量中扣除已用、已付或已处理部分后所余的数额或部分。
senses.en_definition: The balance or remaining portion of an amount or whole.
senses.ms_definition: Baki daripada jumlah atau keseluruhan setelah sebahagiannya digunakan, dibayar atau diambil.
senses.nuances: 可指款项、数量或其他整体的剩余部分。账目、公文中，bakinya 往往比 sisanya 更明确。此处是词根“剩余”义在数量语境中的应用。[DBP PRPM：sisa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sisa)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sebahagian bahan telah digunakan untuk ujian awal, manakala sisanya disimpan untuk analisis lanjut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 部分材料已用于初步测试，其余材料则留存作进一步分析。
dual_scenarios.en: Some of the material has been used for preliminary testing, while the remainder is being kept for further analysis.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Ambil sikit je, sisanya simpan dalam peti sejuk.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ambil sedikit sahaja dan simpan sisanya di dalam peti sejuk.
dual_scenarios.zh: 拿一点就好，剩下的放冰箱。
dual_scenarios.en: Just take a little and put the rest in the fridge.
spoken_features: sikit 是 sedikit 的常见口语形式。
je 对应 sahaja，表示“就、而已”。
口语中可省略地点短语前的 di。

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah makan sikit. Sisanya nak simpan kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah makan sedikit. Di manakah saya patut menyimpan sisanya?
messages.zh: 我已经吃了一点。剩下的要放哪儿？
messages.en: I've had a little. Where should I put the rest?

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Simpan dalam peti sejuk je, nanti aku makan.
messages.ms_standard: Simpan sahaja di dalam peti sejuk. Saya akan memakannya nanti.
messages.zh: 放冰箱就好，我等会儿吃。
messages.en: Just put it in the fridge. I'll eat it later.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论食物剩余时用法中性；招待客人时，直接说让对方吃 sisanya 可能显得把剩食留给客人，应结合实际情况措辞。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述材料、食物及数量的剩余部分。向客人提供仍可食用的食物时，masih ada makanan（还有食物）通常更体贴；财务语境可用 baki 明确表示余额。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论食物剩余时用法中性；招待客人时，直接说让对方吃 sisanya 可能显得把剩食留给客人，应结合实际情况措辞。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述材料、食物及数量的剩余部分。向客人提供仍可食用的食物时，masih ada makanan（还有食物）通常更体贴；财务语境可用 baki 明确表示余额。

etymology.historical_story: The everyday meaning of sisa connects several familiar situations: food left after a meal, money remaining after spending, and material left after use. Adding -nya links that remainder to something already mentioned. This makes sisanya a compact way to carry shared information from one sentence into the next.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sisa＝剩余，-nya＝它的／前面说过的；sisanya 就是“它剩下的那部分”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two connected-looking senses of segak: an impressive appearance and restored health. Together they offer a cultural picture of someone looking vigorous, well presented, and full of life. This is a useful semantic association, rather than proof that one sense historically developed from the other. A deeper borrowing origin is not established here. See [DBP definitions](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=segak).

etymology.historical_story: The deeper historical origin of suntuk is not established by the supplied evidence. Its dictionary meanings nevertheless preserve a memorable contrast: masa suntuk marks time reaching its limit, while sehari suntuk stretches across an entire day. A further sense, labelled Minangkabau by Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka, concerns shortness or narrowness of thought.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suntuk 想成时间轴的端点：masa suntuk 是逼近终点，sehari suntuk 是从起点一直到终点。

etymology.historical_story: Tolkien's Saruman draws on Old English searu, associated with skill, craft and cunning, together with man. The name is commonly interpreted as 'man of skill'. Its connection with clever workmanship suits the character's interest in devices and power. This literary formation belongs to Tolkien's naming system; it is not evidence of Malay affixation. [Tolkien Gateway：词源](https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Saruman#Etymology)

senses.zh_definition: 两条线或两个部分相交形成的叉形，尤指斜十字或乘号形状。

senses.zh_definition: 横置或交叉放置的木条、横杆；亦指由此形成的十字构件。
senses.en_definition: A crosspiece or crossbar, especially a piece of wood placed across another.
senses.ms_definition: Kayu palang atau salib; juga disebut kayu silang.
senses.nuances: 这是实物义，不能一概理解成纸上的符号。传统结构或器物说明中可见；silang keris则是专门的器物术语，指马来短剑ganja部件的尖端。[DBP释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=silang)

senses.zh_definition: 在复合词中表示交叉、相互关联或对照的关系。

senses.ms_definition: Unsur dalam kata majmuk yang membawa pengertian bersilang atau hubungan antara bahagian, seperti silang kata dan rujuk silang.
senses.nuances: 这里是名词性复合成分的用法概括，并非可自由替换bersilang的独立动词义。silang kata是填字游戏；rujuk silang是交叉参照。传统搭配另有silang empat“四岔路口”和silang selisih“意见不合或方向交错”。[DBP的silang词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=silang)、[DBP的rujuk silang词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=merujukkan)

etymology.historical_story: Silang centres on a visible image: one line or piece crossing another. DBP records both the cross-shaped figure and a wooden crosspiece, alongside compounds involving crossroads, puzzles, and disagreement. For learners, these meanings form a useful network around intersection. This is a semantic connection, rather than proof of a dated historical sequence or a particular foreign origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=silang)

etymology.historical_story: Sedut provides a concrete image of drawing something inward. Its dictionary family extends from physical suction to taking extracts from writing and draining money from others. Sedutan also names a selected excerpt, linking an everyday bodily action with editorial practice. These documented connections provide a useful history of meaning without inventing an ancient origin. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedut).

etymology.historical_story: DBP records gelintir as a Javanese-related word meaning a grain or small round object, and also as a classifier for people. With se-, segelintir denotes a small group of people. The connection offers a useful image of just a few grains, although that image illustrates the meaning rather than proving a documented sequence of semantic change. [DBP gelintir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=gelintir)

senses.zh_definition: 学者；在某一知识领域具有专门学问和研究能力的人。

senses.zh_definition: 大学学位获得者的称号；在马来西亚现代学历用语中，尤指硕士资格、学位或相应学习层次。
senses.en_definition: An academic designation for a university graduate; in contemporary Malaysian education, a master's qualification or level of study.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran bagi orang yang memperoleh ijazah universiti; dalam penggunaan pendidikan Malaysia kini, kelayakan atau peringkat pengajian yang disebut Master.
senses.nuances: ijazah sarjana 指硕士学位，sarjana muda 指学士。须结合国家语境理解，不能把印尼语中常指学士的 sarjana 直接套入马来西亚学历体系。马来西亚的 Master 与 Bachelor 对应分别为 Sarjana 与 Sarjana Muda：[DBP 用语说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sarjana)。

etymology.historical_story: Sarjana is traced to Sanskrit sajjana, associated with a good, virtuous or wise person. Its Malay meanings connect intellectual distinction with university qualifications. Today, Malaysian educational usage distinguishes sarjana, meaning master's level, from sarjana muda, meaning bachelor's level. The older association with a learned person remains alive alongside these institutional meanings. Sources: [linguistic research](https://pacling.anu.edu.au/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/seals-13.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sarjana).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sar.ja.na 的 ja 联想到中文“家”：有学问的专家是 sarjana；看到 ijazah sarjana，就想到硕士学位。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆成马来语词缀；通常读作一个音节，末尾字母 e 不另成音节。以下列出复合表达，不表示存在派生词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 酒店套房；由卧室、起居室等配套空间组成的住宿单元，可设用餐区和厨房。

senses.ms_definition: Unit penginapan hotel yang merangkumi bilik tidur serta ruang lain seperti ruang tamu, ruang makan dan dapur.
senses.nuances: 用于酒店和住宿行业，强调一组配套空间；各酒店的具体布局不同。不要将英语 suite 的家具、软件或随员等义项全部移植为马来语义项；音乐术语通常写作 suit。住宿义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=suite)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 酒店预订和商务接待均可使用。向工作人员询问时，可说 Boleh saya tahu kemudahan suite ini?，语气礼貌自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 酒店的套房名称不保证相同设施；预订时应明确卧室数、起居空间和入住人数。用于楼盘名称时，应遵循相关命名规范。

etymology.historical_story: The international hotel term belongs to the French suite word family, associated with things following one another or forming a connected set. This offers a useful image for connected accommodation spaces. DBP explicitly records the hotel meaning in its terminology advice, so the packet's empty definition does not establish that the word is absent from Malay. Sources: [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/suite), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=suite).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suite 读音接近英语 sweet：想象一间舒适的甜蜜套房，卧室和客厅配成一套；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 双音节词根。加 meN- 或 peN- 时，词首 s 被鼻音 ny /ɲ/ 替代：menyusun、penyusun；加 -an 得 susunan。

senses.zh_definition: 整齐叠放的一摞、一叠或一组东西。
senses.en_definition: An orderly pile or stack of things placed in layers.
senses.ms_definition: Longgok barang yang teratur, berlapis-lapis atau bertindih-tindih.
senses.nuances: 强调有次序地叠放，区别于杂乱的 longgok。数量结构常见 beberapa susun、dua susun。参见 [DBP：susun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=susun)。

senses.zh_definition: 层；级；由上下叠置的器物组成的一套。
senses.en_definition: A tier or level, or a set of objects arranged one above another.
senses.ms_definition: Tingkat atau seperangkat barang yang tersusun bertingkat-tingkat.
senses.nuances: 着重层数或成套的叠层结构。常见于饭盒、碗盘等器物；se- 表示一层、一套或一组，须依物件判断。

senses.zh_definition: 诗作等依次串联而成的一组、一串。
senses.en_definition: A sequence or string of verse.
senses.ms_definition: Rangkai atau untai sajak.
senses.nuances: 文语、文学用法，频率低于日常的“排列”义。搭配通常带 sesusun；不能据此把所有现代诗集都称为 susun。

senses.zh_definition: 花瓣等重叠形成的层；重瓣结构。
senses.en_definition: An overlapping layer or layered arrangement, especially of flower petals.
senses.ms_definition: Rangkap yang berlapis-lapis, seperti kelopak bunga.
senses.nuances: 用于描述花瓣层叠的形态，不表示把花瓣人工整理好。本义较专门，以下为描述性搭配。

collocations.en: the layered arrangement of flower petals

senses.zh_definition: 把物品按一定顺序、位置或层次摆放；排列；叠放。
senses.en_definition: To arrange, position, or stack things in an orderly way.
senses.ms_definition: Meletakkan barang beraturan, berderet-deret atau berlapis-lapis.
senses.nuances: 原形 susun 常用于祈使句及口语；正式主动陈述通常用 menyusun。Susun buku 不一定表示把书叠起来，也可指在书架上排好。

senses.zh_definition: 有条理地安排、组织或编排内容、时间和计划。
senses.en_definition: To organize, plan, or compose something in a coherent order.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatur, merencanakan atau menggubah sesuatu supaya teratur.
senses.nuances: 由物件的次序扩展到计划、文字和事务的组织。正式主动句通常用 menyusun；susun atur 是表示布局的固定组合。

senses.zh_definition: 仅用于植物名称 susun kelapa：若干种狗牙花属灌木的俗名。
senses.en_definition: In susun kelapa, a vernacular name for several Tabernaemontana shrubs.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama susun kelapa, sejenis pokok renek daripada genus Tabernaemontana.
senses.nuances: 这是词典另列的同形词 susun II，须保留完整植物名；susun 单独使用一般不表示这种植物。该名称可对应多种植物。参见 [DBP：susun II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=susun)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect susun with both neatly stacked objects and strings of verse. This provides a cultural bridge between arranging physical things and arranging words. The family includes penyusun, an arranger or compiler, so the same root can describe someone organizing shelves or compiling a dictionary. This is a semantic connection, not a claim about a documented first use.

etymology.historical_story: One documented bearer of the name is Lahore's Shalimar Gardens, constructed under Shah Jahan in 1641–1642. Its terraces, water features, and pavilions preserve an important Mughal garden tradition shaped by Persian influences. This is the history of a named place, not proof of the name's literal etymology or of a Malay common-noun meaning. [UNESCO World Heritage Centre](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/171/)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 附着于词根后；常见马来西亚读音中，音节末的 k 实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]，ny 表示单一鼻音 [ɲ]。此处通常表达感叹，不宜机械译成“他的”。所给 Jawi 实际对应词根 seronok，未包含 -nya；此处按输入保留。

senses.zh_definition: 真开心；真好玩；真令人愉快。用于感叹某种活动、体验或情境带来的愉悦。
senses.en_definition: So enjoyable, pleasant, or fun; used to express delight at an experience or situation.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk seronok dengan partikel -nya untuk mengungkapkan rasa sangat senang, gembira atau puas terhadap sesuatu pengalaman atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 本释义依据词根义与 -nya 的功能编写，并非独立词条的官方原文。Seronoknya! 可以独立成句，也可用于 Seronoknya dapat bercuti! 等感叹句。根据句法，-nya 也可能有名物化功能；dengan seronoknya 则表示“愉快地”。基础形容词义见 [DBP：seronok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=Seronok)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay speakers can turn a simple description of pleasure into an expressive reaction by adding -nya: seronok becomes seronoknya. This illustrates the productive grammar of an established Malay word rather than a separate borrowing. DBP records related forms for enjoyment and causing pleasure; the deeper historical origin is not established by the supplied evidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=Seronok)

etymology.historical_story: Sharma is associated with Sanskrit śarman, whose recorded meanings include shelter, protection, comfort, and happiness. Monier-Williams also documents its use in traditional Brahman names. That history explains the name's linguistic background, but a modern bearer should be addressed by their chosen name rather than treated as a dictionary definition or a social classification. [Monier-Williams: śarman](https://www.tuninst.net/SED-MW/download-prem/z.htm)

etymology.historical_story: Singhania belongs to the history of Indian family names rather than Malay word formation. Surname references associate it with Singhana in Rajasthan, illustrating how a place of origin can become a family identifier. etymology.historical_story: Sisinya is an ordinary Malay grammatical combination, rather than a separately borrowed word. Its base, sisi, names a side, edge, or viewpoint. Adding the attached pronoun -nya connects that side to someone or something already mentioned. The familiar expression berada di sisinya also allows physical proximity to suggest companionship and emotional support.

etymology.historical_story: Sadiq reflects Arabic ṣādiq, meaning truthful or true. Malay dictionaries record the corresponding adjective as sadik, while Malaysian religious writing also uses sadiq in fajar sadiq, true dawn. The same Arabic form supplies a personal name. These overlapping uses explain why an isolated lowercase token cannot establish whether a passage concerns character, dawn, or a named person.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sadiq 与 sadik 成对记忆：共同抓住真这个核心；fajar sadiq＝真黎明，Sadiq 大写时可能是人名。

etymology.historical_story: Sakti belongs to Malay's Sanskrit vocabulary and reflects śakti, meaning strength or power. In Malay storytelling, the word evokes abilities beyond ordinary life, including enchanted weapons and extraordinary heroes. This literary setting helps distinguish sakti from everyday strength. The Sanskrit connection is documented in [Maxwell's Malay-language manual](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/A_manual_of_the_Malay_language._With_an_introductory_sketch_of_the_Sanskrit_element_in_Malay_%28IA_manualofmalaylan00maxwrich%29.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The name behind Swiss is connected with Schwyz, a founding canton whose name came to represent the wider confederation. The Swiss Federal Archives explains how neighbouring German-speaking regions extended Schwyzer to the confederates generally. In Malay, Swiss is best learned as a whole geographical label, while Switzerland names the country in formal Malaysian usage. [Swiss Federal Archives](https://www.bar.admin.ch/en/the-confederation-before-1798).

etymology.historical_story: Skye is a Scottish island name with a complex history. Gaelic place-name scholarship links an older form, Sgithe, tentatively with an element interpreted as winged or split, referring to projecting headlands. This is an interpretation rather than a settled literal translation. The island name also became a personal name in English. [Island Place-names](https://www.ainmean-aite.scot/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Island-Place-names.pdf), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/skye)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Skye 与英语 sky 同音：想象天空下的苏格兰海岛，记住 Skye 是专名；这个联想不等于词源解释。

senses.nuances: 这是英语 sex 的常见义项，不应把它的全部英语用法直接视为马来语规范用法。have sex 在马来语中通常表达为 melakukan hubungan seks，不能逐词译成 mempunyai seks。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：辨别动物的性别，尤用于雏鸟等不易直接分辨性别的动物。
senses.en_definition: To determine the sex of an animal, especially a young bird.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, menentukan jantina haiwan, khususnya anak burung atau anak ayam.
senses.nuances: 此为英语及物动词，不是马来语动词；标准马来语用 menentukan jantina。参见 [Dictionary.com：sex](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/sex)。

etymology.historical_story: English sex goes back to Latin sexus and is recorded in Middle English. Its meanings include biological classification and sexual activity. Malay uses the adapted spelling seks, while the English spelling can appear in quotations, forms, and mixed-language conversation. Recognizing the spelling difference helps readers identify which language supplies the expression. See [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/sex) and [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seks).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语写 sex，马来语写 seks：把 x 展开成 ks。英文表格里的 sex 常指“性别”，具体意思看上下文。

senses.ms_definition: Dewan perwakilan rakyat yang tertinggi; dewan negara.

senses.ms_definition: Majlis mahasiswa; penggunaan bahasa Indonesia.

etymology.historical_story: Senat belongs to an international family of institutional names ultimately connected with Latin senatus, an assembly of elders, from senex, meaning an older man. The historical image is collective deliberation. Malay uses the whole borrowed word for parliamentary and university bodies; its opening se- is not a productive Malay prefix. [Treccani: senato](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/senato/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senat 与英语 senate 成对记：一群成员围桌审议。记整词，不拆成 se- + nat。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身无词缀。ber- + sauh → bersauh，词根不变；meN- + sauh → menyauh，词首 s 被鼻音 /ɲ/ 替代。

senses.zh_definition: 锚：从船上放入水中、用于抓住水底并防止船只漂移的重型器具。
senses.en_definition: A heavy device lowered from a vessel to grip the bottom and prevent drifting; an anchor.
senses.ms_definition: Alat berat yang berkait, dilabuhkan ke dalam air supaya perahu atau kapal tidak hanyut; jangkar.
senses.nuances: 指实体船锚。melabuhkan sauh 表示下锚；mengangkat sauh 或 membongkar sauh 表示起锚。membuang sauh 在航海搭配中也表示下锚，并非丢弃锚具。bersauh 的停泊义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=bersauh)。

etymology.historical_story: Sauh belongs to an old Austronesian maritime vocabulary. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary connects Malay sauh with reconstructed Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *sauq₂, meaning anchor, and records related forms in Iban and Ngaju Dayak. Some documented anchors were wooden implements weighted with stone, a reminder that the word's history extends beyond modern metal ship equipment. Source: [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30632).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船员喊“收——”，把锚收上船：mengangkat sauh。sauh 是锚，放下它就能稳住船。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 susah 不变，-nya 读 /ɲa/，与前面的 h 分属不同音节。-nya 可起强调或名词化作用，不应一律译成“他的”。数据包的 سوسه 是词根拼写，整词补写为 سوسهڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 真难啊；多么费劲或困苦。以感叹语气突出事情难做、生活艰难或内心难受。
senses.en_definition: How difficult, troublesome, or distressing; expressing an emphatic reaction to difficulty or hardship.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan yang menegaskan bahawa sesuatu sangat sukar, membebankan atau menimbulkan rasa tidak senang.
senses.nuances: 此用法中 -nya 起强调作用，常见于 Susahnya hendak… 或 Susahnya hidup…。具体可指任务困难、物质困苦或情绪上的难受；不能脱离语境统一译为“贫穷”。词根义参见 [DBP 的 susah 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=susah)；-nya 的强调及名词化功能参见 [DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penulisan+nya)。

collocations.en: how hard it is to choose

senses.zh_definition: 困难、艰辛或难受的情形；某件事情的困难之处。
senses.en_definition: The difficulty, hardship, or distress involved in a situation or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan sukar atau kepayahan yang berkaitan dengan sesuatu perkara, pengalaman atau kehidupan.
senses.nuances: 此用法中 -nya 可使 susah 名词化，如 memahami susahnya…“理解……的艰辛”。根据上下文可与特定人物或事物相关，但 -nya 并不自动表示男性所有者。较正式的行政文字常选用 kesukaran 或 kesusahan。词根意义依据 [DBP 的 susah 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=susah)。

collocations.en: to understand the hardship of earning a living

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于表达自己的困扰或体谅他人艰辛。直接对别人说 Susahnya nak ajar awak!“教你真费劲”容易显得责备或羞辱，宜改为说明具体不明白的部分。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于表达自己的困扰或体谅他人艰辛。直接对别人说 Susahnya nak ajar awak!“教你真费劲”容易显得责备或羞辱，宜改为说明具体不明白的部分。

etymology.historical_story: Susah has a long documented presence in Malay: Crawfurd's 1852 dictionary records meanings spanning difficulty, hardship, worry and sorrow. Modern susahnya combines that established root with -nya. Depending on sentence structure and intonation, the result can name a difficulty or exclaim over it, linking practical obstacles with the speaker's emotional response. [Historical source](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: susah 是“难”，加上强调的 -nya，就像忍不住叹一声“真难啊”；放进理解、描述等结构里，则可表示“困难之处”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语整词或语码转换成分记忆，没有马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为英语读音；规范马来语对应词是 stik，读 /stik/，Jawi 为 ستيک。输入包未给 steak 的 Jawi，故保留 null，不将 stik 的拼写冒充为已核定的 steak 拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 供煎、烤等烹调的厚肉片，未加限定时通常指牛排肉。
senses.en_definition: A thick slice of meat, usually beef, prepared or intended for frying or grilling.
senses.ms_definition: Potongan daging yang tebal untuk dimasak, misalnya dengan memanggang atau menggorengnya; disebut stik dalam bahasa Melayu baku.
senses.nuances: steak 是英语拼写，马来西亚菜单和口语中常见；规范马来语采用 stik。附有限定词时也可指其他肉类或鱼类的厚切片。status 按请求保留为 official，不表示英语拼写已取代规范词形 stik。[DBP：stik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=stik)。

senses.zh_definition: 将厚肉片煎熟或烤熟后制成的排餐，通常指牛排，可配酱汁和配菜。
senses.en_definition: A dish of fried or grilled steak, often served with sauce and accompaniments.
senses.ms_definition: Hidangan daripada potongan daging tebal yang dimasak dan boleh disajikan bersama sos serta makanan iringan.
senses.nuances: 点餐时通常指整份菜，而非仅指生肉。以下为常见马来语与英语混用的菜单表达；正式马来语可写 stik dengan sos lada hitam 或 stik panggang。

etymology.historical_story: English steak came through Middle English from Old Norse steik, with historical connections to roasting meat on a stake. In Malaysian usage, the English spelling can appear alongside the standardized Malay form stik. This pairing shows how an imported food term can retain one spelling on menus while acquiring another in Malay dictionaries. [Merriam-Webster: steak](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/steak); [DBP: stik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=stik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 steak 读 /steɪk/，规范马来语写 stik；把菜单上的 steak 与马来语词典里的 stik 配对记忆。

morphology.formula: susah + -kan → susahkan；完整主动形式：meN- + susah + -kan → menyusahkan
morphology.pattern_note: -kan 表示使某人陷入困难或忧虑；susahkan 可见于祈使句、特定被动结构及省略 meN- 的口语主动句。音节按构词推定；输入包的 سوسه 是词根写法，完整词补写为 سوسهکن。

word_family.gloss: 使为难；给人添麻烦；使担忧

senses.zh_definition: 使人为难、增加他人的负担或给人添麻烦。
senses.en_definition: To trouble, inconvenience, or burden someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan seseorang susah atau membebankannya dengan kesukaran.
senses.nuances: Jangan susahkan orang lain 是自然的禁止式，不应把所有不带 meN- 的用法都判为错误。普通正式主动陈述通常用 menyusahkan，例如 Prosedur itu menyusahkan pengguna。释义据 [DBP：menyusahkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=83916&keyword=menyusahkan)改写；祈使式亦见 [YADIM 用例](https://www.yadim.com.my/v2/tauliah-mudahkan-jangan-payahkan/)。

collocations.en: don't put yourself to any trouble

senses.zh_definition: 使人忧虑、难过或心烦；在特定句式中表示为某事操心。
senses.en_definition: To cause worry or distress; in some constructions, to worry about something.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang berasa risau atau sedih; dalam binaan tertentu, merisaukan sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 须根据句式区分“使某人担忧”和“为某事担忧”。例如 Perkara itu saya susahkan 表示“那件事是我所担忧的”，并非“我让那件事变困难”。正式表达可用 risaukan 或 bimbangkan，使意思更清楚。参见 [DBP 的忧虑义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=83916&keyword=menyusahkan)。

etymology.historical_story: The everyday adjective susah covers difficulty and an uneasy state of mind. Adding -kan turns those states into something caused or experienced through an action. Its social force is especially clear in jangan susahkan diri: a speaker acknowledges another person's effort while gently declining help. This account explains the formation without assigning an unverified ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: susah＝难、烦；-kan＝使：susahkan orang＝让别人为难、给别人添麻烦。

senses.zh_definition: 女王；王后。属于王室或文学语汇，具体身份须结合称号与上下文判断。

senses.ms_definition: Raja perempuan atau permaisuri; rani.
senses.nuances: 这是与织造术语同形的另一词条。不能一律限定为拥有统治权的女王；ibu suri 特指君主的母亲。

senses.zh_definition: 妻子；在固定表达 suri rumah、suri rumah tangga 中，现代通常指以料理家庭为主要职责的家庭主妇。
senses.en_definition: A wife; in suri rumah or suri rumah tangga, a housewife or female homemaker.
senses.ms_definition: Isteri; dalam ungkapan suri rumah atau suri rumah tangga, lazimnya wanita yang mengurus rumah tangga sebagai kegiatan utama.
senses.nuances: 现代日常用法以完整表达 suri rumah 最常见；单独用 suri 泛指普通妻子较有文学色彩。不能因为某人已婚便自动称她为 suri rumah。

senses.zh_definition: 仅见于固定表达 mati suri：看似死亡，实际并未死亡。
senses.en_definition: In mati suri: apparently dead but not actually dead.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan mati suri, kelihatan seperti sudah mati walaupun sebenarnya belum mati.
senses.nuances: 这是固定表达中的限定意义，不宜把 suri 单独当作通用的“假”或“昏迷”。mati suri 也不应随意等同于某一种明确的医学诊断。

etymology.historical_story: Suri brings several distinct dictionary histories together under one spelling: a weaving implement, royal and domestic titles, and restricted traditional expressions. These are separately recorded homonyms, so the loom component should not be explained as a metaphorical queen. Recognising the surrounding words is essential: gigi suri, ibu suri and mati suri lead to different meanings. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=suri)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住三个画面：织机里的 suri 是“筘”，王宫里的 suri 是“王后”，suri rumah 是“家庭主妇”；看搭配选意思。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不作马来语词缀拆分；sh 表示 /ʃ/。英语读音为单音节，但原包的 syllables 缺失值保留。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：关闭；使门、窗等合上，或自行合上。
senses.en_definition: To close something, or to become closed.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, menutup sesuatu atau menjadi tertutup.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词。出现在马来语聊天中时可构成语码转换；标准马来语通常按句法使用 tutup、menutup 或 tertutup。不能因为 DBP 英马词典收录了英语词头，就视为正式马来语词。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：关着的；闭合的；商店等处于关闭状态的。
senses.en_definition: Closed; not open.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, tertutup atau tidak dibuka untuk urusan.
senses.nuances: 作形容词时描述状态；马来语对应词依对象而变，如 pintu tertutup、mata terpejam、kedai ditutup。所列搭配为标准马来语对应表达。

etymology.historical_story: Shut belongs to English rather than to the Malay affix system. DBP includes it in its English–Malay dictionary and supplies Malay equivalents such as tertutup and ditutup. That bilingual treatment helps explain its meaning, but does not establish it as a Malay loanword. Mixed-language examples here illustrate code-switching, not an official Malay headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 shut，联想把门关上；标准马来语动作词记 tutup，关闭状态记 tertutup。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着书写的强调小品词，不改变 sahaja 的词干；j 表示 /dʒ/。suffix 为本数据格式的位置归类，不意味着 -lah 是派生词缀。输入 jawi 为词根拼写，按要求保留，不代表已提供完整形式的拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 强调范围或数量的限制，表示“就只有……”“仅此而已”；-lah 加强确认或收束语气。
senses.en_definition: Emphasizes restriction to a particular person, thing, amount, or extent: only this, just that, or nothing more.
senses.ms_definition: Menegaskan batas pada orang, benda, jumlah atau perkara tertentu, dengan maksud hanya itu atau tidak lebih daripada itu.
senses.nuances: 这是 sahaja 的限制功能加上 -lah；-lah 的效果随语调而变，不能机械译成“啦”。本条为依据 DBP 词根释义所作的组合释义，并非独立词条的逐字引文。参见 [DBP PRPM：sahaja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=sahaja)。

collocations.zh: 就只有那些／就这样而已

senses.zh_definition: 置于动作或建议之后，表示“就……吧”“干脆……好了”，可传达鼓励、许可、务实选择或无奈接受。
senses.en_definition: Following an action, conveys a suggestion, permission, or acceptance: just do it, go ahead, or settle for it.
senses.ms_definition: Digunakan selepas ungkapan perbuatan untuk memberikan anjuran, keizinan atau penerimaan terhadap sesuatu pilihan.
senses.nuances: Ambil sahajalah 可以是友善许可，也可能带不耐烦；情绪由上下文与语调决定。熟人聊天常将 sahaja 缩为 saja、aje 或 je。该组合不应一律理解为“没有其他选择”。

senses.zh_definition: 与疑问或不定表达结合，表示接受任意合适的对象或人选，相当于“什么都行”“谁都可以”。
senses.en_definition: With an interrogative or indefinite expression, indicates acceptance of any suitable thing, person, or option.
senses.ms_definition: Apabila bergabung dengan ungkapan tanya atau tak tentu, menyatakan bahawa mana-mana pilihan yang sesuai boleh diterima.
senses.nuances: Apa-apa sahajalah 通常表示“什么都行”，不一定表示随便或敷衍。选择范围仍受当前情境限制。这里只列该组合的常见现代功能，不把词根 sahaja 的所有古典义自动移植过来。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -lah 不自动保证礼貌。对上司、客户或陌生人提出建议时，可加 sila、boleh 或合适称谓；简短的 Guna sahajalah 在某些语调下可能显得敷衍。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合熟人间许可、安慰、提出务实方案或结束说明。正式书面报告通常直接使用 sahaja；口头汇报中 sahajalah 可以自然地收束内容。

etymology.historical_story: Sahajalah illustrates how Malay builds conversational meaning from small grammatical elements. DBP records sahaja with functions including restriction, unrestricted choice, and suggestion. Adding -lah gives the expression emphasis whose interpersonal effect depends on context and intonation. In everyday conversation, shorter forms such as je lah convey related meanings. This account explains the modern construction without assigning an unsupported date to its origin. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=sahaja).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sahaja＝“只是／就”，加 -lah 后按语境记成“就这个吧”或“就做吧”；先看它前面是对象还是动作。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 可表示一队，也可表示同一队；词首 p 保留，没有鼻音替换。pasukan 是本条直接构词基础，DBP 另将其列于 pasuk 词族。headword.jawi 按数据包保留，但 ڤاسوقن 只对应 pasukan，完整 sepasukan 应写作 سڤاسوقن。

senses.zh_definition: 一队、一组共同执行任务或参加活动的人。
senses.en_definition: A team, squad, or group of people acting together.
senses.ms_definition: Satu kumpulan orang yang menjalankan tugas atau kegiatan bersama.
senses.nuances: 严格语法上，se- 在此表达数量一；因本输出没有数词选项，按整体指称的一队人归入 noun。常用于警察、军人、救援人员和运动员，不指定人数。pasukan 的集合义见 [DBP 词条](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pasukan)。

senses.zh_definition: 属于同一支队伍的；同队的。
senses.en_definition: Belonging to the same team.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam pasukan yang sama.
senses.nuances: 此处 se- 表示相同，而非数量一。rakan sepasukan 指队友；kami sepasukan 表示我们在同一队。强调合作做事的方式时，通常使用 secara berpasukan。

senses.zh_definition: 一群共同活动的动物。
senses.en_definition: A herd or group of animals.
senses.ms_definition: Satu kawanan atau kumpulan binatang.
senses.nuances: 承接 pasukan 的动物集合义；现代一般表达中，sekawan gajah、sekumpulan gajah 等通常更自然。此义不应误解为动物组成了有组织的工作队。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record pasukan for groups of people and animals, with military and sporting applications among its familiar uses. Adding se- creates two useful perspectives: one whole team, or membership of the same team. This explains why sepasukan penyelamat counts a group, while rakan sepasukan describes the relationship between its members.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 把人圈进一个 pasukan：数人数群体时是“一队”，说彼此关系时是“同队”。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名，整词记忆，不拆为马来语词缀。此处采用常见的 /svɛn/ 读法，一个音节；具体读音随语言和本人习惯而异。正常书写用 Sven。

etymology.historical_story: Sven descends from Old Norse Sveinn, associated with the word for a young man. Related Scandinavian name forms include Svein and Svend, while Sven is a familiar Swedish form. These are historical name relatives, rather than Malay derivatives; in a Malay conversation, Sven simply identifies the person who bears that name. [Name history](https://snl.no/Sven_-_mannsnamn)

word_family.gloss: 广播电视播送；传播活动

senses.zh_definition: 通过电视、电台或网络平台播出节目、影像或声音。
senses.en_definition: To broadcast or transmit a programme, recording, or audiovisual content.
senses.ms_definition: Memancarkan atau menyampaikan rancangan, rakaman, gambar atau suara melalui radio, televisyen atau platform dalam talian.
senses.nuances: 侧重把内容传送给受众；siarkan 适用于指令，如 sila siarkan，也可见于节目预告中的 kami siarkan。现场直播通常说 siarkan secara langsung。

senses.zh_definition: 把消息、公告、文章或其他资料刊登、发布，使公众知悉。
senses.en_definition: To publish or make information publicly available.
senses.ms_definition: Menerbitkan atau menyebarkan berita, pengumuman, tulisan atau maklumat untuk pengetahuan orang ramai.
senses.nuances: 不局限于广播媒体，也用于报刊、网站和社交平台。发布私人照片、个人资料或未经核实的消息时，须考虑当事人同意与内容准确性。

etymology.historical_story: Siarkan is built from siar and the productive Malay suffix -kan. Its modern uses connect several generations of public communication: a newspaper publishes an announcement, a radio station broadcasts a programme, and a club posts a notice online. The communication medium changes, while the central idea remains making content available to an audience.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siar 想成“向外传播”，加上 -kan 就是“把内容传播出去”：siarkan berita，把新闻发布出去。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借用，不拆成马来语词缀。音标列英语读音；音节切分为补充信息。输入未提供 Jawi，保留 null；不据此虚构官方拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 公共卫生监测中选定的监测单位、设施或地点，用于持续收集资料并提示疾病变化。
senses.en_definition: A selected reporting unit or site used to monitor disease patterns and provide warning signals.
senses.ms_definition: Unit atau lokasi terpilih yang mengumpulkan data secara berterusan bagi memantau pola penyakit dan mengesan perubahan.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚卫生部门确有此专业用法。常在 klinik sentinel 等词组中作名词修饰语；并不表示所有诊所都会参与，也不自动表示样本具有统计代表性。此处为专业用法概括。[马来西亚卫生部：监测单位说明](https://www.moh.gov.my/moh/attachments/7161.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 英语原义及英语夹用语境中的哨兵、警戒人员。
senses.en_definition: In English or English-influenced usage, a guard stationed to keep watch.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris, pengawal yang ditempatkan untuk berkawal dan memberikan amaran.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义说明，不宜直接视为普通马来语中 pengawal 的常用替代词。一般马来语叙述宜使用 pengawal 或 pengawal yang bertugas。[英语词源与原义](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sentinel)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合公共卫生报告与相关工作交流。不要把成为 sentinel 单位说成发生疫情的证明，也不要默认普通听众了解该术语。

etymology.historical_story: English sentinel came through French sentinelle from Italian sentinella, a word for a guard; its deeper origin is uncertain. In Malaysian health usage, the idea of keeping watch helps explain selected clinics and reporting sites that monitor disease patterns. This connection is a useful semantic explanation, rather than a documented date or route of borrowing into Malay. [词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sentinel), [马来西亚卫生部用例](https://www.moh.gov.my/moh/attachments/7161.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 SEN-ti-nel 时想象哨兵竖起耳朵：人站岗叫 sentinel，诊所替社区监测疾病就是 klinik sentinel。

etymology.historical_story: Sullivan is an English rendering of the Irish surname Ó Súileabháin, which identifies descent from a person named Súileabhán. O'Sullivan preserves the ancestral marker more visibly. This history belongs to Irish naming traditions: when the surname appears in Malay writing, it identifies its bearer rather than acquiring a new Malay lexical meaning. [Name reference](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/sullivan).

etymology.historical_story: One established source of Stella is the Latin word for star. Philip Sidney used it for the beloved in Astrophel and Stella, giving the name a memorable literary association. A separate Greek naming tradition uses Stella as a diminutive of Styliani, so the spelling alone cannot establish every bearer's name history. [Latin tradition](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stella-1), [Greek tradition](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stella-2).

etymology.historical_story: Sebutan is formed transparently from sebut, meaning to say or mention, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings preserve several perspectives on speech: what is mentioned, how words sound, and what people repeatedly discuss. The same noun also names a designation and a mathematical term, showing how one familiar form serves several specialized contexts. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sebutan)

etymology.historical_story: Sukarnya illustrates a continuing Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separately established ancient word. The adjective sukar combines with -nya to emphasize difficulty or present it as a topic. DBP records additional older meanings of sukar involving poverty, serious illness and scarcity, but these should not automatically become separate everyday meanings of sukarnya. [DBP: sukar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sukar)；[DBP: -nya](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sukar＝难；句首加上感叹语调：“Sukarnya!”＝“真难啊！”看到后面接一件事，则想到“这件事有多难”。

etymology.historical_story: Shinigami is the romanized Japanese word written 死神, combining a form associated with dying and kami, meaning a deity or spirit. Japanese dictionaries document the term in an early eighteenth-century puppet play. It also became the title of a rakugo story, showing that its cultural history extends beyond modern animation. [Japanese dictionaries: 死神](https://kotobank.jp/word/死神-713060)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住日语原字 死神：shini 联系“死亡”，gami 联系 kami“神灵”；这是日语词源提示，不是马来语构词拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的附着式人称代词，此处表示领属；严格说属于后附着语素，而非派生后缀。与 suami 连写，词根不变。原数据包的 سوامي 是 suami 的拼写；完整形式按构成写作 سواميمو。音节及音标按完整形式补出。[DBP 人称代词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)

senses.ms_definition: Suami kamu, iaitu lelaki yang menjadi pasangan kamu dalam perkahwinan.
senses.nuances: 这是 suami 与领属附着代词 -mu 的规则组合，并非独立派生词。马来语本身不以 -mu 标记听话人的性别。释义依词根定义及语法合成，并非冒称 DBP 对完整形式另有独立释文。-mu 常见于亲密表达、书信和文学；马来西亚日常交谈常用 suami awak，正式服务场景常用 suami puan。[DBP 词根与词族资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=suami+isteri)

etymology.historical_story: Suami belongs to the Sanskrit layer of Malay vocabulary. Research on historical inscriptions relates Sanskrit swami to modern Malay suami, illustrating how an older borrowed word became ordinary family vocabulary. Suamimu adds the Malay possessive clitic -mu to that established noun. Its present meaning follows directly from this combination: your husband. [Inscription study](https://ejbl.uis.edu.my/index.php/e-jbl/article/download/47/16)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suami＝丈夫，-mu＝你的；把“你的”贴在丈夫后面：suami-mu → suamimu。

etymology.historical_story: Subber belongs to the informal vocabulary of online subtitling communities. Its English formation connects sub, used for subtitle or subtitling, with the person-forming ending -er. Viki explicitly calls subtitle contributors subbers, showing how a specialist community can turn a short working label into a recognizable identity for its members. senses.zh_definition: 《Kamus Dewan》所指的一种牛，传统释义描述为黑色、外形似普通家牛，学名标作 Bos indicus，即瘤牛。
senses.en_definition: A kind of cattle identified in Kamus Dewan as Bos indicus and traditionally described there as black.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis binatang yang rupanya seperti lembu dan berwarna hitam, Bos indicus.
senses.nuances: 这是词典的传统动物释义；其中的颜色描述不应视为所有瘤牛的科学鉴别标准。一般马来西亚生活语境谈牛多用 lembu。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=sapi)

senses.zh_definition: 牛；家牛的通称，主要用于印度尼西亚语及受其影响的表达。
senses.en_definition: A cow or cattle collectively, especially in Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Lembu; penggunaan ini ditandai sebagai bahasa Indonesia dalam Kamus Dewan.
senses.nuances: DBP 的 Id 标签表示印度尼西亚语用法。sapi 不限定雌性，不能因英语 cow 的常见译法而把它理解成专指母牛。马来西亚正式畜牧、食品及采购文本一般使用 lembu、daging lembu 和 susu lembu。

senses.zh_definition: 植物名的一部分：pohon sapi，指词典学名标作 Otophora spectabilis 的一种小乔木。
senses.en_definition: In pohon sapi, a small tree identified in the dictionary as Otophora spectabilis.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama pohon sapi, sejenis tumbuhan berupa pokok kecil, Otophora spectabilis.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 单列的同形词 sapi II，仅见于植物名称，不能套用牛的释义。以下是植物语境中的名称组合，并非日常高频搭配；学名沿用词典记录。[DBP 同形词记录](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=sapi)

etymology.historical_story: Sapi carries a cultural story in the proverb lembu punya susu, sapi dapat nama: one animal supplies the milk while another receives recognition. The image turns cattle into a memorable lesson about misplaced credit. Kamus Dewan also distinguishes a specific cattle sense from the broader Indonesian meaning. These records establish usage, but do not establish the word's earliest origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=sapi)

senses.zh_definition: 与情感有关或以情感为特征的；尤指因私人经历、人物关系或回忆而具有感情意义的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to or characterized by feeling, especially personal attachment or memories.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan atau dicirikan oleh sentimen.
senses.nuances: nilai sentimental 指个人赋予物品或地方的情感价值，不等于市场价值，也不必涉及爱情。该释义据《Kamus Dewan》，情感价值搭配亦见 DBP 英马词典。[DBP 马来语释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sentimental) [搭配记录](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pen)

senses.zh_definition: 感情细腻、浪漫或容易动情的；也形容歌曲、故事等温柔感人、能触动情绪。
senses.en_definition: Tender, romantic, or easily moved emotionally; also, evoking tender feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Bersifat lembut, romantis, atau mudah terusik perasaan; bagi karya, menyentuh perasaan atau mengharukan.
senses.nuances: 形容歌曲可表示抒情、柔情或感人，未必是悲伤；形容人则可能是温和描述，也可能暗含过于感情用事的评价。不能一律译成贬义的“矫情”。两个用法分别见《Kamus Dewan》及《Kamus Pelajar》。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sentimental)

etymology.historical_story: English sentimental is recorded from the eighteenth century, formed from sentiment and the adjective ending -al. Its history includes both sympathetic feeling and criticism of excessive tenderness. Malay dictionaries likewise allow emotional attachment, romantic softness, and susceptibility to feeling. This parallel helps explain the word's range, although the packet does not document its precise borrowing date or transmission route into Malay. [English history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sentiment) [Malay meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sentimental)

etymology.historical_story: Sargen is documented in regional Singlish vocabulary as a colloquial rendering of English sergeant. etymology.historical_story: Sekelas illustrates how a short Malay prefix builds social relationships into a word. Adding se- to kelas expresses sharing a class, just as classroom life turns separate pupils into rakan sekelas. Because kelas also names categories and levels, the same construction extends naturally to comparable products or performers. This is a transparent formation within Malay. [DBP records](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekelas).

etymology.historical_story: Malay stok corresponds to English stock, but its dictionary meanings reach beyond shop shelves. Alongside merchandise and stored supplies, the word also denotes shares and the plant base used in grafting. etymology.historical_story: The key to setanding is tanding, a Malay noun for a match or equal. The prefix se- builds the idea of being on the same level. Related forms describe competing, matching an opponent, and competitions. This family makes comparison easy to remember: the same vocabulary connects an actual contest with an assessment of comparable quality. etymology.historical_story: Shaun is an English spelling variant of Sean, from Irish Seán, a form of John. The name belongs to a much wider family transmitted through French, Latin and Greek from Hebrew. Its traditional meaning concerns divine graciousness, but ordinary speakers use Shaun to identify a person, rather than to express that historical meaning. [Etymonline：Sean](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Sean)

senses.zh_definition: 天启圣典；印度教传统中被视为圣哲所闻受、具有启示权威的经典类别，核心为吠陀文献。
senses.en_definition: The category of Hindu scripture regarded as revealed or heard by ancient seers, principally the Vedic corpus.
senses.ms_definition: Golongan kitab suci Hindu yang dianggap diterima oleh para resi melalui pendengaran atau wahyu, terutama korpus Veda.
senses.nuances: 这是依据宗教资料编写的马来语释义，并非 DBP 官方释文。源语字面义为“所听闻者”；与 smriti 的“所忆持者”相对。经典范围随传统而异，不能把所有印度教经典都归入 shruti。以下搭配是说明性专业用语，未据马来语语料统计其频率。

senses.zh_definition: 印度古典音乐理论中的微分音程单位；传统理论常以一个八度含二十二个 shruti 来描述音高关系。
senses.en_definition: A microtonal interval in Indian classical music theory, traditionally discussed within a system of twenty-two divisions of the octave.
senses.ms_definition: Unit selang nada halus dalam teori muzik klasik India, yang secara tradisional dihuraikan melalui pembahagian oktaf kepada dua puluh dua shruti.
senses.nuances: 这是专业音乐义，与宗教经典义须分开理解。二十二个单位不意味着二十二平均律，也不宜把每个 shruti 都说成大小固定的相同音程。本释义为编辑综合，非已核实的 DBP 官方释文；搭配为说明性专业用语。

messages.en: I came across the word shruti in this book. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Anjali (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau bab Veda tu, shruti merujuk kitab yang dianggap wahyu. Aku nak semak penerangan dia dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Dalam bab tentang Veda itu, shruti merujuk kepada kitab yang dianggap sebagai wahyu. Saya mahu menyemak penjelasannya terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 在讲吠陀的那一章里，shruti 指被视为天启的经典。我想先核对一下书里的解释。
messages.en: In that chapter on the Vedas, shruti means scripture regarded as revealed. Let me check the explanation first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论宗教义时用“在该传统中被视为天启”等尊重且准确的表述。马来西亚印度裔群体的宗教与语言背景多样，不应假定每个人都熟悉或认同同一经典分类。

etymology.historical_story: Shruti represents Sanskrit śruti, meaning hearing or that which is heard. In Hindu traditions, the term connects sacred authority with teachings received and transmitted through listening. In Indian music theory, it also names fine pitch distinctions. The shared idea is attentive hearing, but the religious and musical meanings developed into distinct technical uses.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 shruti 连到“听”：宗教里是圣哲所闻受的经典，音乐里是细听才能辨出的音程；这是语义联想，不是汉语谐音词源。

senses.zh_definition: 空军中队；按《Kamus Dewan》的概括，通常由十至十八架飞机组成。
senses.en_definition: An air-force squadron, described by Kamus Dewan as comprising ten to eighteen aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Formasi udara tentera yang menurut huraian Kamus Dewan merangkumi antara sepuluh dengan lapan belas pesawat.
senses.nuances: 飞机数量是词典概括；实际编制须看具体军队及单位。三项马来语释义均为依据词典编写的概括。[DBP：skuadron](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=skuadron)。

senses.zh_definition: 陆军中队，常见于装甲或骑兵编制；词典概括为团下辖约百人的单位，通常分成三个分队。
senses.en_definition: An army squadron within a regiment, described as approximately one hundred personnel, usually organized into three troops.
senses.ms_definition: Subunit rejimen tentera darat dengan sekitar seratus anggota, lazimnya tersusun dalam tiga trup.
senses.nuances: 不是空军专用词。trup 指其下属分队；具体编制依军种与单位而异。

senses.zh_definition: 海军舰艇中队；由两艘或以上同类型舰艇组成的单位。
senses.en_definition: A naval squadron comprising two or more vessels of the same type.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan tentera laut yang menghimpunkan sekurang-kurangnya dua kapal daripada jenis yang sama.
senses.nuances: 范围通常小于整支舰队 armada；中文具体译名应配合有关海军的编制。

etymology.historical_story: Skuadron corresponds to English squadron, whose history reaches back to Italian squadrone and squadra, associated with soldiers arranged in a square. The term subsequently became familiar in naval and air-force organization. Its older land-force connection explains why a skuadron in Malay can comprise soldiers or ships as well as military aircraft. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/squadron)、[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=skuadron)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 skua，联想 squad 的队伍感；再记三种画面：飞机、装甲兵、舰艇，都可能组成 skuadron。

etymology.historical_story: Sedutan is formed transparently from sedut with the noun suffix -an. Dictionaries place physical drawing-in alongside the selection of a short passage or recording. A useful way to understand the connection is to imagine taking a small portion from a larger whole. This is a semantic explanation, not a documented chronology of when the media sense first appeared.

senses.zh_definition: 排列；次序；各组成部分经过安排后形成的顺序、位置或结构。

senses.nuances: 可指名单顺序、座位布局、句子结构及音乐编排等。与 penyusunan 相比，susunan 主要强调形成的排列或结构，penyusunan 主要强调编排过程。

etymology.historical_story: Susunan combines susun with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. Comparative evidence connects susun with a wider Austronesian vocabulary of layers, rows, and stacking. This physical image helps explain the modern range: bricks form a stack, names form an ordered list, and words form a sentence structure. Each has elements placed in relation to others. [Comparative reference](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_s.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: susun 是“排起来”，加 -an 看“排出来的样子”：一叠书、一个名单、一种语序，都是 susunan。

etymology.historical_story: Sofia belongs to the international family of names derived from Greek sophia, meaning wisdom. Related spellings include Sophia and Sophie, reflecting transmission across languages. Malay speakers use Sofia as a complete personal name, without translating its historical meaning. The same spelling also denotes Bulgaria's capital, a separate referent that context identifies. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sophia) [City reference](https://www.gov.bg/en/About-Bulgaria/GENERAL-INFORMATION/General-information)

senses.nuances: sudi 表示意愿，-kah 构成疑问；整个词不是单独的小品词。这里按 PRPM 同义词栏的 kata kerja 归类。它询问“愿不愿意”，不只是“能不能”。释义为依据词根及语法功能的综合表述，非独立词条原文。[参见 sudi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudi) 及 [kah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kah)。

collocations.en: would you be willing to help
would you be willing to attend

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于邀请、请求帮助及较郑重的个人提议。熟人日常聊天更常说 sudi tak 或 boleh tolong；sudikah 可能显得郑重或带俏皮感。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式邀请中可搭配 tuan、puan 或合适职衔，表达对对方意愿的尊重；礼貌询问后仍应允许对方拒绝。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于邀请、请求帮助及较郑重的个人提议。熟人日常聊天更常说 sudi tak 或 boleh tolong；sudikah 可能显得郑重或带俏皮感。

etymology.historical_story: Sudikah is transparently formed within Malay from sudi and the interrogative particle -kah. Its cultural interest lies in invitation etiquette: the speaker asks about another person's willingness, giving the request a courteous shape. The formation is grammatical rather than a separate historical borrowing; its present meaning follows directly from the base and the question particle. [Sources: sudi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudi), [kah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sudi＝愿意；-kah＝问号：sudikah＝“您可愿意？”

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借入；马来语读作单音节 /sket/，拼写中的 r 不单独发音。

senses.zh_definition: 裙子；系于腰部、向下覆盖身体且不分裤腿的下装，长短不一，通常指西式女裙。
senses.en_definition: A garment fastened at the waist and hanging over the legs without separate leg sections, typically worn by women.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pakaian luar perempuan cara Barat yang dilekatkan di pinggang dan mempunyai labuh yang berbeza-beza; rok.
senses.nuances: 通常指半身裙；连衣裙一般称 gaun。长裙不宜一律译为 maxi skirt，须看具体长度与款式。[DBP：skirt](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=skirt)

etymology.historical_story: Borrowed from English, skirt keeps its foreign spelling while its Malay pronunciation is adapted to sket. Its place in Malay vocabulary illustrates how an imported clothing term can become an ordinary local noun. The established derivative berskirt then gives it a Malay grammatical life: it means to wear a skirt.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 拼写认英语 skirt，发音记 sket；再加 ber-，berskirt 就是“穿着裙子”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆分为马来语词缀；首音节的 e 为 é /e/。DBP 收录的派生形式 mensensasikan 保留词首 s。

word_family.gloss: 将某事炒作成轰动话题

senses.zh_definition: 引起公众轰动、强烈兴趣或广泛议论的事件、情况或事物。
senses.en_definition: An event, situation, or phenomenon that causes widespread excitement or intense public interest.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu kejadian atau keadaan yang menggemparkan atau membangkitkan perasaan serta menarik perhatian ramai.
senses.nuances: 可指正面的走红，也可指争议性事件；mencari sensasi 常带有刻意博取关注的贬义。释义依据 [DBP：sensasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sensasi)。

collocations.zh: 刻意制造话题以博取关注
collocations.en: seek publicity by causing a stir

senses.zh_definition: 能引起轰动、强烈情绪或公众好奇的；耸动的。
senses.en_definition: Causing a stir or arousing strong emotion, curiosity, or public interest.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan kegemparan, menarik perhatian atau membangkitkan perasaan dan rasa ingin tahu.
senses.nuances: 常置于名词后修饰新闻、故事或议题；描述报道时可暗示内容耸动，但本身不等于虚假。依据 [DBP：sensasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sensasi)。
