etymology.historical_story: Historical scholarship connects sendi with Sanskrit sandhi, meaning a junction or joint. The connection preserves a concrete anatomical image: separate bones meeting at one point. Modern DBP entries also record mechanical connections, post-supporting stones, and figurative foundations. These meanings offer a useful image of connection and support, although that teaching link does not establish one historical pathway for every sense. [Historical linguistic study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sendi+II+1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sendi 联想“身体的连接点”：膝盖是骨与骨的连接处；再联想到门的连接处和房柱的支承点。

headword.orthography_note: 保留输入包的音节与爪夷文字段；所给爪夷文对应词根 siap，未包含 -lah。siaplah 是规范连写的附着形式，不表示它具有独立的 DBP 词目。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是后附强调小品词，不是派生词缀；此处 suffix 仅表示其附着位置。词根不变，词尾 /p/ 通常不爆破。

senses.zh_definition: 已经完成或准备妥当；-lah 突出这一结果，具体语气随上下文变化。
senses.en_definition: Finished or ready, with emphasis supplied by the enclitic -lah.
senses.ms_definition: Sudah selesai atau sudah tersedia untuk digunakan, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 可表示肯定、宽慰或对结果的强调。-lah 本身不表示过去时，也不能一律译成“了”。词根释义依据 [DBP：siap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=siap)；小品词功能参见 [DBP：信息突出机制](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2023/03/13/7523/)。马来文释义为据来源整理的释义，并非逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 准备好吧；在指令中催促或要求对方做好准备。
senses.en_definition: Get ready; used as an emphatic or encouraging instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Bersedialah untuk melakukan atau menghadapi sesuatu, sebagai arahan atau gesaan.
senses.nuances: 这是命令语境中的用法，不等于陈述“已经完成”。马来西亚日常交流也常用 bersiaplah；向陌生人或上级提出要求时，sila bersiap 更稳妥。

senses.zh_definition: 要倒霉了；要受罚了，常用于警告、威吓或熟人间的玩笑。
senses.en_definition: In for trouble; used in a warning, threat, or teasing prediction.
senses.ms_definition: Akan menerima akibat buruk atau hukuman, digunakan sebagai amaran, ancaman atau usikan.
senses.nuances: 这是 siaplah 在特定语境中的惯用语用解读，并非 -lah 单独具有威胁意义。siaplah kau 的语气可能很重；关系、声调和前后文决定它是玩笑还是威吓。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 熟人间可用于催促或打趣；正式通报中的倒装强调带有修辞色彩，日常公文通常直接写 sudah siap 或 telah siap。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -lah 不保证语气温柔；siaplah cepat 可能显得催促，siaplah kau 可能构成威吓。对上级或陌生人宜改用礼貌请求。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 熟人间可用于催促或打趣；正式通报中的倒装强调带有修辞色彩，日常公文通常直接写 sudah siap 或 telah siap。

etymology.historical_story: Siaplah is transparently formed within Malay from siap and the emphatic particle -lah. Its meaning depends on the sentence: it can announce completion, urge readiness, or warn that someone faces trouble. These uses illustrate how a familiar readiness word acquires conversational force without requiring a separate borrowed origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siap 记成“就绪”，把 -lah 当成语气聚光灯：完成了、快准备、你惨了，要看整句话。

morphology.formula: se- + eloknya → seeloknya；进一步分析：se- + elok + -nya → seeloknya
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留 eloknya，但它是已带 -nya 的基底，真正的词根是 elok。se- 的 e 读 /ə/，elok 的 e 读 /e/；两个元音分属不同音节，之间可出现喉塞音。马来西亚常见读音中，词尾 k 实现为 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 最好；以较理想或较妥当的做法而言。用于提出建议，表示某种行动更为可取。
senses.en_definition: Preferably; ideally; it would be best to.
senses.ms_definition: Seelok-eloknya; sebaik-baiknya.
senses.nuances: 常置于句首，也可置于主语之后，针对整个行动提出建议；通常不表示强制要求。不要把它与表示“和……一样好或漂亮”的 seelok 混淆。DBP《Kamus Dewan Perdana》将其释为 seelok-eloknya。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=seelok)

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau nak elak sesak, seeloknya kita gerak awal sikit lah.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places seeloknya alongside seelok-eloknya, connecting it with elok, meaning good or beautiful. This relationship offers a useful semantic bridge: what is good becomes what would be best to do. In contemporary Malay, the expression commonly introduces practical recommendations. etymology.historical_story: Speedy has a history within English, rather than an established Malay derivational history. Merriam-Webster traces it to Middle English spedi, built from sped and an adjective-forming suffix. Earlier meanings included being beneficial, agile, or prompt, while the base also concerned success and progress. Modern speedy emphasizes quick movement or accomplishment, which helps explain the familiar wish for a speedy recovery. [Merriam-Webster：speedy](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/speedy).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: speed＝“速度”，加英语-y变成speedy＝“快速的”；整组记speedy recovery＝“早日康复”。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied spelling is the English technical word shim, whose deeper origin is uncertain. Malay engineering references provide equivalents such as kepipis, while DBP terminology also records syim in compounds. Computing uses shim for intervening code that helps components work together, inviting comparison with a small physical insert that corrects a mismatch. The packet alone does not establish which meaning was intended.

etymology.historical_story: Sorak belongs to Malay vocabulary for collective vocal expression. Its cultural life appears in the proverb alah sabung, menang sorak, which pictures losing a contest while retaining the satisfaction of cheering. The same word can accompany celebration or ridicule, preserving the crowd's powerful role in giving public approval or disapproval. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sorak).

etymology.historical_story: Shakespeare is an English family name whose literary prominence comes from William Shakespeare. His career joined acting, playwriting and partnership in a London theatre company. Today, his surname can identify either the historical writer or, by association, the works readers study and actors perform. In Malay, it remains a proper name rather than a native derivative. Source: [Folger Shakespeare Library](https://www.folger.edu/explore/shakespeares-life/).

senses.nuances: 标准马来语通常用 tepi、sisi 或 sebelah，须按位置关系选择。所给 IPA 为英语读音。DBP 页面将 side 列于英马词典，不能据此认定为标准马来语词条；status 沿用任务指定的数据标签。[DBP：英语 side](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=side)。

collocations.en: at the side of the road

senses.zh_definition: 争论、竞争或协商中的一方；某人的阵营。
senses.en_definition: A party or camp in a disagreement, competition, or negotiation.
senses.ms_definition: Pihak atau kumpulan dalam perselisihan, pertandingan atau rundingan.
senses.nuances: 混合口语中的 side aku 指“我这一方”，未必指空间位置。正式马来语用 pihak saya；表达支持某人时可用 menyebelahi 或 berpihak kepada。[DBP：side 与 memihak、menyebelahi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=side)。

senses.zh_definition: 某件事的一个方面，或某人对事件的说法与观点。
senses.en_definition: An aspect of something, or a person's account or perspective.
senses.ms_definition: Aspek sesuatu perkara atau penjelasan dan sudut pandangan seseorang mengenainya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词在混合话语中的用法，不能把所有搭配一律译成 tepi。按语境可用 aspek、sudut pandangan 或 penjelasan。

collocations.zh: 他对这件事的说法（混合口语）

etymology.historical_story: Here, side is an English word appearing inside Malay conversation. Malaysia's multilingual setting allows speakers to alternate languages within a sentence, especially among people who share both languages. The English–Malay dictionary supplies different Malay equivalents for different meanings. Its inclusion there documents translation relationships; it does not by itself establish side as a standard Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语 /saɪd/ 记忆：位置的一边用 sebelah，争论的一方用 pihak，事情的一面用 aspek。

senses.zh_definition: 寿司：以调味醋饭为主体，配以鱼类、其他海鲜、蛋或蔬菜等的日本食品。
senses.en_definition: A Japanese dish of vinegared rice served with fish, other seafood, egg, vegetables, or other ingredients.
senses.ms_definition: Hidangan Jepun berasaskan nasi bercuka yang digabungkan dengan ikan, makanan laut, telur, sayuran atau bahan lain.
senses.nuances: sushi 是常见国际拼写；规范马来语对应 susyi。这里按指定结构保留 status: official 作为词条记录标签，不表示 sushi 获 DBP 认定为规范拼写。ms_definition 为综合释义，并非 DBP 原文；寿司不必含生鱼，只有生鱼片而没有饭的 sashimi 也不等于寿司。[DBP 的 susyi 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=susyi)；[日本国家旅游局](https://faq.japan-travel.jnto.go.jp/en/guide/sushi-in-japan/)

etymology.historical_story: The Japanese name travelled internationally with the dish. Earlier sushi traditions preserved fish through fermentation with rice. Later Japanese cooks used vinegar to create the desired acidity without waiting for lengthy fermentation, helping establish familiar modern forms. Malay adapts the name as susyi, while sushi remains common in international restaurant names and everyday writing. [MAFF](https://www.maff.go.jp/e/policies/market/dento_syoku/bunrui/suisan-hakkou.html)；[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=susyi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 su-shi：看到醋饭想到寿司；写规范马来语时，把 sh 换成表示同一音的 sy，成为 susyi。

senses.nuances: 实际马来语词类是 kata bilangan tentu（确定数词）；受本结构词类选项限制，pos 以 noun 对应数值名词用途。表示数量时放在名词或量词前；pukul sebelas 表示十一点；“第十一”用 kesebelas。[DBP 数量用例与说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sebelas)

etymology.historical_story: Sebelas makes Malay counting visible: se- contributes one, and belas belongs to the series running from eleven to nineteen. The same pattern continues in dua belas and tiga belas, although those expressions are written separately. Everyday uses connect the number with eleven o'clock and an eleven-player football team, giving learners practical anchors for remembering its form. [DBP 用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sebelas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 记“一”，belas 记“十几”：一个单位加在十上就是 sebelas，十一；十一点就是 pukul sebelas。

etymology.historical_story: Australian lexicographers connect sheila with an Irish personal name used generically for women. Early Australian usage referred particularly to Irish women; the meaning later broadened to women generally. The precise historical route remains debated, so the name connection is best presented as probable rather than certain. See the [Australian National Dictionary Centre](https://history.cass.anu.edu.au/centres/andc/australian-words-s).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Sheila本来可以是女子名；小写sheila在澳洲俚语里泛指女子。这个联系也帮助区分专名与普通名词。

etymology.historical_story: Sonja is demonstrably used as a personal name: Norway's royal household records Sonja Haraldsen, born in Oslo in 1937. That establishes a real naming context, but it does not identify the supplied lowercase token or establish a Malay dictionary meaning. Without its original sentence, assigning a Malay etymology, a fixed pronunciation or a derivational family would turn a plausible interpretation into unsupported certainty.

etymology.historical_story: Speaker is borrowed from English, but its established Malay dictionary meaning is a parliamentary office. The title points to the person who controls proceedings rather than simply anyone who speaks. Malaysian parliamentary usage places Speaker alongside Yang di-Pertua, connecting the borrowed word with local institutional terminology and the practical work of chairing debate. [Parliament of Malaysia](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/images/webuser/dn/Buku%20Panduan%20Penyediaan%20Verbatim%20Penyata%20Rasmi%20Hansard.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Sewajarnya is built around wajar, associated with what is fitting, reasonable, or natural. The surrounding se- and -nya form an established expression covering both natural circumstances and appropriate conduct. This semantic bridge explains why the same word can describe something expected and recommend how someone ought to act, depending on its sentence.

etymology.historical_story: English scarlet came through Old French escarlate, a word associated with fine cloth. Medieval records connect the term with both textiles and red colouring, showing how a material name could become a colour name. Its deeper origin remains disputed. This European textile history does not establish scarlet as a standardized Malay borrowing. [Anglo-Norman Dictionary](https://www.anglo-norman.net/entry/scarlet)

etymology.historical_story: Sembahyang preserves an older combination of sembah, expressing reverence or worship, and hyang, referring to divinity. Modern speakers generally learn it as one word. Its present meanings span Islamic ritual prayer and worship in other traditions, illustrating how inherited vocabulary can serve changing religious communities without retaining only its earliest associations. [Nothofer, Pengantar Etimologi](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/26597/1/Bernd%20Nothofer_Pengantar%20Etimologi%20lengkap%20pdf.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用 sembah（敬拜）联想 sembahyang（礼拜）；历史上的 hyang 指神圣者，不是关系词 yang。

spoken_features: ni：ini 的口语缩略形式
buat sesi：口语中常用，正式表达可用 adakan sesi
kat：此处对应表示地点的 di
je：sahaja 的口语形式
lah：使提议的语气较轻松

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita nak buat sesi sumbang saran kat mana petang ni?
messages.ms_standard: Di manakah kita hendak mengadakan sesi sumbang saran petang ini?
messages.zh: 今天下午咱们去哪儿一起想点子？
messages.en: Where shall we have our brainstorming session this afternoon?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat kafe bawah je lah. Aku dah tempah meja.
messages.ms_standard: Di kafe di tingkat bawah sahaja. Saya sudah menempah meja.
messages.zh: 就在楼下的咖啡馆吧。我已经订好桌了。
messages.en: Let’s just use the café downstairs. I’ve already booked a table.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向上级、长辈或客户提出建议时，可用 Pada pandangan saya…（依我看……）或 Jika sesuai, saya ingin menyarankan…（如果合适，我想建议……），为对方保留考虑空间。熟人间可直接说 Ada cadangan tak?（有什么建议吗？）。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: “建议”义适合会议、课堂和共同解决问题的场合。sumbang saran 指共同产生、交流想法的讨论。“肚脐”义属于吉兰丹方言，跨地区交流宜用 pusat 或 pusar；涉及身体时应尊重对方隐私，避免拿身体特征开玩笑。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向上级、长辈或客户提出建议时，可用 Pada pandangan saya…（依我看……）或 Jika sesuai, saya ingin menyarankan…（如果合适，我想建议……），为对方保留考虑空间。熟人间可直接说 Ada cadangan tak?（有什么建议吗？）。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: “建议”义适合会议、课堂和共同解决问题的场合。sumbang saran 指共同产生、交流想法的讨论。“肚脐”义属于吉兰丹方言，跨地区交流宜用 pusat 或 pusar；涉及身体时应尊重对方隐私，避免拿身体特征开玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records two distinct entries under saran: a suggestion and a Kelantan word for the navel. Their shared spelling does not establish a shared origin. The suggestion sense supports derivatives such as saranan and menyarankan, and appears in sumbang saran, the expression for brainstorming. The consulted dictionary entry does not establish an earlier donor language or borrowing date. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=saran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa.ran 读成两拍，联想“商量”：先提出 saran，再一起商量；sumbang saran 就是大家贡献点子。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

headword.status_note: 沿用请求指定的数据状态；不表示该英语形式已获核定为标准马来语。音标采用英式英语读法；原包的音节字段 sst 明显异常，保留以便校订，实际为单音节。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马英混合口语中整词使用，无马来语词缀变化；不能将开头的 st- 拆作词缀。

word_family.gloss: 重新开始；重新启动，属英语词族
启动器；起动机，属英语词族

senses.zh_definition: 开始；着手进行某项活动。用于夹杂英语的马来语口语。
senses.en_definition: To begin an activity; used as an English insertion in informal Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, bermaksud mula atau memulakan sesuatu kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 常见于熟人聊天和非正式职场交流。标准马来语按句法使用 mula、bermula 或 memulakan；这里提供的是混合口语释义，并非引述官方马来语词条。

senses.zh_definition: 启动发动机、机器或设备，使其开始运转。
senses.en_definition: To start an engine, machine, or device.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, bermaksud menghidupkan enjin, mesin atau peranti.
senses.nuances: 口语中的 start kereta 通常指启动汽车发动机。正式表达宜用 menghidupkan enjin 或 menghidupkan mesin，而非机械地逐字翻译为 memulakan kereta。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Label “start” pada skrin tersebut perlu diterjemahkan sebagai “mula” dalam versi bahasa Melayu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该屏幕上的“start”标签应在马来语版本中译为“mula”。
dual_scenarios.en: The on-screen label “start” should be translated as “mula” in the Malay version.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Semua dah sampai? Kita start mesyuarat sekarang, ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah semua orang sudah tiba? Mari kita mulakan mesyuarat sekarang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 人都到齐了吗？我们现在开始开会吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Is everyone here? Let's start the meeting now.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
start 是英语动词插入马来语句子的语码混用。
句末 ya 用于征求认同，使语气较柔和。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Semua dah sampai? Kita start mesyuarat sekarang, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah semua orang sudah tiba? Mari kita mulakan mesyuarat sekarang.
messages.zh: 人都到齐了吗？我们现在开始开会吧。

messages.zh: 等一下，Lina 马上进来。然后我们就开始。
messages.en: Hang on, Lina's about to join. Then we can start.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉的双语同事之间使用自然；面对需要清楚标准表达的听众，使用马来语对应词更妥当。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 聊天可说 start kerja；正式报告写 mula bekerja 或 memulakan kerja。正式例句中的 start 是被讨论的英语标签。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉的双语同事之间使用自然；面对需要清楚标准表达的听众，使用马来语对应词更妥当。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 聊天可说 start kerja；正式报告写 mula bekerja 或 memulakan kerja。正式例句中的 start 是被讨论的英语标签。

etymology.historical_story: English start developed from Old English styrtan, associated with sudden movement or leaping. Its meanings later expanded to setting out, beginning an activity, and putting machinery into operation. The contrast is memorable: an abrupt physical movement became an abstract beginning. These are developments within English, rather than evidence that start is an inherited Malay root. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/start).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 start 和屏幕上的启动键连起来：按下就“开始”；写标准马来语时对应 mula 或 menghidupkan。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词为词根，开头 se- 不是此处的前缀。首音节 e 读 /ə/；派生为 menyerabutkan 时，meN- 在 s 前变为 meny-，词根首字母 s 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 有纤维；毛糙；杂乱；心绪纷乱

senses.zh_definition: 纤维；纤维状细丝，如椰壳、树皮中的细丝，也用于某些生物组织名称。
senses.en_definition: A fibre or threadlike strand, especially one found in plant material.
senses.ms_definition: Serat seperti yang terdapat pada sabut atau kulit kayu, atau sesuatu yang berbentuk serat.
senses.nuances: serabut 指纤维或纤维状结构；sabut 通常指椰子的纤维外壳，两者不能在所有语境中互换。akar serabut 是植物学上的须根，并非“乱根”。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=serabut)

senses.zh_definition: 起毛的；毛糙的；绳线等表面或末端有散开的细丝。
senses.en_definition: Frayed or fuzzy, with loose fibres projecting from a surface or end.
senses.ms_definition: Berambu-rambu atau berbulu-bulu, terutama pada tali dan benang.
senses.nuances: 描述实物纤维散开或起毛，不必然表示已经断裂。完整书面句中也常使用 berserabut。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=serabut)

senses.zh_definition: 心烦意乱的；思绪纷乱、忧虑或被琐事烦扰的。
senses.en_definition: Mentally troubled, worried, or overwhelmed.
senses.ms_definition: Risau, runsing atau tidak tenteram fikirannya; turut digunakan dalam ungkapan serabut perut.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》将此义标为 Kl，即吉兰丹用法；现代非正式交流也可见 kepala serabut、fikiran serabut。表示日常烦乱，不等于精神疾病诊断。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=serabut)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sistem akar serabut pada rumput membantu mengikat tanah dan mengurangkan hakisan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 草的须根系统有助于固持土壤并减少侵蚀。
dual_scenarios.en: The fibrous root system of grass helps bind the soil and reduce erosion.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kepala aku dah serabut dengan kerja ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Fikiran saya sudah berserabut kerana kerja ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这工作搞得我脑子都乱了。
dual_scenarios.en: This work has got me feeling overwhelmed.
spoken_features: kepala serabut 用“脑袋乱”表达心理上的烦乱。
aku 是熟人间常用的第一人称。
dah 对应 sudah；ni 对应 ini。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kepala aku dah serabut, banyak sangat kerja nak siap hari ni.
messages.ms_standard: Fikiran saya sudah berserabut kerana terlalu banyak kerja yang perlu disiapkan hari ini.
messages.zh: 我脑子都乱了，今天要做完的工作太多了。
messages.en: I'm overwhelmed. There's so much to finish today.

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Rehat kejap dulu. Buat satu-satu je, nanti aku tolong.
messages.ms_standard: Berehatlah sebentar dahulu. Buatlah satu demi satu; saya akan membantu nanti.
messages.zh: 先歇一会儿。一件一件来，待会儿我帮你。
messages.en: Take a short break. Do one thing at a time; I'll help you in a bit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟人间说自己 serabut 很自然；直接说对方让自己 serabut 可能显得不耐烦。与上司交谈可具体说明工作压力或待办事项。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 实物和植物学用法适合正式场合；心理义适合日常倾诉。朋友说 kepala serabut 时通常是在表达压力，可回应理解或提供帮助。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人间说自己 serabut 很自然；直接说对方让自己 serabut 可能显得不耐烦。与上司交谈可具体说明工作压力或待办事项。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 实物和植物学用法适合正式场合；心理义适合日常倾诉。朋友说 kepala serabut 时通常是在表达压力，可回应理解或提供帮助。

etymology.historical_story: Serabut offers a memorable connection between material texture and mental experience. Its dictionary senses include fibres, frayed strands, and troubled thoughts, with the emotional sense labelled Kelantanese. Picture loose threads becoming tangled, then imagine worries behaving similarly. This explains the semantic connection without claiming an undocumented ultimate origin or a precise date for the figurative use. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=serabut)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一把散开的纤维 serabut，再想脑中烦事缠成一团：kepala serabut＝心烦意乱。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语 shift 的整词借入形式，无马来语词缀。sy 表示单一辅音 /ʃ/，全词一个音节；词尾不保留英语 shift 的 /t/。下列词族成员为复合表达。

senses.zh_definition: 轮班班组；按轮替制度在某一时段工作的员工群体。
senses.en_definition: A group of workers that takes its turn working in rotation with other groups.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan pekerja yang bertugas secara bergilir dengan kumpulan lain.
senses.nuances: 本义侧重执行工作的人员群体，而非时段；在具体语境中可用 kumpulan pekerja 或 anggota syif 明确所指。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=syif)

senses.zh_definition: 班次；按排班表规定的一段工作时间。
senses.en_definition: A scheduled period of work in a system of rotating duties.
senses.ms_definition: Tempoh bekerja yang ditetapkan dalam jadual tugas.
senses.nuances: 日常最常用于说明上班时段，如早班、夜班。syif 本身不表示加班；超出正常工时的工作通常称 kerja lebih masa。正式拼写采用 syif。[DBP 词条及用语说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=syif)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penyelia akan menyemak jadual syif bagi memastikan bilangan petugas mencukupi pada waktu malam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主管将检查轮班表，以确保夜间有足够的值勤人员。
dual_scenarios.en: The supervisor will review the shift roster to ensure adequate staffing at night.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku kerja syif malam hari ni, esok baru boleh jumpa.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya bekerja pada syif malam hari ini dan hanya boleh berjumpa esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我今天上夜班，明天才能见面。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm on the night shift today, so I can only meet tomorrow.
spoken_features: 口语 kerja 对应标准语 bekerja。
ni 对应 ini。
baru boleh 在此表示“到那时才可以”。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok jadual syif minggu depan kat grup?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah melihat jadual syif minggu hadapan dalam kumpulan sembang?
messages.zh: 你看过群里下周的排班表了吗？
messages.en: Have you checked next week's shift roster in the group chat?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku syif pagi je minggu depan, jadi tak payah tukar.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya hanya bertugas pada syif pagi minggu hadapan, jadi saya tidak perlu menukar syif.
messages.zh: 看了。我下周都是早班，所以不用换班。
messages.en: Yes. I'm only on morning shifts next week, so I don't need to swap.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求同事换班时宜用 Boleh kita tukar syif?（我们可以换班吗？），并说明原因；向主管申请时可用 Saya ingin memohon pertukaran syif。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于工厂、医院、保安、零售及客服等轮班环境。协调会面时应说明 syif pagi、syif petang 或 syif malam；涉及换班时还需明确日期和时间。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请求同事换班时宜用 Boleh kita tukar syif?（我们可以换班吗？），并说明原因；向主管申请时可用 Saya ingin memohon pertukaran syif。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于工厂、医院、保安、零售及客服等轮班环境。协调会面时应说明 syif pagi、syif petang 或 syif malam；涉及换班时还需明确日期和时间。

etymology.historical_story: Syif adapts English shift to Malay spelling and pronunciation. In workplaces that operate beyond ordinary office hours, the word names both a team taking its turn and the hours assigned to it. These paired meanings explain why the same word appears in conversations about staffing, factory production, hospital duties, and personal work schedules. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=syif)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 shift 的词尾 t 收起来，sh 改写成 sy：syif＝轮到你上的那一班。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语形式；-s 可标记名词复数，也可标记动词第三人称单数，在 /l/ 后读 /z/。输入包将完整词形标为词根，此处按英语形态分析更正；不是马来语派生后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 字幕：与影视或视频内容同步显示、呈现对白或其译文的文字；为英语复数形式。
senses.en_definition: On-screen text presenting speech or its translation in a film, programme, or video.
senses.ms_definition: Teks pada skrin yang memaparkan dialog atau terjemahannya; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah sari kata.
senses.nuances: 马来语聊天中可作为英语语码转换出现，规范马来语用 sari kata，分写为两个词。IPA 为英语读音，非已核定的马来语借词读音。释义参见 [Cambridge：subtitle](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/subtitle)；马来语用例参见 [YouTube 翻译与转录词汇表](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/7296221?hl=ms)。

senses.zh_definition: 书籍、文章等的副标题；为英语 subtitle 的复数。
senses.en_definition: Secondary titles that supplement or explain main titles.
senses.ms_definition: Tajuk tambahan yang menerangkan atau melengkapkan tajuk utama sesuatu karya.
senses.nuances: 此义属于英语；应按出版语境译成 subtajuk 或 tajuk kecil，不应译成影视用语 sari kata。依据 [Cambridge：subtitle](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/subtitle) 编写，非 DBP 对 subtitles 的官方释义。

senses.zh_definition: 为影视作品配字幕，或为作品加副标题；为英语动词的第三人称单数现在时。
senses.en_definition: Adds subtitles to audiovisual material or gives a work a secondary title.
senses.ms_definition: Menyediakan sari kata untuk bahan audiovisual atau memberikan subtajuk kepada karya.
senses.nuances: 仅适用于相应英语句法，如 she subtitles videos。不能把马来语聊天中的所有 subtitles 都分析成动词。依据 [Cambridge：subtitle](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/subtitle)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua video latihan hendaklah dilengkapi dengan sari kata bahasa Melayu sebelum diterbitkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有培训视频发布前均须配上马来语字幕。
dual_scenarios.en: All training videos must include Malay subtitles before publication.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah buka subtitles belum? Aku tak faham dialog dia.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah mengaktifkan sari kata? Saya tidak memahami dialog dalam video itu.

spoken_features: subtitles 是英语语码转换；规范对应词为 sari kata。
dah 对应 sudah，tak 对应 tidak。
dah…belum 构成询问是否已完成动作的口语句式。
dia 在此口语化地指视频。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah buka subtitles belum? Aku tak faham dialog dia.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah mengaktifkan sari kata? Saya tidak memahami dialog dalam video itu.
messages.zh: 你开字幕了没？我听不懂里面的对白。
messages.en: Have you turned on the subtitles? I can't understand the dialogue.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum. Tekan ikon kat bawah tu je.
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Tekan sahaja ikon di bahagian bawah itu.
messages.zh: 还没。点下面那个图标就行。
messages.en: Not yet. Just tap that icon at the bottom.

etymology.historical_story: English subtitle combines sub-, meaning below or subordinate, with title. The dictionary records both a secondary title and text displayed with moving images. Subtitles adds the English ending -s. In a Malay conversation, retaining this English form is code-switching; a standard Malay audiovisual sentence uses sari kata. The English structure does not establish an official Malay borrowing.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two distinct words spelled sita: a legal term associated with court claims and seizure, and a literary adjective meaning pure white. Contemporary administrative language keeps the legal word visible in notices and enforcement reports. This contrast illustrates how identical spellings can carry separate lexical histories. The cited DBP entry does not establish the legal word’s ultimate origin, so no donor language is asserted.

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish which scotch is intended. One independently documented referent is the Scotch brand: 3M records masking tape in 1925 and transparent cellophane tape in 1930. That product history explains the brand example here, but it does not establish that lowercase scotch is an official Malay common noun. [3M history](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/about-3m/history/).

etymology.historical_story: The text and performance sense belongs with English script, ultimately from Latin scriptum, something written, related to scribere, to write. Malay uses the adapted spelling skrip. A separate financial homograph corresponds to English scrip, not script. Keeping those English forms apart helps explain why one Malay spelling can refer either to a performance text or to a provisional certificate. [Script etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/script), [DBP homographs](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=skrip)

etymology.historical_story: Semangat belongs to a regional cultural vocabulary of spirit and vitality. Traditional accounts associate it with people, rice, and other beings or objects, while modern Malay also uses it for morale and determination. Semangatnya adds the referring element -nya to that noun; it is not a separately inherited root. Cultural background: [ANU Press, Concepts of the Soul](https://press.anu.edu.au/downloads/press/p55751/mobile/ch03.html).

etymology.historical_story: English speedster combines speed with the suffix -ster, forming a name for something or someone associated with speed. Its range includes people, animals and vehicles. The same memorable form also suits fictional characters whose defining ability is extraordinary movement, although that context does not establish a separate Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: speedster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/speedster).

etymology.historical_story: Strickland preserves a rural English landscape in a family name. The surname derives from places in historic Westmorland, including Great and Little Strickland. Their names combine Old English stīrc, a young bullock or heifer, with land. The agricultural meaning belongs to the place-name's history, rather than describing people who bear the surname. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/strickland).

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate borrowing: se- adds an equal-degree comparison to bodoh. A related expression, sebodoh-bodoh, appears under bodoh in Dewan dictionaries with a concessive meaning. Comparing the two helps learners see how reduplication changes the grammatical force of a familiar adjective. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=bodoh)

senses.en_definition: Proper, decent, or becoming in speech, behaviour, or appearance; commonly negated to mean improper or indecent.
senses.ms_definition: Elok dan sopan pada tutur kata atau perbuatan serta manis dipandang atau didengar; dalam frasa tidak senonoh atau kurang senonoh, bermaksud tidak patut, tidak sopan atau tidak elok dipandang.
senses.nuances: 通常遇见的是 tidak senonoh、kurang senonoh，口语为 tak senonoh；肯定形式有词典依据，但日常称赞常用 sopan 或 sesuai。否定形式不必然涉及色情，程度须看语境。参见 [DBP：senonoh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=senonoh)。

etymology.historical_story: The consulted DBP entries explain senonoh through social judgments about speech, conduct, and appearance, rather than supplying a historical derivation. Kamus Dewan foregrounds its negative combinations, while Kamus Pelajar also records the positive meaning. This contrast offers a useful cultural lesson: learners often encounter a word for propriety when speakers are pointing out a breach of it. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=senonoh).

etymology.historical_story: Sri belongs to an honorific tradition associated with Sanskrit śrī, a word connected with beauty and fortune. Its respectful function survives in titles across languages. In Malaysian Malay, learners meet it in established forms such as Tan Sri and Puan Sri. The inherited association with distinction helps explain its function, but does not make Sri interchangeable with every spelling of Seri. [Origin: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/shri).

etymology.historical_story: Suara is traced to Sanskrit svara, meaning voice or sound. In Malay, its meanings extend from audible speech to opinions and votes: a person can make a sound, express a position, or have a say. Suaraku adds the Malay clitic -ku, making that voice personally mine without changing the borrowed root. See [research on Sanskrit loans](https://www.pertanika.upm.edu.my/resources/files/Pertanika%20PAPERS/JSSH%20Vol.%2025%20%283%29%20Sep.%202017/11%20JSSH-1573-2016-4thProof.pdf).

morphology.formula: sedikit + 独立小品词 pun → sedikit pun；sedikitpun 为非规范连写
morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入将整个连写串视为词根的分析；此处 root_word 表示短语的基础词 sedikit。pun 不是后缀，应与 sedikit 分写。IPA 表示规范短语的宽式读音；词尾 /t/ 在实际发音中可不除阻。

senses.zh_definition: 规范写作 sedikit pun：哪怕一点；与否定词连用时表示“一点也不、丝毫不”。
senses.en_definition: Even a little; with negation, not at all or not in the slightest. Standard spelling: sedikit pun.
senses.ms_definition: Sedikit pun bermaksud walau sedikit; apabila digunakan bersama kata nafi, ungkapan ini menegaskan ketiadaan sesuatu walaupun pada kadar yang paling kecil.
senses.nuances: 整个短语可作程度或数量强调语，pun 本身是小品词。否定意义来自 tidak、tak、belum 等上下文，不能把 sedikit pun 单独等同于“不”。连写形式不是规范词头。分写规则见 [DBP《马来语通用拼写指南》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)；基础词见 [PRPM：sedikit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7876&keyword=sedikit)。马来语释义为综合释义，并非 DBP 对连写形式的原文定义。

etymology.historical_story: The important history here is an established spelling convention. Malay writes pun separately in this expression, while allowing certain established combinations to be joined. Sedikit pun therefore remains two words. Its force comes from combining a small quantity with emphasis: under negation, even the smallest amount is excluded, producing the familiar meaning 'not at all'.

etymology.historical_story: Comparative evidence links Malay sikat with a reconstructed Western Malayo-Polynesian form *sikat. Related words refer to brushes and brushing across several regional languages. The Malay meanings bring together familiar objects with rows or projections: a comb, a rake, and a hand of bananas. That visual link is useful for learning, although it does not establish the exact historical sequence. [Source: Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_s.htm).

etymology.historical_story: Sasar illustrates why identical spellings need careful dictionary reading. Kamus Dewan separates a mental-state adjective from entries concerning straying and aiming, marking the latter two as Jakarta usage. Modern learners also encounter familiar compounds such as kumpulan sasar. These dictionary divisions document different uses; they do not establish a single historical path connecting all the meanings.

etymology.historical_story: Malay laras denotes musical pitch as well as correspondence or suitability. Adding se- produces selaras, used for matching pitch and agreement with a standard. etymology.historical_story: Scotland is named after the Scots, whose name is associated with settlers from Ireland. The deeper origin of that people's name remains uncertain. etymology.historical_story: English streak descends from Old English strica, associated with a line or stroke. Its meanings expanded from visible marks to traits and runs of similar events. Modern learning applications make the consecutive-series meaning especially visible: a number represents repeated practice, turning an abstract sequence into something users can watch grow. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/streak)；[Duolingo](https://blog.duolingo.com/improving-the-streak/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天画一笔，连成一条不断的线：看得见的是条纹，数得出的是连续纪录。

word_family.gloss: 把故事搬上舞台；改编成戏剧

senses.zh_definition: 由演员扮演人物、演绎故事的戏剧或戏剧演出。
senses.en_definition: A play or dramatic performance acted by performers.
senses.ms_definition: Pertunjukan cerita yang dilakonkan oleh orang; pementasan cerita.
senses.nuances: 可指舞台演出，也见于 sandiwara radio 等媒介表达；谈现代影视或一般戏剧时，drama 往往更常见。释义依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=sandiwara)。

senses.zh_definition: 为掩人耳目而刻意安排、缺乏真实性的事件或行为；一场做给别人看的戏。
senses.en_definition: A staged event or pretence intended to deceive or mislead.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu kejadian yang tidak sungguh-sungguh, untuk mengabui mata sahaja dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，通常含有指责虚假或不真诚的意味。说 sesuatu itu sandiwara，往往是在质疑其真实性，并非仅仅形容事情有戏剧性。

etymology.historical_story: Sandiwara has a Javanese background. An Indonesian government cultural reference attributes its introduction to Mangkunegoro VII and explains sandi as something concealed and warah as teaching: a performance conveys lessons indirectly. Malay dictionaries also record a figurative meaning, a deceptive show, giving learners a memorable connection between acting before an audience and putting on an act. See [Vademikum Kebudayaan](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/12932/1/Vademikum%20dirjen%20kebudayaan%20depdikbud.pdf) and [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=sandiwara).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sandiwara 想成“台上演故事，台下装样子”：真上台是戏剧，假做事是作秀。

etymology.historical_story: Shelly is recorded as an English personal name and a spelling variant of Shelley. In a Malay sentence, such a name identifies a person rather than acquiring a new Malay dictionary meaning. Its appearance in a frequency list therefore does not establish a Malay lexical origin or official dictionary status. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/shelly).

etymology.historical_story: Selipar is borrowed from English slipper, with a vowel separating the opening consonants in its Malay form. Malaysian usage readily includes everyday outdoor footwear as well as house slippers. The familiar compound selipar jepun identifies the V-strapped rubber type, showing how a borrowed word became part of an established local footwear vocabulary. [Loanword record](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/selipar), [DBP footwear definition](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=selipar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 slipper 慢慢读成 se-li-par：脚一滑进去，就是 selipar；开头 se- 不另拆。

etymology.historical_story: Sekotak illustrates an everyday Malay way of counting goods through their containers. The prefix se- contributes the meaning 'one', while kotak names the box. This makes the expression useful for chocolates, milk, stationery and food parcels. Its meaning depends on the package being discussed; it does not name a fixed weight or volume.

senses.en_definition: A nonstandard spelling of surat khabar: a newspaper carrying news, commentary, advertisements, and other material, usually published daily.

senses.nuances: 规范拼写必须分写为 surat khabar；连写形式不是另一个独立词义。搭配与例句使用规范形式。DBP 明确说明该拼写规则：[DBP：suratkhabar 拼写咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=suratkhabar)。

etymology.historical_story: The standard expression combines surat, referring to writing or a written document, with khabar, an Arabic loan meaning news or a report. Together, the words identify a publication that carries news. Its derived noun persuratkhabaran refers to newspaper affairs or journalism. Standard spelling keeps the base expression separate but joins the derived form. See [DBP: khabar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=khabar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: surat 是文字或书信，khabar 是消息：把消息印成文字，就是 surat khabar；记得中间留空格。

etymology.historical_story: The two prominent uses have distinct naming histories. The military vehicle honours Medal of Honor recipients Stuart S. Stryker and Robert F. Stryker. The medical company traces its beginnings to surgeon and inventor Homer Stryker, who started a company in 1941. These are separate namesakes, not evidence that one organization produced both products.

morphology.formula: sa- + orang → saorang（旧拼写）；se- + orang → seorang（现代拼写）

senses.zh_definition: 一个人；一名。为现代 seorang 的旧拼写，置于人的称谓前时表示一位或一名。
senses.en_definition: Historical spelling of seorang: one person; a or one before a human designation.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan lama bagi seorang, yang bermaksud satu orang dan digunakan sebelum sebutan orang seperti murid atau guru.
senses.nuances: 受给定词性选项限制归入 noun；严格说，seorang 在 seorang murid 中具有数词与量词组合的功能。现代写 seorang murid。1968 年马来西亚国会记录可见 saorang murid，证明该形式具有历史用例。[国会历史记录](https://repositori.parlimen.gov.my/bitstream/123456789/3537/8/DR-12021968.pdf#page=1)

senses.zh_definition: 独自；一个人。对应现代 seorang 表示没有其他人陪伴的用法。

senses.ms_definition: Sendiri atau tanpa ditemani orang lain; padanan ejaan semasanya ialah seorang.
senses.nuances: 这是现代对应词 seorang 的另一用法，不等于 seseorang（某个人）。旧拼写只适合历史引用或讨论；现代通常写 seorang diri、seorang sahaja 或 berseorangan。[DBP：seorang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seorang)

etymology.historical_story: Saorang offers a small window into older Malay printing. Earlier spelling conventions used sa- where modern spelling uses se-, and historical sources show both joined and hyphenated forms. Today, seorang preserves the meaning while following the newer convention. Recognizing this relationship helps readers understand archives without treating an old spelling as a separate modern word. [NIE 拼写说明](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/26e4f656-c9e4-4e25-b4de-1432c479f037/content)

etymology.historical_story: The spelling shift comes directly from English. Malay has the adapted spelling syif, which DBP records for both a scheduled work period and the workers assigned to it. The two spellings illustrate how English workplace vocabulary can coexist with an established Malay form: informal messages may retain English, while Malay administrative writing uses syif. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=syif)

senses.nuances: 常用于文学、影视和文化评论，如 unsur supernatural。DBP 英马词典给出的对应词是 ghaib，术语资料也列有 sakti；本条马来语释义据这些对应义综合表述，不冒充输入中不存在的独立官方定义。[DBP 对应词](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=ghaib)。该拼写也见于 DBP 文学评论。[DBP 使用实例](https://wadahdbp.my/titisan-pena/unsur-mistik-dalam-seri-eksplorasi-sensasi-persepsi-dan-emosi/)。

etymology.historical_story: The international word supernatural ultimately reflects Medieval Latin supernaturalis, combining the idea of being above or beyond with nature. In Malay literary discussion, it offers a compact label for forces and events outside ordinary natural explanation. Its meaning overlaps with ghaib, but its use in a film review does not automatically endorse any particular religious belief. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/supernatural).

senses.nuances: 这是医疗语境中的常见具体用法，不等于合成代谢类固醇。准确理解须结合药名、剂型和用途。[马来西亚卫生部：Apakah itu Steroid?](https://infosihat.moh.gov.my/penerbitan-multimedia/bahan-pameran.raw?args%5B0%5D=0&element=1d8e3e60-3870-466c-ae13-200eb2f809b0&item_id=1602&method=download&task=callelement)。

senses.zh_definition: 合成代谢类固醇；体育或健身语境中涉及增强肌肉和运动表现的一类类固醇。
senses.en_definition: An anabolic steroid, especially when discussed as a substance used to enhance muscle growth or athletic performance.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan steroid anabolik yang digunakan untuk meningkatkan pembinaan otot atau prestasi fizikal, termasuk dalam konteks penyalahgunaan oleh atlet.
senses.nuances: 体育报道中的 steroid 常省略 anabolik；这种语境不能代表所有类固醇的性质或用途。[DBP：steroid](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=steroid)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay steroid belongs to international scientific vocabulary. Its cultural associations stretch from laboratory chemistry to prescribed medicines and sports reporting. The dictionary's Seoul Olympics example illustrates how strongly the word can evoke doping, although its scientific scope is much wider: natural steroids also include hormones and substances involved in cell membranes and digestion. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=steroid); [IUPAC](https://doi.org/10.1351/goldbook.11259).

senses.ms_definition: Tidak begitu jelas pada penglihatan atau tidak cukup terang sehingga sukar dilihat dengan nyata.

senses.ms_definition: Tidak dinyatakan secara terang-terangan; tersembunyi, khususnya tentang maksud atau tujuan.
senses.nuances: 比单纯“不清楚”更突出未明示的意味；形容他人意图时，语气可能带怀疑。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses samar for things that cannot be seen clearly and for facts or intentions that are not apparent. The expression samar muka names the late-evening period when faces become difficult to distinguish. Related forms such as menyamar and menyamarkan connect this visual indistinctness with disguise and concealment. [DBP: samar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=samar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa-mar 联想成“纱幕”：隔着一层纱，脸看不清，意思也说不清；此联想不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Somebody is a Middle English compound of some and body. Here body stands for a person, rather than merely a physical body. That older human reference remains visible in anybody and nobody. The word also developed a social meaning: being somebody can mean being a person whose standing or achievements attract recognition.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: some＋body：有一个人，但暂不说明是谁。记住 body 在这里指人，不能逐字译成某个身体。

etymology.historical_story: Siu is documented in DBP’s Mukah Melanau vocabulary with the Malay equivalent belalang. The same record lists compound names, including siu daun and siu padai, showing how the term participates in more specific insect names. This documents a community vocabulary rather than establishing a borrowing into standard Malay. The available evidence does not establish its deeper origin or earliest historical use.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 有关，适合亲密表达、歌词和叙事；向上司、长辈或陌生人介绍亲属时，sepupu saya 通常更稳妥。正式出版物中的文学引语仍可保留 sepupuku。

etymology.historical_story: Sepupuku combines a kinship term with the shortened first-person pronoun aku. A historical lexical description records sepupu as originally referring to people with the same grandparents. Some regional varieties connect se- with one, contrasting it with dua pupu for second cousins. Adding -ku identifies whose cousin is meant without specifying gender or family side. [WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839165573917)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sepupu 记成“堂表亲”，再接熟悉的 aku 缩短形式 -ku：sepupu＋ku＝我的堂表亲。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词进入马来语对话或行业表达，不按马来语词缀拆分。IPA 采用英语来源读音；sing.le 为发音分节提示，不是构词边界，本地口音可能不同。

senses.zh_definition: 单身的；在马来语夹用英语的口语中，指未婚，或目前没有恋爱伴侣，具体含义由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: Unmarried or not currently in a romantic relationship, in English–Malay code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan yang mencampurkan bahasa Inggeris, belum berkahwin atau tidak mempunyai pasangan romantik pada masa ini, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 没有恋爱对象不等于法律上未婚，两者不可混用于行政表格。正式马来语应按实际情况使用 belum berkahwin、bujang 或 tidak mempunyai pasangan。本义为描述性整理，非 DBP 马来语词条引文；PRPM 的英语词典记录不等同于确认其为规范马来语词目。参见 [DBP：single](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=single)。

senses.zh_definition: 单曲；作为独立发行作品推出的歌曲或录音作品。
senses.en_definition: A song or recording released as a standalone music release.
senses.ms_definition: Lagu atau rakaman yang diterbitkan sebagai keluaran tersendiri; penggunaan istilah Inggeris dalam bidang muzik.
senses.nuances: 常见于马来西亚娱乐报道和音乐宣传。这里描述的是实际行业用法，不据此宣称已核实其独立的规范马来语词条地位；正式表达可写 lagu baharu 等适合语境的说法。实际用例见 [RTM：single pertama](https://berita.rtm.gov.my/gemerlap/senarai-berita-gemerlap/senarai-artikel/samsol-tampil-solo-dengan-single-pertama-borak/)。

senses.zh_definition: 单人的；在住宿等服务场景的英语夹用表达中，指供一人使用的床位或房型。
senses.en_definition: Intended for one person, especially of a bed or room in accommodation-related code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Untuk kegunaan seorang, khususnya bagi katil atau bilik dalam percakapan yang mencampurkan bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: katil single 和 bilik single 是双语服务交流中的表达。标准马来语可分别用 katil bujang 和 bilik seorang；单人床的房间也不一定仅允许一人入住，应向经营者确认。

etymology.historical_story: English single appears in Malaysian Malay conversation and entertainment reporting. Its meanings depend on the setting: relationship talk concerns a person's partner status, while music reporting concerns an independently released recording. These uses show how speakers carry an English word into different Malay sentence frames; they do not by themselves establish official dictionary status. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=single) and [RTM](https://berita.rtm.gov.my/gemerlap/senarai-berita-gemerlap/senarai-artikel/samsol-tampil-solo-dengan-single-pertama-borak/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“一个”：感情里一个人、住宿里一人用、音乐里一首独立推出的作品；最终看上下文。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆分词缀；DBP 的 spésial 标音表示 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/。没有确证的常用马来语派生词列入本词族。

etymology.historical_story: DBP explicitly identifies spesial as a borrowing from English special and labels it conversational Malay. The spelling makes the imported word easier to read within Malay conventions, while established alternatives remain available. Its useful cultural lesson is that dictionary inclusion and formal register are separate matters: a recorded word can still belong chiefly to conversation. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=spesial)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: spesial 一听就能联想到英语 special：特别的。聊天说 spesial，正式表达按意思选 istimewa、khas 或 khusus。

etymology.historical_story: Pixar identifies Sulley as the nickname of James P. Sullivan, a celebrated scarer whose encounter with a human child changes his life. The spelling functions as a character name, rather than a Malay word assembled from productive affixes. This documented referent explains the name in film discussions, but does not establish the identity of every lowercase corpus occurrence. [Pixar](https://www.pixar.com/monsters-inc)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sulley /ˈsʌli/ 与 Sullivan 放在一起记，再联想蓝色毛茸茸的大怪兽；记的是角色昵称，不是马来语构词。

morphology.pattern_note: 加 -an 构成表示喊叫声音的名词，不发生鼻音替换。按数据包分为 so.ra.kan；DBP 也记录带喉塞音的读法 [so.raʔ.kan]。

word_family.gloss: 向某人欢呼、助威或起哄

senses.zh_definition: 响亮的呼喊声，尤其指人群表示兴奋、支持、赞同或嘲弄时发出的欢呼、呐喊或起哄声。
senses.en_definition: A loud shout or collective cheering, expressing excitement, support, approval, or sometimes mockery.
senses.ms_definition: Teriakan yang nyaring; sorak.
senses.nuances: ms_definition 采用数据包所载 Kamus Dewan 释义。词本身表示响亮的人声，具体是助威还是嘲弄取决于语境；不等于单纯的拍手声 tepukan，也不必包含有组织的口号。参见 [DBP：sorakan 与 sorak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sorakan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 体育新闻 / 赛事报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Sorakan gemuruh penyokong mengiringi kejayaan pasukan negara menjaringkan gol kemenangan pada minit terakhir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 国家队在最后一分钟攻入制胜球，支持者随即爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。
dual_scenarios.en: Thunderous cheers from supporters greeted the national team's winning goal in the final minute.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sorakan kat stadium tu kuat gila, kat luar pun boleh dengar!

dual_scenarios.zh: 体育场里的欢呼声也太大了，外面都听得到！
dual_scenarios.en: The cheering in the stadium is so loud you can hear it outside!
spoken_features: kat 对应 di；tu 对应 itu。
kuat gila 是朋友间强调“非常响”的口语说法，正式场合用 sangat kuat。
口语省略可从语境恢复的主语。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在球赛、庆典和适合互动的表演中，sorakan 可以表达热情支持；正式仪式中应配合主持安排及现场气氛。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 避免以起哄声羞辱个人，尤其涉及外貌、族群或宗教时。悼念、祈祷及需要安静的场合，应遵守现场礼仪。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在球赛、庆典和适合互动的表演中，sorakan 可以表达热情支持；正式仪式中应配合主持安排及现场气氛。

etymology.historical_story: Sorakan is transparently formed from sorak with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its family connects the sound itself with bersorak, the act of shouting, and penyorak, a person who cheers. DBP also records proverbs involving sorak, showing its place in figurative language as well as descriptions of noisy crowds. A deeper historical origin is not established here. [DBP：sorakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sorakan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sorak 记成“喊出来”，加 -an 就把动作装成一阵“喊声”：bersorak 是欢呼，sorakan 是欢呼声。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆；末尾 e 为 e taling /e/，不是 /ə/，也不是不发音字母。

word_family.gloss: 那天下午；随后到了下午（印尼用法）
拖到下午；时间已太晚（印尼用法）

senses.zh_definition: 下午至日落前的一段时间；午后、傍晚。
senses.en_definition: The afternoon or late afternoon, before nightfall.
senses.ms_definition: Waktu petang, iaitu waktu selepas tengah hari hingga menjelang malam; digunakan terutamanya dalam bahasa Indonesia.
senses.nuances: 输入中的 Kamus Dewan 释义标注 Id，表示印度尼西亚用法。马来西亚一般说 petang；sore 常见于印尼对话、影视和引文。不可套用英语 sore 的“疼痛”义。印尼词义亦可参见 [KBBI 词典文本](https://www.kemhan.go.id/itjen/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/KAMUS-BESAR-BAHASA-INDONESIA_Mutatis-Mutandis-Hal-1078.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Sore connects modern Indonesian with an older Javanese vocabulary of daylight. Linguist Bernd Nothofer analyses Old Javanese sore as sor, ‘below’, combined with we, ‘day’, with the intervening w disappearing. He also notes its presence in Classical Malay. This historical account complements the supplied dictionary’s Indonesian usage label, which describes register rather than necessarily identifying the earliest borrowing route. See [Pengantar Etimologi](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/26597/1/Bernd%20Nothofer_Pengantar%20Etimologi%20lengkap%20pdf.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 so-re，两拍都发音；想象太阳慢慢落下，连接“午后、傍晚”。在马来西亚，把它对应到 petang。

etymology.historical_story: Suster entered Indonesian through Dutch zuster, meaning sister, including a religious or nursing sister. This background helps explain why one word can refer both to a Catholic religious woman and to a nurse. Malay dictionaries preserve these meanings while marking their Indonesian association. The shared vocabulary records contact between languages and institutions, rather than a productive Malay affix pattern. [Linguistic study](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/d1094da6-cecd-4e26-8a86-fd3669362a0b/content)

etymology.historical_story: Sepakan illustrates Malay word formation in everyday sporting language: sepak names a kick, while the suffix -an forms a noun for the action or its result. Football terminology makes this relationship especially visible in expressions such as sepakan sudut. The entry supports this morphological explanation without requiring a speculative ancient origin for the root. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sepakan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sepak 是“踢”，加 -an 就把动作变成“一次踢击”：sepak + an → sepakan。

etymology.historical_story: SALT compresses the English name Strategic Arms Limitation Talks into four initials. The first series of negotiations between the United States and the Soviet Union ran from November 1969 to May 1972 and produced agreements limiting strategic weapons. The abbreviation consequently became a recognizable label in diplomatic history and entered Malay reference works as an international acronym. [U.S. Department of State](https://2009-2017.state.gov/t/isn/5191.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 四个字母对应四个关键词：Strategic 战略、Arms 武器、Limitation 限制、Talks 谈判；按全称记住 SALT。

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是附着于前词的疑问强调小品词，并非派生词缀；此处 suffix 表示其后附位置。词干不变，ng 表示 /ŋ/。headword.jawi 按资料包保留，但 ساڠت 仅对应 sangat，未包含 -kah；syllables 的 null 表示资料包未提供。连写规则见 [DBP：疑问小品词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudah+kah)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于疑问句，询问或质疑某种性质是否达到很高程度：真有那么……吗？
senses.en_definition: Used in a question to ask or challenge whether something is so or very much of a specified quality.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk sangat yang disertai partikel tanya -kah untuk menyoal atau mempersoalkan darjah sesuatu sifat.
senses.nuances: 这是 sangat 加疑问小品词的组合，不应把 sangat 的所有词义机械复制为独立词义。语气常较书面、修辞化，也可能表示不耐烦；日常更常说 susah sangat ke?。以下为可用的组合示例，未核实为高频搭配。基础词义见 [DBP：sangat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sangat)；本条马来文为组合释义，并非 DBP 独立词条原文。

etymology.historical_story: Sangatkah illustrates Malay grammar working with an existing word rather than creating a new lexical root. Sangat supplies intensity, while the attached particle -kah turns that intensity into a focus of questioning. The combination can therefore sound searching or rhetorical. It should be understood through its components, without assigning it an unsupported separate origin story.

etymology.historical_story: Spassky entered international chess vocabulary as a transliterated Russian surname. Boris Spassky won the world championship in 1969 and faced Bobby Fischer in Reykjavik in 1972. That contest attracted exceptional attention during the Cold War, making the surname recognizable far beyond chess clubs. This explains its cultural visibility, rather than establishing the surname’s deeper etymology. See [FIDE’s account](https://www.fide.com/boris-spassky-1937-2025/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Spassky 的开头 /sp/ 和结尾 /ski/ 连读，同时想象1972年的棋盘对决：这是棋手姓氏，不是棋步名称。

morphology.pattern_note: 在已见的短信式用法中，这是 saya 的非标准缩写，不是加词缀形成的派生词。不能因字母 sy 相邻就认定读作 /ʃa/；若展开为 saya，可读 /sa.ja/。输入没有语境，仍须留意 Sya 也可能是名称。

senses.nuances: 具体词类为第一人称单数人称代词，即 kata ganti nama diri，属马来语广义 kata nama 类。不是独立的标准拼写，也不必然代表口语读音发生缩略。此用法可见于 [DBP PRPM 收录的公众提问及其标准化答复](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Sya)；该页面中的出现不等于 DBP 认可 sya 为标准词条。以下为常见 saya 结构的缩写示例。

Public questions preserved by DBP contain sya where the accompanying standard wording uses saya. This documents informal usage, but does not identify its first writer, date its creation, or establish a separate pronunciation. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Sya).

senses.zh_definition: 退回；后退；由原先的位置或立场向后退让。
senses.en_definition: To move back, retreat, or withdraw from a position.
senses.ms_definition: Kembali ke tempat atau keadaan asal; bergerak ke belakang; mundur.
senses.nuances: 可指实际后退，也可指决心或立场动摇。pantang surut 表示绝不退缩。surut kepada bekas isterinya 所表达的复婚义属于旧式用法，现代通常说 rujuk。义项依据：[PRPM：surut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=128916&keyword=surut)。

senses.zh_definition: 减弱；消退；指愤怒、热情或某种活动的强度逐渐降低。
senses.en_definition: To diminish in intensity or subside.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi semakin kurang atau reda, seperti kemarahan dan semangat.
senses.nuances: 强调强度或程度降低，不一定完全消失。形容热情消退时，semangat surut 常带惋惜或担忧的语气。

senses.zh_definition: 退潮；退水；指海水、河水或洪水的水位下降。
senses.en_definition: To ebb or recede, especially of tides or floodwater.
senses.ms_definition: Turun semula parasnya selepas pasang atau banjir, berkenaan air.
senses.nuances: air surut 可表示正在退水，也可在潮汐语境中指低潮状态；pasang surut 则概括涨潮与退潮，亦可比喻起伏。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect surut with receding water, backward movement, and weakening emotion. These meanings share an image of something pulling away from an earlier level or position. The expression pantang surut turns that image into a declaration of determination. This is a documented semantic connection, rather than evidence identifying the word's earliest origin or a particular borrowing language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 su.rut 联想成“水退”：水位退下、脚步退后、怒气退去，都沿着“向后或向下”的方向记。谐音仅作助记。

senses.zh_definition: 英语 state 的复数：州；联邦内部的成员政治单位。马来语通常对应 negeri 或 negeri-negeri。
senses.en_definition: Plural of state: constituent political units of a federation.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak kata nama Inggeris state yang merujuk kepada negeri dalam sesebuah persekutuan.
senses.nuances: 本条保留为英语形式说明，不能据此把 states 当作马来语词汇教授。ms 栏列出马来语对应搭配，en 栏列出英语搭配。义项依据：[Cambridge Dictionary：state](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/state)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语复数名词：国家；尤其指作为国际政治主体的国家。
senses.en_definition: Countries regarded as political entities.

senses.nuances: 在 sovereign states、member states 等搭配中，states 往往对应 negara-negara，而非 negeri-negeri；须结合组织和政治层级判断。

senses.en_definition: Conditions or forms in which something exists.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau bentuk kewujudan sesuatu, dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 在科学和一般说明中常对应 keadaan；马来语不通过添加英语 -s 表示复数。

senses.zh_definition: 英语 state 的第三人称单数现在时：陈述；说明；明确写明。
senses.en_definition: Says, specifies, or records something explicitly.
senses.ms_definition: Menyatakan atau menerangkan sesuatu dengan jelas; bentuk kata kerja Inggeris bagi subjek orang ketiga tunggal dalam kala kini.
senses.nuances: The report states… 中的 states 是动词，并非“各州”。马来语对应 menyatakan，动词不因第三人称单数而添加 -s。另须区分大写的 the States，英语口语中可指美国。

etymology.historical_story: This spelling belongs to English and combines state with an inflectional -s. Its appearance in multilingual material does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing. For translators, its interest lies in ambiguity: the same spelling can name political units or conditions, or function as a verb. The surrounding sentence determines which Malay equivalent is appropriate.

etymology.historical_story: English sawyer belongs to the vocabulary of traditional timber work. Its historical forms connect saw with an occupational ending, naming the person who cuts timber into usable pieces. The packet supplies no evidence of adoption into Malay, so this English history should not be presented as the history of an established Malay word.

morphology.pattern_note: 整体表示要求安静的嘘声，不作词根词缀拆分。重复字母表示声音延长，不增加音节；shh、shhhh是书写变体，不是派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 嘘！用于示意别人安静、降低音量或不要继续说话。
senses.en_definition: A prolonged hushing sound used to request silence or quieter speech.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi desis yang digunakan untuk meminta seseorang diam, memperlahankan suara atau tidak meneruskan percakapan.
senses.nuances: 实际功能属于感叹词或声音手势；此处按限定词类归入particle。属于非正式写法，不能据此认定为DBP正式收录词目；马来语释义为编辑释义。声音长度、语气和表情决定它听起来是温柔提醒还是不耐烦的制止。英语同类声音的释义与读音参见[Cambridge：shh](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shh)。

etymology.historical_story: This expression represents a sound gesture rather than an ordinary word assembled from meaningful parts. Its extended spelling makes the duration of the hush visible on the page. In dialogue and messaging, it lets a writer reproduce a quieting sound directly. That expressive function does not establish an official Malay dictionary spelling.

etymology.historical_story: Skop offers a useful lesson in identical spelling with different meanings. DBP records both a long-handled shovel and an abstract range of coverage, and identifies English as the source of the scope sense. In an office, skop kerja draws a boundary around responsibilities; beside a pile of sand, context can instead identify a physical tool. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=290296&keyword=skop).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: skop 对应英语 scope：给任务画个“范围圈”。遇到沙土、长柄和铲动动作，再切换到“铁铲”义。

etymology.historical_story: Place names often reveal which language a text was written in. Indonesian official publications use Skotlandia, while Malaysian DBP material also uses Scotland. The forms name the same place, rather than different destinations. For learners, this contrast helps identify regional language conventions; it does not justify treating the ending as a productive Malay suffix. [Indonesian official usage](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/22555/1/Statistik%20Kebahasaan%20dan%20Kesastraan%202021.pdf), [DBP usage](https://dbp.gov.my/wajah-bahasa/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Skot-，联想 Scotland；整词 Skotlandia 记作“苏格兰的印尼语名称”，不拆出虚构词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Setaraf combines the Malay prefix se-, expressing sameness here, with taraf, meaning level or status. Its structure makes an abstract comparison easy to picture: two people or qualifications placed at one level. The dictionary’s educational example shows how the word expresses equivalence without requiring identical qualifications. See [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=setaraf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 想成“相同”，taraf 想成“层级”：站在同一层，就是 setaraf。

messages.en: Only Spidey! They already picked out the red-and-blue one at the shop.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合影迷交流、儿童娱乐及角色名称介绍。正式文章首次出现时可写 Spider-Man（昵称 Spidey），方便不熟悉角色的读者理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 规范书写使用 Spidey；输入的小写形式可保留为检索键。不要把它当作普通蜘蛛的马来语名称，也不要据此认定它是 DBP 收录的规范马来语词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合影迷交流、儿童娱乐及角色名称介绍。正式文章首次出现时可写 Spider-Man（昵称 Spidey），方便不熟悉角色的读者理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 规范书写使用 Spidey；输入的小写形式可保留为检索键。不要把它当作普通蜘蛛的马来语名称，也不要据此认定它是 DBP 收录的规范马来语词。

etymology.historical_story: Spidey belongs to English superhero culture rather than inherited Malay vocabulary. Marvel uses it affectionately for Spider-Man and in entertainment titles. In a Malay sentence, the name can remain unchanged while Malay words supply the surrounding grammar, as in kostum Spidey. This illustrates the use of an international character name without creating a Malay derivative.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 /spaɪ/，联想 spider；Spidey 是蜘蛛侠的昵称，普通蜘蛛则是 labah-labah。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词词基；末尾 -asi 不在此机械拆作本族后缀。首音节 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/；penspekulasi 保留词基开头的 sp-。

senses.zh_definition: 思辨；主要通过思考进行的推究或沉思。
senses.en_definition: Reflective or theoretical contemplation.
senses.ms_definition: Perenungan atau tafakur.
senses.nuances: 这是《Kamus Dewan》列出的义项，主要适合哲学、思想或学术语境；日常新闻中的 spekulasi 通常指未经证实的推测。下列组合是相应领域的自然用法。释义依据 [DBP：spekulasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=spekulasi)。

senses.zh_definition: 缺乏事实根据或充分证据的推测、猜想或结论。
senses.en_definition: An opinion, conjecture, or conclusion unsupported by established facts.
senses.ms_definition: Pendapat, kesimpulan atau dugaan yang tidak berdasarkan kenyataan atau fakta.
senses.nuances: 常见于新闻、公关声明及日常讨论。称某说法为 spekulasi，强调其尚无事实根据，不等于已证明它虚假；spekulasi liar 带更强的批评意味。

senses.zh_definition: 投机：为谋取较大利润而买卖股票等资产，同时承担较大的价格变动风险。
senses.en_definition: Buying and selling assets in pursuit of substantial profit while accepting substantial risk.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan membeli dan menjual sesuatu, seperti saham, dengan harapan mendapat keuntungan besar sambil menanggung risiko besar.
senses.nuances: 属于经济与金融用语，强调为获利承担较大风险。并非所有投资都属 spekulasi，这个词本身也不表示交易违法。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak syarikat meminta orang ramai agar tidak membuat spekulasi mengenai peletakan jawatan pengarah itu sebelum kenyataan rasmi dikeluarkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 公司呼吁公众，在正式声明发布前，不要对该董事辞职一事作出猜测。
dual_scenarios.en: The company urged the public to avoid speculation about the director's resignation until an official statement is issued.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Itu spekulasi je, belum ada pengumuman rasmi pun.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Itu hanya spekulasi; belum ada sebarang pengumuman rasmi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那只是猜测啦，正式消息都还没出。
dual_scenarios.en: That's just speculation. There's been no official announcement yet.
spoken_features: je 对应 sahaja 或 hanya。
belum ... pun 在这里加强“连……都还没有”的语气。
kan 可用于请求对方认同。
tak 对应 tidak；dulu 对应 dahulu。

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Cerita pejabat nak pindah tu spekulasi je, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Cerita bahawa pejabat akan berpindah itu hanya spekulasi, bukan?
messages.zh: 办公室要搬的消息只是猜测，对吧？
messages.en: That story about the office moving is just speculation, right?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, bos pun belum sahkan. Kita tunggu pengumuman dulu, tak payah kongsi lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, pihak atasan juga belum mengesahkannya. Kita tunggu pengumuman dahulu dan tidak perlu berkongsi cerita itu buat masa ini.
messages.zh: 对，老板也还没确认。先等通知吧，暂时别传了。
messages.en: Yes, the boss hasn't confirmed it either. Let's wait for an announcement before passing it on.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论同事、公众人物或未公布的决定时，可说 Itu masih spekulasi，温和指出消息未经证实。直接说 Jangan buat spekulasi liar 语气较重，容易显得在训斥对方。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻分析、信息核实和金融讨论。涉及私生活、健康或人事安排时，应区分事实与猜测，避免把未经证实的说法包装成消息。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论同事、公众人物或未公布的决定时，可说 Itu masih spekulasi，温和指出消息未经证实。直接说 Jangan buat spekulasi liar 语气较重，容易显得在训斥对方。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻分析、信息核实和金融讨论。涉及私生活、健康或人事安排时，应区分事实与猜测，避免把未经证实的说法包装成消息。

etymology.historical_story: Spekulasi belongs to an international word family ultimately connected with Latin speculari, to observe or contemplate. Its meanings make a memorable journey: looking closely becomes thinking beyond what is known, then anticipating uncertain outcomes. Malay dictionaries preserve contemplation, unsupported conjecture, and risky trading as distinct senses. The evidence here does not establish the immediate borrowing route into Malay. [Etymonline: speculation](https://www.etymonline.com/word/speculation)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spekulasi 连到英语 speculation：脑中先猜结果，市场上则押注结果；共同点是结果尚未确定。

morphology.pattern_note: 前缀 se- 的 e 读 /ə/；连接 lari 时保留词根首音 /l/，不发生鼻音同化。整词已形成“平行、相符”等固定词义。

senses.zh_definition: 平行的；线条、山脉等走向相同的。几何学中指同一平面内的直线无论如何延长都不相交。
senses.en_definition: Parallel; extending in the same direction, with coplanar straight lines remaining equidistant and never meeting.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai hala yang sama; bagi garis lurus pada satah yang sama, tidak berpotongan apabila dipanjangkan.
senses.nuances: 可作定语，如 garisan selari，也可作谓语，如 kedua-dua garisan itu selari。比较两者时常用 selari dengan。词义依据：[DBP：selari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=selari)。

senses.zh_definition: 与某项目标、政策、原则或发展方向相符、协调一致的。
senses.en_definition: Consistent with or aligned with a goal, policy, principle, or direction of development.
senses.ms_definition: Seimbang atau bersesuaian dengan sesuatu matlamat, dasar, prinsip atau perkembangan.
senses.nuances: 常见结构为 selari dengan，强调方向或要求相符，并不表示内容完全相同。正式报告中常用于说明措施与目标之间的关系。

senses.zh_definition: 连续进行的；尤指随着事件进程即时展开的解说。
senses.en_definition: Continuous or running, especially of commentary delivered as an event unfolds.
senses.ms_definition: Berlangsung secara berterusan, khususnya bagi ulasan yang mengikuti perjalanan sesuatu peristiwa.
senses.nuances: 这一义项主要见于固定搭配 ulasan selari，通常指比赛或其他事件进行时的即时解说；不宜把所有“连续的”都机械译为 selari。参见：[DBP：ulasan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=ulasan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pelaksanaan program ini selari dengan matlamat kerajaan untuk meningkatkan kemahiran digital masyarakat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项计划的实施符合政府提升民众数字技能的目标。
dual_scenarios.en: The implementation of this programme aligns with the government's objective of improving the public's digital skills.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dua garisan ni dah selari ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kedua-dua garisan ini sudah selari?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这两条线现在平行了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Are these two lines parallel now?
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式。
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
句末 ke 构成口语是非问句。
je 是 sahaja 的口语缩略形式；lah 在回复中表示安抚或强调。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Dua garisan ni dah selari ke? Aku nak hantar lukisan ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kedua-dua garisan ini sudah selari? Saya mahu menghantar lukisan ini.
messages.zh: 这两条线现在平行了吗？我想交这张图了。
messages.en: Are these two lines parallel now? I want to hand in this drawing.

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah selari dah. Hantar je lah.
messages.ms_standard: Kedua-duanya sudah selari. Hantarkan sahaja lukisan itu.
messages.zh: 已经平行了，直接交吧。
messages.en: They are. Go ahead and hand it in.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性标准词，可用于课堂、新闻与公文。向上级指出方向不一致时，可说 Cadangan ini mungkin belum selari dengan matlamat kita“这项建议可能尚未与我们的目标一致”，语气较委婉。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论政策、价值观或团队目标时，说明具体与什么相符，避免只说 selari 而缺少比较对象。日常交流可以使用，但正式书面语应写完整的 ini、sudah 和 sahaja。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性标准词，可用于课堂、新闻与公文。向上级指出方向不一致时，可说 Cadangan ini mungkin belum selari dengan matlamat kita“这项建议可能尚未与我们的目标一致”，语气较委婉。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论政策、价值观或团队目标时，说明具体与什么相符，避免只说 selari 而缺少比较对象。日常交流可以使用，但正式书面语应写完整的 ini、sudah 和 sahaja。

etymology.historical_story: Selari combines the Malay prefix se- with lari, the root associated with running. A useful interpretive image is two paths running in the same direction; this illustrates the meaning rather than proving its historical development. The word also expresses agreement between plans and goals. Its morphological structure is documented in a [Malay Language Centre publication](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/Kertas2_Dian2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lari“跑”想成两条跑道：朝同一方向延伸，就是 selari“平行”；计划朝同一目标前进，就是“相符”。这是记忆图像，不是词源考证。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整单纯词记忆，分为 si.ya 两个音节；字母 y 表示 /j/。没有可据此确认的常用加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 用于盛装和携带饭菜的多层叠式食盒；各层可分别放置食物，也称层叠饭盒。
senses.en_definition: A tiered food carrier with stacked containers for holding and transporting meals; a tiffin carrier.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas makanan berlapis-lapis yang disusun bertingkat untuk menyimpan atau membawa bekalan; juga disebut mangkuk tingkat atau mangkuk tepen.
senses.nuances: 指盛装食物的器具，不是饭菜本身，也不专指某一种材质。与 mangkuk tingkat 同义；在玻璃市的相关饮食服务中仍可见这一名称。参见：[MalaysiaAktif：Siya](https://malaysiaaktif.my/2026/01/siya-tradisi-membawa-kepada-sumber-rezeki/)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tersebut mengetengahkan penggunaan siya, iaitu mangkuk tingkat, sebagai bekas untuk membawa makanan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览重点介绍了层叠食盒作为携带食物容器的用途。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition highlights the use of the siya, a tiered food carrier, for transporting meals.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mak, saya nak bawa siya ni ke pejabat esok, boleh?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ibu, bolehkah saya membawa siya ini ke pejabat esok?

dual_scenarios.en: Mum, can I take this tiffin carrier to work tomorrow?
spoken_features: Mak 是对母亲的亲切称呼，标准对应形式可用 ibu。
nak 是 hendak 或 mahu 的口语形式。
ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式。
dah、kat、je 分别对应 sudah、di、sahaja。
句末 ya 用于柔化提醒或请求。

messages.speaker: Aina (女儿)
messages.ms_spoken: Mak, saya nak bawa siya ni ke pejabat esok, boleh?
messages.ms_standard: Ibu, bolehkah saya membawa siya ini ke pejabat esok?
messages.zh: 妈，我明天想带这个层叠饭盒去办公室，可以吗？
messages.en: Mum, can I take this tiffin carrier to work tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Salmah (母亲)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh. Mak dah basuh, ada kat dapur. Ambil je, tapi bawa balik ya.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Ibu sudah membasuhnya, dan bekas itu berada di dapur. Ambil sahaja, tetapi bawalah pulang semula.
messages.zh: 可以，妈已经洗好了，就在厨房。拿去吧，不过记得带回来呀。
messages.en: Of course. I've washed it; it's in the kitchen. Take it, but remember to bring it home.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身中性，无冒犯意味。面向不熟悉这一名称的人，可补充 siya, atau mangkuk tingkat“siya，也就是层叠食盒”，方便理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于带便当、赠送饭菜和介绍生活器物等情境。借用食盒后宜清洗并归还；向他人赠送食物时，应先了解对方的饮食要求，包括清真、素食或过敏限制。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，无冒犯意味。面向不熟悉这一名称的人，可补充 siya, atau mangkuk tingkat“siya，也就是层叠食盒”，方便理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于带便当、赠送饭菜和介绍生活器物等情境。借用食盒后宜清洗并归还；向他人赠送食物时，应先了解对方的饮食要求，包括清真、素食或过敏限制。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied dictionary entry identifies siya as a tiered food carrier but does not establish its borrowing source or earliest attestation. Its cultural setting is better documented: a [Malaysian government report](https://malaysiaaktif.my/2026/01/siya-tradisi-membawa-kepada-sumber-rezeki/) describes these carriers being used to exchange dishes among neighbours and relatives. In Perlis, the name also appears in contemporary meal delivery, linking familiar household practice with a reusable container.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 si-ya /si.ja/ 时，想象把饭和菜“一层一层叠起来”：siya 就是能叠层携带的食盒。把声音与实物绑定，整词记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无马来语词缀，也无鼻音同化或首辅音脱落；按 sa.lon 两个音节读。未列出未经核实的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 布置雅致、用于接待宾客的房间；雅致会客厅。
senses.en_definition: An elegantly furnished room for receiving guests.
senses.ms_definition: Bilik yang indah untuk menerima tetamu.
senses.nuances: 这是输入所载《Kamus Dewan》第四版义项，附 IB（Indonesia-Belanda）标签。在马来西亚日常表达中，通常说 ruang tamu；salon 的这一义项适合历史建筑或文学描写。它不能直接等同于理发店。参见 [DBP PRPM：salon](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=salon)。

collocations.en: receive guests in the reception room

senses.zh_definition: 在商业招牌或受英语影响的表达中，指提供美发、美容服务的店铺。
senses.en_definition: In commercial naming or English-influenced usage, an establishment offering hairdressing or beauty treatments.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan komersial yang dipengaruhi bahasa Inggeris, kedai yang menawarkan perkhidmatan dandanan rambut atau rawatan kecantikan.
senses.nuances: 本义为实际用法说明，马来文释义为编辑撰写，并非输入中的 DBP 原释义。马来西亚规范马来文通常采用 salun rambut、salun kecantikan；salon 常见于外文店名或混合语表达。参见 [DBP 关于 salon 与 salun 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=salon)。

collocations.zh: 美发店（规范马来文通常写 salun rambut）
美容院（规范马来文通常写 salun kecantikan）

dual_scenarios.context: 历史建筑导览 / 文化报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Salon di kediaman bersejarah itu digunakan untuk menerima tetamu kehormat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那座历史宅邸的雅致会客厅用于接待贵宾。
dual_scenarios.en: The reception room in that historic residence is used to receive distinguished guests.

messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi salon kat bawah tu kejap. Kau dah potong rambut?

messages.zh: 还没呢。等等我，咱们一起去吧。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这个名词本身没有敬称或贬义色彩。向长辈、客户介绍接待空间时，ruang tamu 通常更容易理解；描述历史宅邸时可用 salon。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式文件中，应按所指对象区分会客厅与美容营业场所。美发、美容服务通常写 salun rambut、salun kecantikan；引用含 Salon 的注册店名时保留原名。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这个名词本身没有敬称或贬义色彩。向长辈、客户介绍接待空间时，ruang tamu 通常更容易理解；描述历史宅邸时可用 salon。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式文件中，应按所指对象区分会客厅与美容营业场所。美发、美容服务通常写 salun rambut、salun kecantikan；引用含 Salon 的注册店名时保留原名。

etymology.historical_story: The European word salon comes through French from Italian salone, an enlarged form of sala, meaning a hall. Its association with an elegant reception room survives in the Malay dictionary sense. DBP labels this entry IB, indicating an Indonesian-Dutch connection. For Malaysian hairdressing businesses, distinguish this inherited room sense from the usual standard spelling salun. etymology.historical_story: Suria comes from Sanskrit sūrya, meaning the sun, a word also associated with the solar deity in Indian tradition. In Malay, it connects literary descriptions of sunlight with technical expressions such as tenaga suria and sistem suria. The same inherited word thus serves both poetic imagery and scientific description. [Source: Sanskrit Words in Southeast Asian Languages](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/651).

etymology.historical_story: Semampu is transparently formed from se- and mampu, the ordinary word for being able or having sufficient means. etymology.historical_story: Saheb is a variant of sahib. English dictionaries trace sahib through Urdu to Arabic ṣāḥib, associated with companionship and possession. In South Asian usage, it developed into a respectful male title and became prominent in colonial forms of address. Malay also records the related spelling sahib, but that does not establish saheb as a standard Malay headword. [Collins: sahib and saheb](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/sahib); [DBP: sahib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sahib).

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合家庭出游、返乡、聚餐与节庆问候。邀请某人 sekeluarga 通常会被理解为邀请其家人一同参加，应确保邀请范围与实际安排一致。不要默认每个人都有配偶或子女。

etymology.historical_story: Sekeluarga combines Malay se-, expressing entirety here, with keluarga, family. The World Loanword Database connects keluarga with Sanskrit kula, family, and varga, group, while noting uncertainty about whether the combination was borrowed whole or assembled within an Indonesian language. Modern Malay speakers use keluarga as an independent base; adding se- gathers its members into the familiar idea of the whole family. [Source: World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839391642536).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 se-，想象一个圆圈把 keluarga（一家人）全部圈起来：sekeluarga＝全家，一个也不落。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着在词后的强调语助词，不是派生词缀；suffix 在此仅表示它位于词尾。连接时词根不变，ny 表示单个鼻音 /ɲ/。输入未提供整词分音，按 senyum 加 lah 补为 se.nyum.lah。headword.jawi 按输入保留 سڽوم，但这只对应 senyum；依据 senyum 与 lah 的拼写，完整形式可组合为 سڽومله。[DBP：senyum](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=senyum)、[DBP：lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=lah)、[DBP：语助词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lah)
