etymology.historical_story: Senyumlah brings together senyum, the Malay word for smiling, and the attached particle -lah. The particle adds emphasis without creating a new lexical meaning. A photographer can use the form to prompt a smile, while a friend can use it as encouragement. Its warmth or insistence comes from the relationship, situation, and tone of voice. [DBP：senyum](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=senyum)、[DBP：lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=lah)

etymology.historical_story: Saudari belongs to a Sanskrit-derived kinship pair: saudara and saudari, associated with a brother and sister born of the same womb. In modern Malay, the female term also serves as a respectful way to address someone outside the family. That connection offers a useful cultural image: a word linked to sisterhood can express courteous social fellowship. [Historical linguistic study](https://www.serialsjournals.com/abstract/11605_16._hoogervorst-formatiert_2-11.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Sekarat is traced to Arabic sakarāt, associated with the overwhelming pangs of death. It entered Indonesian as a word for dying, while Malaysian Malay normally uses nazak. Its resemblance to se- plus karat, meaning rust or carat, is misleading: the dying sense does not describe rust spreading through a body. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sekarat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se-ka-rat 分成三拍，联想生命走到最后几拍；只作记忆提示。马来西亚常用对应词是 nazak，切勿用“生锈”解释词源。

etymology.historical_story: Stoking is an adapted borrowing of English stocking. A useful cultural twist lies in its everyday meaning: Malaysian Malay uses it for ordinary socks as well as longer leg coverings. An English speaker picturing only sheer stockings may therefore misunderstand a perfectly ordinary conversation about school socks or sportswear. [Malaysian vocabulary example](https://www.coelang.tufs.ac.jp/mt/ms-en/vmod/v_search_detail.php?id=889&ls=s&rf=3).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到英语 stocking，就联想马来语 stoking；记住它在马来西亚也指普通短袜。末尾 ng 读 /ŋ/，像英语 sing 的尾音。

etymology.historical_story: Sauron belongs to Tolkien’s invented literary world rather than Malay word formation. The Tolkien Estate describes how a requested sequel to The Hobbit expanded into a much larger history, connecting the Ring and the Necromancer with earlier legends. For Malay learners, the useful cultural connection is therefore the story and its characters, rather than an imagined Malay root. [The Tolkien Estate](https://www.tolkienestate.com/writing/the-lord-of-the-rings/)

word_family.gloss: 三角形；马来西亚规范拼写

senses.zh_definition: 三角形：在欧氏平面上由三条线段围成、具有三个顶点和三个内角的图形。
senses.en_definition: A plane figure enclosed by three straight sides, with three vertices and three interior angles.
senses.ms_definition: Rajah satah yang dibatasi oleh tiga sisi lurus dan mempunyai tiga bucu serta tiga sudut.
senses.nuances: 本义对应规范形式 segi tiga。马来西亚正式文本、学校作业及考试应分写；连写 segitiga 不应标为马来西亚官方规范拼写。平面欧氏三角形的内角和为 180°。此处马来文释义为依据 DBP 定义编写的释义，并非逐字引文。规范拼写依据：[DBP：segi tiga](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=segi+tiga)。

etymology.historical_story: The expression makes its geometric meaning transparent: segi refers to a side or angular aspect, and tiga means three. Malaysian spelling treats segi tiga as a compound written in two words. Learning the expression alongside segi empat helps reveal a naming pattern in which the number identifies the figure's sides.

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 表示领属或回指相关事项的条件；suffix 是位置分类，此处不构成新的派生词根。sy 表示 /ʃ/，ny 表示 /ɲ/，连接时无音变。音节为补充分析；输入 Jawi 为词根拼写，完整词形可写作 شرطڽ。

senses.nuances: -nya 可以回指某个人提出的条件，也可以回指某项安排的条件。句首 Syaratnya, … 常用于提出限制，相当于“条件是……”，词性仍为名词。释义据 [DBP：syarat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=8064&keyword=syarat) 综合改写。

senses.nuances: 常见于入学、求职、申请和活动报名。syaratnya 可指一项或多项要求，单复数由上下文决定；并非出现 -nya 就只能解释成单数。

etymology.historical_story: Syarat comes from Arabic sharṭ, meaning a condition or stipulation. Its Malay uses extend across agreements, eligibility, religious requirements, and certain customary payments. The Jawi spelling شرط preserves the Arabic consonantal form, while Malay pronunciation supplies the familiar two syllables sya-rat. Adding -nya connects that requirement to a person, arrangement, or matter already under discussion.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 sya-rat 时想象一道“条件关卡”：满足 syarat 才能通过；syaratnya 就是“它的通关条件”。

etymology.historical_story: Seingat combines se- with ingat, the word associated with remembering. Its dictionary meaning places a boundary around a claim: only as far as someone's memory reaches. In conversation, this becomes a useful way to revisit an earlier event while allowing correction. The connection between memory and limited certainty provides a clearer learning story than an unsupported account of its first historical appearance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住ingat“记得”：seingat saya就是“在我记得的范围内”。把se-想成圈住记忆范围的小圆圈。

morphology.formula: sudah − 字母 u、a → sdh（书写缩略，不是加缀构词）
morphology.pattern_note: 输入的词根标注予以保留；从语言分析看，sdh 是 sudah 的书写缩略，不是独立发音词根。按完整形式读出时为 /sudah/，口语也常说 dah。下列词族属于展开形式 sudah。

senses.zh_definition: sudah 的非正式书写缩略，表示某动作已经发生、某过程已经完成，或某状态已经成立，相当于“已经、了”。
senses.en_definition: An informal written abbreviation of sudah, marking an action as completed or a state as already obtaining.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan tulisan tidak formal bagi sudah, yang menandakan sesuatu perbuatan telah berlaku atau sesuatu keadaan telah wujud.
senses.nuances: 此处 particle 对应助词性用法；展开形式 sudah 在马来语语法中可作 kata bantu aspek。sdh 是文字缩略，不是口头把三个辅音连读；也不能仅凭这些字母排除其他领域的缩写。缩略形式见 WhatsApp 语言研究，完整词义依据 DBP；前者研究对象为印尼语，不作为马来西亚规范认可的证据。[WhatsApp 缩略研究](https://ojs.badanbahasa.kemendikdasmen.go.id/jurnal/index.php/jurnal_ranah/article/viewFile/3614/1945)，[DBP：sudah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=128916&keyword=sudah)

etymology.historical_story: Sdh is formed by removing the vowel letters from sudah while retaining its consonant sequence. Research on Indonesian WhatsApp groups documents this shortening alongside other abbreviated spellings. This explains the graphic mechanism, rather than proving a particular Malaysian origin or date. The full form supplies the meaning; the abbreviation itself has no separate spoken word history established here. [WhatsApp language study](https://ojs.badanbahasa.kemendikdasmen.go.id/jurnal/index.php/jurnal_ranah/article/viewFile/3614/1945)

etymology.historical_story: The sources consulted do not establish a deeper etymology for Malay segan. Its documented meanings nevertheless reveal a useful cultural connection: reluctance to act can arise from embarrassment, restraint, or respect for another person. DBP records these meanings together and lists the bird name separately. This is a semantic learning connection, not a proven sequence of historical development. [DBP: segan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=segan+)

etymology.historical_story: Syarikat belongs to the Arabic-derived vocabulary of partnership and association, related to Arabic sharika, meaning a company or partnership. Malay preserves the broader idea of union alongside the modern business sense. Syarikatnya adds the Malay enclitic -nya, allowing the same borrowed noun to refer naturally to someone's company without marking that person's gender.

etymology.historical_story: The English country name Sweden reached its modern form through northern European language contact, with Middle Dutch Sweden contributing to its history. Earlier English also used Swedeland. Swedish itself calls the country Sverige. Malay uses Sweden as a geographical name, so its spelling should be learned whole rather than divided into imagined Malay roots. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Sweden).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /swiː/ 的长音和瑞典的长冬夜连起来：Sweden＝瑞典。只是联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: English skip goes back to Middle English skippen, probably with Scandinavian connections, although its deeper origin is uncertain. The image of hopping helps explain passing over something without stopping. In Malay conversation, that omission sense fits advertisements, questions and routines; formal Malay expresses it with context-specific words such as melangkau. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/skip), [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=langkau).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /skɪp/ 想成一次短促的“跳”：跳过广告、跳过题目；skip kelas 则是把课也跳掉了。

etymology.historical_story: Sampan belongs to the shared maritime vocabulary of East and Southeast Asia. Its resemblance to Chinese words associated with three planks provides a memorable connection, but scholars have also proposed an Austronesian origin. The direction of borrowing remains disputed, so the Chinese explanation should be treated as one account rather than settled history. [Linguistic discussion](https://languagelog.ldc.upenn.edu/nll/?p=66278)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sampan 听起来像“三板”：想象几块木板组成一艘舢板。这里只是记忆联想，不代表词源已经定论。

etymology.historical_story: English still descends from Old English stille, associated with remaining motionless or fixed. Its temporal meaning developed through the idea of continuing without change: a condition stays in place, so it remains true now. This is English word history; the packet does not establish still as an officially adopted Malay borrowing. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/still)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 still 想成状态“停留”到现在：still tunggu 就是“还在等”，正式马来语换成 masih menunggu。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是附着于词尾的代词成分，并非产生新词义的派生后缀；词干不变，ng /ŋ/ 与 ny /ɲ/ 分属相邻音节。输入的 Jawi 仅对应 sekeliling，缺少 -nya，本条保留原始字段。

senses.zh_definition: 其周围的空间、地方或事物；以所指的人或事物为中心的四周。
senses.en_definition: The surroundings of the person or thing referred to; the area on every side of that referent.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan atau segala yang berada di sekitar orang atau sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh unsur -nya.
senses.nuances: 常用于 di sekelilingnya，表示“在其四周”；-nya 的具体所指须由上下文确定。它不表示该对象拥有周围的一切。马来文释义为依据词干释义与语法组合编写的释义，并非 DBP 对完整形式的逐字引文。词干及词类依据：[DBP：sekeliling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekeliling)。

collocations.en: the people around him or her
the conditions around him, her, or it

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

messages.ms_standard: Amir sudah membaca buku itu sejak tadi. Dia tidak menyedari bahawa orang di sekelilingnya sedang membuat bising.

messages.en: He's always like that when he's focused. Let's just wait outside.

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates Malay word building rather than borrowing. Keliling supplies the idea of going or extending around something; sekeliling denotes the surrounding area. Adding -nya anchors that area to a referent already understood in the conversation. The spelling keeps the pronoun attached, following the Malay convention for enclitic pronouns. Reference: [DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 keliling“绕一圈”：sekeliling 是“四周”，再接 -nya“其”，就是“其四周”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + shake → shake；英语整词进入马英夹杂表达
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词形，不按马来语词缀拆分。标准英语读音为单音节 /ʃeɪk/，末尾 e 不单独发音。输入的 various translations 不是音节数据，故改为 shake。英语动词变化为 shake—shook—shaken。Jawi 按包保留 null；status 为指定模式固定值，不表示此拼写已获确认为标准马来语词。

word_family.gloss: 摇动；发抖；英语分词形式
被摇动；受到震动；英语过去分词

senses.zh_definition: 摇动、摇晃或使物体反复快速移动；也可指身体发抖。
senses.en_definition: To move, or cause something to move, repeatedly with short, quick motions.
senses.ms_definition: Menggerakkan sesuatu berulang kali dengan cepat, atau bergerak sedemikian, termasuk menggigil.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义，可出现于马英夹杂口语；标准马来语依对象选 goncang、goyang、kocok、bergegar 或 menggigil。不是所有情境都可用同一个马来语词对译。[Cambridge：shake](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shake)

senses.zh_definition: 一种搅打或摇混而成的饮料，如奶昔、椰子冰沙或蛋白质饮品。
senses.en_definition: A blended or mixed drink, such as a milkshake or protein drink.
senses.ms_definition: Minuman yang disediakan dengan mengisar atau mencampurkan ramuan, seperti susu, ais krim, buah atau serbuk protein.
senses.nuances: 常见于英文饮品名及菜单；具体配方由完整名称决定，并非所有 shake 都含牛奶。一般 milkshake 可称 susu kocak。[Cambridge：饮料义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shake)

senses.zh_definition: 一次摇动、摇晃或抖动。
senses.en_definition: An instance of shaking.
senses.ms_definition: Satu gerakan menggoncang, menggoyang atau menggetarkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 本义属于英语；标准马来语一般用 goncangan 或相应动词结构。下列搭配是英语表达，不能当作标准马来语搭配。[Cambridge：动作名词义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shake)

senses.zh_definition: 使人震惊或不安；使信心、信念或稳定性动摇。
senses.en_definition: To unsettle someone emotionally or weaken confidence or stability.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang terguncang perasaannya atau menyebabkan keyakinan dan kestabilan menjadi lemah.
senses.nuances: 属于英语比喻义；标准马来语可按情境用 mengejutkan、menggoncangkan 或 menggugat。正式马来语写作应采用合适的马来语表达。[Cambridge：比喻义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shake)

dual_scenarios.ms: Menu baharu kafe itu menyenaraikan minuman bernama "coconut shake".

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Botol tu shake dulu lah sebelum minum.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Goncang botol itu dahulu sebelum meminum kandungannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那瓶先摇一摇再喝啦。
dual_scenarios.en: Give that bottle a shake before you drink it.
spoken_features: shake 是英语动词，与马来语句法混用。
tu 对应 itu；dulu 对应 dahulu。
lah 在此加强提醒。
口语把 botol tu 放在句首作为话题。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak minum ni. Kena shake dulu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak meminum minuman ini. Adakah saya perlu menggoncangnya dahulu?
messages.zh: 我想喝这个，要先摇一摇吗？
messages.en: I'm going to drink this. Do I need to shake it first?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, tutup rapat-rapat, lepas tu shake je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, pastikan penutupnya dipasang dengan rapat, kemudian goncangkan botol itu.
messages.zh: 对，先把盖子拧紧，再摇就行。

etymology.historical_story: English shake descends from Old English sc(e)acan, a Germanic verb. Modern English uses it for physical movement and, figuratively, emotional disturbance or weakened confidence. Its drink sense belongs to the same modern word family. In Malay contexts, the English spelling needs contextual interpretation, particularly when it appears inside a beverage name. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/shake_2), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shake)

In Star Trek, the name identifies an institution whose work includes exploration, science, diplomacy, and defense. Its appearance in Malay discourse is best understood as the use of a fictional proper name. [Official background](https://www.startrek.com/get-to-know)

word_family.gloss: 自发性；自然流露的状态

senses.zh_definition: 自发的；出于自身意愿或当下感受而自然产生的，未经预先安排，也不受他人强迫。
senses.en_definition: Arising naturally from one's own impulse, without coercion or prior planning.
senses.ms_definition: Berlaku atau tercetus menurut gerak hati sendiri, tanpa paksaan atau perancangan terlebih dahulu.
senses.nuances: 重点是自然产生、未经安排，不单指速度快；回答迅速也可能经过准备，未必属于 spontan。修饰行为、反应或表达时常用作形容词；secara spontan 表示“自发地、即兴地”。参见 [DBP：spontan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=spontan)。

senses.zh_definition: 自发发生的；在有关条件下自行产生的，用于描述自然现象或科学过程。
senses.en_definition: Occurring of itself under the relevant conditions, without being externally induced.
senses.ms_definition: Berlaku dengan sendirinya dalam keadaan tertentu tanpa dicetuskan oleh tindakan luar.
senses.nuances: 科技语境中的含义须结合具体学科理解；例如，化学反应具有自发性，不等于反应一定迅速。此义不涉及人的意愿。

etymology.historical_story: Spontan belongs to a European word family associated with Latin sponte, meaning 'of one's own accord'. That older idea links personal willingness with something arising naturally. Malay uses the word for unplanned human responses and self-arising phenomena. The Latin connection explains the shared meaning, although it does not by itself establish the immediate language of borrowing. See [Treccani: sponte](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/sponte/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 联想英语 spontaneous：没写稿、没安排，话就自然冒出来——spontan。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk bahasa Indonesia bagi senapang, iaitu senjata api berlaras panjang yang menggunakan peluru.

etymology.historical_story: Senapan and Malaysian senapang are associated with Dutch snaphaan, an old name for a firearm. Research on Malay weapon manuscripts connects senapang with contact involving Dutch flintlock technology. The borrowed name eventually became a general term for long guns, while Indonesian and Malaysian usage settled on different final consonants. See [research on Malay firearm manuscripts](https://ejournal.usm.my/kajh/article/download/kajh_vol21-no-1-2014_4/pdf/3472).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senapan 和 senapang 配对记：都指长枪；读印尼材料见 -n，在马来西亚通常用 -ng。

morphology.pattern_note: 在等程度比较分析下，se- 表示“一样……”，词根首音 l 保留；lena 中的 e 为 /e/。该分析依据构词规则推导，尚未核实为独立词条。

senses.zh_definition: 在比较结构中，表示睡眠与另一人或另一时候同样酣熟；常见于否定结构，表示睡得没有……那么熟。
senses.en_definition: As soundly asleep as a stated or understood comparison; under negation, not sleeping as soundly.
senses.ms_definition: Sama lena dengan orang atau keadaan yang dijadikan perbandingan.
senses.nuances: 这是根据 [DBP：lena](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=lena) 和 [DBP：se- 的等程度功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=se) 作出的组合释义，不是已核实的独立官方释义。以下搭配及例句为构词示例，未证实其高频性。不能将 lena 的全部义项直接移植到 selena；人名 Selena 另当别论。

etymology.historical_story: Under the supplied root analysis, selena combines the productive Malay prefix se- with lena, a word describing sound sleep. The resulting interpretation compares degrees of sleep, much as other se- formations compare qualities. This explains a possible grammatical reading, not a documented historical origin or independent dictionary entry. A personal name spelled Selena requires separate analysis.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 想成“同样”，lena 想成“酣睡”：tak selena biasa，就是“没平时睡得那么熟”。

etymology.historical_story: A small clothing word can preserve an older wardrobe. Kamus Dewan records sal both as a neck scarf and, archaically, as turban cloth. That pairing links the word to cloth wrapped around different parts of the body. It documents historical usage, but does not establish a particular borrowing route. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=8652&keyword=sal)

etymology.historical_story: English smart has an unexpected connection with pain: its adjective goes back to Old English smeart, associated with a sharp, stinging sensation. Its later meanings include intelligence, stylish appearance and automated technology. Malay conversations can draw on these English meanings, while formal Malay selects equivalents such as segak, bijak or pintar. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/smart)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 smart 联成三幅图：衣着利落、脑筋灵活、设备智能；分别对应 segak、bijak、pintar。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不作马来语词缀拆分；音标为英语读音，th 表示 /θ/。马来语对应形式为 Sabat 或 hari Sabat，未提供的 Jawi 保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 安息日；犹太教每周用于休息和宗教敬拜的圣日，自星期五日落开始，至星期六入夜结束；部分基督教教派也守第七日安息日。
senses.en_definition: The weekly seventh-day observance of rest and worship in Judaism and some Christian traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Hari ketujuh dalam minggu yang dikhususkan untuk berehat dan beribadat dalam agama Yahudi serta sesetengah aliran Kristian.
senses.nuances: sabbath 是英语拼写；DBP 收录的马来语形式是 Sabat，也列有 Sabbat。status 沿用指定数据标签，不表示英语拼写属于标准马来语。本条马来语释义为综合释义，搭配以标准对应词呈现。[DBP：Sabat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=sabat)；犹太教起止时间见 [Chabad：Shabbat](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/633659/jewish/What-Is-Shabbat.htm)。

senses.zh_definition: 某些基督教传统所称的主日安息日，即用于敬拜和休息的星期日。
senses.en_definition: Sunday regarded in some Christian traditions as a day of rest and worship.
senses.ms_definition: Hari Ahad yang dianggap sebagai hari rehat dan ibadat dalam sesetengah tradisi Kristian.
senses.nuances: 这是英语 Sabbath 的另一宗教用法；并非所有基督徒都把星期日称为 Sabbath。翻译时应依教派采用 hari Ahad、Hari Tuhan 或其惯用称呼。[Merriam-Webster：Sabbath](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Sabbath)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻性的休息日或暂停某种活动的一段时间。
senses.en_definition: A period of rest or deliberate abstention from an activity.
senses.ms_definition: Tempoh berehat atau menghentikan sesuatu kegiatan buat sementara waktu, secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 属于英语引申义，不应据此把 sabbath 当作一般马来语“假日”的常用词。标准马来语通常直接表达为 hari rehat 或 tempoh berehat；以下为解释性搭配。[Merriam-Webster：Sabbath](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Sabbath)

etymology.historical_story: English Sabbath traces through Latin sabbatum and Greek sabbaton to Hebrew shabbath, associated with rest. Its history connects weekly religious observance with the broader idea of pausing work. Different traditions apply the term differently, while Malay dictionaries record Sabat as the corresponding religious term. The English spelling should therefore remain distinct from its Malay equivalent. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Sabbath)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sabbath 与马来语 Sabat 连起来，记“安息、敬拜”；末尾 th 是英语 /θ/，不是马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节 e 为央元音 /ə/。meN- + serbu → menyerbu、peN- + serbu → penyerbu 时，词首 s 脱落，鼻音实现为 ny /ɲ/。

senses.zh_definition: 猛攻；突袭；迅速冲向目标发动攻击或执法行动。

senses.ms_definition: Meluru ke arah sasaran untuk menyerang atau menjalankan serbuan.
senses.nuances: 标准主动陈述通常用 menyerbu；serbu 常用于命令、口语或省略式标题，被动形式为 diserbu。执法语境译为“突查、突袭搜查”，不必然表示发生战斗。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=serbu)

senses.zh_definition: 蜂拥而至；成群涌向某人、某物或某处，以争取接近或取得某物。
senses.en_definition: To swarm towards someone or something in a crowd.
senses.ms_definition: Datang beramai-ramai untuk mendapatkan sesuatu atau mengerumuni seseorang.
senses.nuances: 强调多人集中涌来，可用于顾客、歌迷或人群，不必带有攻击性。

senses.zh_definition: 猛冲；突然闯入或冲向某处，可指单个人的动作。

senses.nuances: 强调动作突然或猛烈，不要求多人参与；普通、平静的进入宜用 masuk。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence does not establish serbu’s ultimate origin. Its documented Malay uses connect attacking, rushing into a place, and crowding towards something desirable. That semantic range explains how the same root can describe a military assault and shoppers descending on a sale: the shared image is a forceful or concentrated rush towards a target. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=serbu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人喊着“冲！”涌向同一个目标：有敌人是突袭，有折扣是蜂拥抢购；serbu 的共同画面就是“猛冲过去”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是文学专名，不按马来语词缀规则拆分；通常写作 Sméagol。资料包未提供可核实的音标、音节或爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.en_definition: Sméagol, the original name of the fictional character later known as Gollum in Tolkien's Middle-earth.
senses.ms_definition: Nama asal watak rekaan Gollum dalam karya J. R. R. Tolkien.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学、电影及粉丝交流。用这个名字嘲笑他人的外貌或行为可能构成冒犯；它不是马来语中表示某种人格或外貌的中性称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论作品时直接使用人物名即可；正式文字保留首字母大写，并尽可能保留 é。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学、电影及粉丝交流。用这个名字嘲笑他人的外貌或行为可能构成冒犯；它不是马来语中表示某种人格或外貌的中性称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Tolkien used Sméagol as the earlier name of Gollum, connecting personal identity with the character's transformation. The name belongs to his literary use of Old English, rather than Malay word formation. Scholars discuss links with words for investigating, penetrating, and burrowing; the precise derivation should not be presented as unanimously settled. See [Jason Fisher's philological discussion](https://lingwe.blogspot.com/2012/12/smeagol-whats-in-name.html).

etymology.historical_story: Spesimen belongs to the international scientific vocabulary associated with English specimen. Its ultimate Latin ancestor, specimen, meant an example, indication, or means of recognition and was related to specere, to look. A specimen makes something observable through a representative example. The precise route into Malay is not established by the supplied packet. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=specimen).

etymology.historical_story: Setitik combines se-, meaning one, with titik, which can denote a drop or a dot. Malay proverbial language gives this tiny quantity considerable force: the familiar saying about a little indigo spoiling a pot of milk illustrates how one small fault can damage a larger good. This is cultural usage, not a proposed borrowing history. [DBP: setitik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=setitik)

etymology.historical_story: English speckle is recorded from the fifteenth century and is related to the older word speck. Its small coloured marks are easy to recognise on eggshells, feathers, and fruit. The ending in speckles belongs to English grammar. Its appearance in Malay material should therefore be understood as English usage or code-switching, rather than evidence of an established Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记英语 speck＝“一点小斑”；speckles 末尾 /z/ 像许多小点一起出现。马来语对应 bintik-bintik。

senses.zh_definition: 其来源；该消息、资料或说法所依据的人、文件或其他出处。

senses.ms_definition: Orang, dokumen atau bahan yang menjadi asal sesuatu maklumat atau kenyataan yang sedang diperkatakan.

senses.zh_definition: 其供给来源；为有关个人、机构或活动提供资金、能源或其他所需资源的来源。

senses.ms_definition: Punca yang membekalkan wang, tenaga atau keperluan lain kepada pihak atau kegiatan yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 具体所指必须从前文判断。例如，先谈资金时，sumbernya 可指资金来源；这个词本身不限定为“收入”。[DBP：sumber](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?cari=Sumber&spec=false&type=1)

senses.zh_definition: 其源头或发源处，尤指有关水流的水源。

senses.ms_definition: Mata air atau tempat asal air bagi aliran yang dimaksudkan.

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves a concrete image behind sumber: a spring or well from which water comes. It also records the broader meaning of an origin or source, including financial support. That image offers a useful bridge between physical water supplies and abstract information. Sumbernya combines this noun with attached -nya, whose reference is supplied by context. [DBP: sumber](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?cari=Sumber&spec=false&type=1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sum-ber-nya 分成 sumber“来源”＋nya“其”：看到 sumbernya，就问“它的来源在哪里？”

morphology.pattern_note: se- 表示共同或相同，读 /sə/；词根 tugas 的首辅音 t 保留。音节与 IPA 按标准拼读补写。输入的 توݢس 是词根 tugas 的拼写；完整派生词补写为 ستوݢس。前缀义参见 [DBP：se](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=+se)。

senses.ms_definition: Berkongsi tugas atau menjalankan tugas bersama-sama, terutama dalam hubungan sesama rakan sekerja.
senses.nuances: 核心是共同工作的关系，常见于 rakan setugas；不表示双方职位、级别、薪酬或轮班时间必然相同。setugas 本身不等于名词“同事”，完整短语 rakan setugas 才表示同事。此处马来语释义为依据构词和用例编写的释义，并非输入中 tugas 释义的逐字引用。DBP 的词典材料使用 rakan setugas 表示工作伙伴，参见 [DBP：teman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=teman)。

etymology.historical_story: Setugas is transparently formed from the Malay prefix se-, expressing sameness or a shared relationship, and tugas, meaning duty or task. In the expression rakan setugas, that shared relationship identifies colleagues. The formation connects the vocabulary of responsibility with everyday workplace relationships; it does not by itself establish a particular date or occasion of origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se- 记成“共同”，把 tugas 记成“任务”：共同做任务的人，就是 rakan setugas（同事）。

etymology.historical_story: Simpson commonly belongs to the English and Scottish patronymic naming tradition: Sim was a shortened personal name associated with Simon, and the surname identified a descendant. This historical explanation does not make its ending a productive Malay suffix. In Malay writing, the inherited surname functions as a complete proper name. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/simpson).

word_family.gloss: 作猜想；抱有某种看法或怀疑

senses.zh_definition: 猜想；推测；尚未得到证实的看法或判断。
senses.en_definition: A supposition or conjecture formed without certainty.
senses.ms_definition: Apa yang disangka; dugaan atau kira-kiraan.
senses.nuances: 此义可以是中性的，并不一定涉及对他人的恶意怀疑。sangkaan 强调所持判断尚非定论；jangkaan 常用于预期结果，两者不能在所有语境中互换。义项依据 [DBP：sangkaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sangkaan)。

senses.zh_definition: 猜疑；对某人或某事怀有的怀疑，尤其指尚未证实的负面看法。
senses.en_definition: Suspicion or an unverified adverse belief about someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Curiga atau syak terhadap seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常与 buruk 或 menaruh 连用。sangkaan buruk 表示负面猜疑；不能把所有 sangkaan 都译成“偏见”。此处按教学需要拆分 DBP 同一释义中的猜疑成分。参见 [DBP：sangkaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sangkaan)。

etymology.historical_story: Sangkaan combines sangka with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. Historical accounts connect sangka with Sanskrit śaṅkā, associated with doubt or suspicion. The modern Malay family encompasses both neutral supposition and interpersonal suspicion. Its history helps explain why context matters: a tentative guess and an unkind assumption can share the same underlying root. [Historical reference: Maxwell](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/manualmalaylan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sangka 是“猜、以为”，加 -an 就把猜的内容装进名词盒子：sangkaan＝猜想；接 buruk 则是负面猜疑。

etymology.historical_story: SPA comes from the initial letters of Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Awam. The Malaysian commission was established on 31 August 1957, the day Malaya became independent. Its abbreviation therefore belongs to the vocabulary of public administration and government employment, rather than the history of bathing resorts. senses.zh_definition: 【英语】不久、很快；在现在或所述时间之后不长的时间内。
senses.en_definition: Within a short time after now or after a specified time.
senses.ms_definition: Kata adverba bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud tidak lama lagi atau tidak lama selepas sesuatu waktu yang dinyatakan.

etymology.historical_story: English soon comes through Middle English sone from Old English sōna, which meant immediately. Its meaning later relaxed to a short time afterwards. That shift explains why a modern promise involving soon can leave the actual deadline uncertain. Its appearance inside a Malay message illustrates language mixing, without by itself proving adoption as a standard Malay word. [Etymonline: soon](https://www.etymonline.com/word/soon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: soon /suːn/：把等待时间想成一小段，箭头指向“不久之后”；马来语记作 tidak lama lagi。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留英语词形 stress；马来语规范适应形式为 stres，双写 ss 不表示两个 /s/。此处 IPA 表示马来语口语读法，英语通常为 /stres/ 或 /strɛs/。

senses.zh_definition: 由心理或身体负担引起的紧张、焦虑或压力状态。
senses.en_definition: Mental or physical tension arising from demanding circumstances.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan resah, cemas atau tegang akibat tekanan mental atau fizikal; dalam ejaan bahasa Melayu, stres.
senses.nuances: stress 是英语拼写，常见于马来语夹英语交流；正式马来语采用 stres。此处马来语定义依据规范词 stres 概述，并非把 stress 冒充为《Kamus Dewan》的马来语词头。压力不等同于抑郁症或焦虑障碍。[DBP：stres](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=stres)。

senses.zh_definition: 感到压力大、紧绷或心烦的。
senses.en_definition: Feeling tense, overwhelmed, or stressed.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa tertekan, resah atau tegang; penggunaan predikatif dalam bahasa percakapan bercampur bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 口语 Aku stress 中作状态谓语，意思接近英语 stressed，而非英语形容词 stress。正式表达可用 Saya berasa tertekan。以下搭配保留夹语写法，不作为正式马来语拼写范例。

senses.zh_definition: 力学中的应力，即材料内部单位面积上承受的作用力。
senses.en_definition: Internal force per unit area within a material subjected to loading.
senses.ms_definition: Daya dalaman per unit luas dalam bahan yang dikenakan beban; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah tegasan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语技术词义，马来语工程术语应使用 tegasan，不与心理压力的 stres 混用。以下列出规范马来语对应搭配。[英语词义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/stress)。

senses.zh_definition: 语音中使某个音节或词相对突出的重音。
senses.en_definition: Relative prominence given to a syllable or word in speech.
senses.ms_definition: Penonjolan relatif sesuatu suku kata atau perkataan dalam pertuturan; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah tekanan.
senses.nuances: 常见于英语教学中的 word stress 和 sentence stress。重音的实现涉及音高、时长及强度，并非单纯提高音量。以下列出马来语对应搭配。[英语词义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/stress)。

senses.zh_definition: 强调某一点，使其受到特别注意。
senses.en_definition: To give particular emphasis or importance to something.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan penekanan khusus pada sesuatu perkara; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah menekankan.
senses.nuances: 此义属于英语及夹语表达；正式马来语宜用 menekankan。不能因为心理压力义常见，就把所有 stress 都译为感到压力。[英语词义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/stress)。

etymology.historical_story: English stress developed from Middle English stresse, a shortened form of destresse. Its history connects the idea of pressure with both physical strain and emotional difficulty. Modern English also uses it for spoken emphasis. Malay has adapted the psychological term as stres, while informal messages often retain the English spelling stress, illustrating borrowing alongside everyday code-switching. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/stress).

etymology.historical_story: Segel belongs to a documented network of Dutch loans across Indonesian and regional Malay varieties. Dutch zegel supplied a word for seals and stamps, while some borrowing varieties also used it for food coupons. These linked meanings evoke documents and tokens that authorize or certify something. The word is borrowed whole, rather than formed from Malay se- and gel. [Loanword dictionary](https://pure.knaw.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/458170/Nww_compleet_archief.pdf).

senses.zh_definition: 【英语语码转换】确定的；确信的；对某事没有疑问。
senses.en_definition: Certain or confident that something is true.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percampuran kod dengan bahasa Inggeris: pasti atau yakin tentang sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见于马来语与英语混用的对话；规范马来语对应 pasti 或 yakin。此处马来语释义为解释性转述，并非 DBP 的 sure 词条释义。[Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/sure)

senses.zh_definition: 【英语语码转换】肯定；一定；表示说话者认为某结果必然发生。

etymology.historical_story: English sure came through French forms such as seur from Latin securus, associated with freedom from worry and safety. Its meanings developed around reliability and certainty. In Malaysian mixed-language conversation, the English word can express confidence or accept a request; its occurrence there does not establish it as standard Malay. [Etymological source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sure)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sure 与“心里有数”联想：有数就是确定；别人提出请求时，一声 sure 就是“好，可以”。这是记忆联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Stewart began as an occupational surname connected with the office of steward, a person entrusted with managing another person's household or estate. In Scotland, the hereditary High Stewards made that office especially prominent. The name later became associated with a royal dynasty, but sharing the surname alone does not establish royal descent. Sources: [Stewart family history](https://stewartsofbalquhidder.com/stewart-families/stewart-origins/), [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/dost/stewart).

etymology.historical_story: English someone combines some and one, with forms recorded in Middle English. Its ordinary meaning leaves a person's identity unstated, while a further use describes an important person. In Malaysian conversation it can occur inside otherwise Malay speech through language switching; that context does not make it a standard Malay headword. [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/someone)

etymology.historical_story: Sekecil illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than an independently borrowed word. The prefix se- combines with kecil to establish an equal degree of smallness. In expressions such as sekecil mana pun, that comparison supports a concessive meaning: even something very small still counts. Its structure remains transparent to modern speakers. [DBP 构词说明](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=10&k=se)

etymology.historical_story: Singkatan illustrates a productive Malay pattern: singkat means short or brief, and -an names the resulting shortened form. Abbreviations serve both institutional writing and quick personal messages. DBP's SMS guide connects this everyday practice with established spelling conventions, showing that shortening an expression still requires attention to capitals, punctuation, and the reader's understanding. See the [DBP guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Seruling belongs to a regional musical vocabulary also represented by suling. Bamboo flute traditions show how a familiar natural material becomes a melodic instrument through carefully placed holes and controlled breath. Malaysia's cultural inventory documents a Kadazan-Dusun suling with named finger holes, illustrating the local knowledge preserved alongside the instrument. [JKKN cultural inventory](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/senibudaya/detail/1122).

etymology.historical_story: Seadanya is built from the Malay base ada, meaning to exist or be available, rather than borrowed as a complete foreign word. Its meanings connect available resources with an existing personal condition. At a meal, it can modestly describe what the host has prepared; in a relationship, it expresses accepting someone as they are.

etymology.historical_story: Malay adopted English squad as skuad, a spelling recorded by DBP alongside its English origin. The word serves both organized teams and small units carrying out special duties. In casual mixed-language conversation, speakers may retain the English spelling squad, especially when discussing games or friends. Keeping these spellings distinct helps learners move naturally between chat and formal Malay. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=skuad).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 认识英语 squad 就先抓住“一队人”；写正式马来文时，换成 skuad。

senses.ms_definition: Cabang jalan, sungai atau laluan lain, atau tempat laluan tersebut berpecah, bercabang atau bertemu.
senses.nuances: simpang tiga 指三向路口，常见形状为丁字形或 Y 字形；simpang empat 指四向路口。它不是任何街角或弯道的通称：单纯转弯而没有支路，通常用 selekoh。表示“偏离”这个动作时，标准表达通常用 menyimpang。DBP 还记录了米南加保区域用语 simpang belahan，指迁居分出的宗族支系，不是一般交通义。

etymology.historical_story: The spatial image behind simpang links branching routes with departure from a course. Its word family extends from a physical junction, persimpangan, to menyimpang, which can describe turning aside or departing from accepted teaching. This is a documented connection within Malay usage, rather than evidence for a particular ancient borrowing or historical event. See [DBP: simpang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=simpang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象路牌上写着 simpang，眼前道路分成几条：simpang tiga 三个方向，simpang empat 四个方向。

etymology.historical_story: Suruhanjaya belongs to a small, familiar group of Malay compounds written as single words. Its institutional meaning is illustrated by the Reid Commission, associated with drafting Malaya's independence constitution, and the Cobbold Commission, which examined views in Sabah and Sarawak concerning Malaysia's formation. These examples connect the vocabulary with public consultation and nation building. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=suruhanjaya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suruh（委派、吩咐）联想到“一组人获委派办事”，记住 suruhanjaya 指整个委员会；这只是助记，不是逐字释义。

etymology.historical_story: Selfie developed in Australian English from self and the familiar suffix -ie, with recorded use dating to the early 2000s. Smartphone cameras helped the word travel across languages. In Malaysian conversation, the English form circulates alongside swafoto, the Malay equivalent selected by DBP for official use. [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/selfie) [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=swafoto)

senses.zh_definition: 一颗；一粒；一枚。由表示一的 se- 与量词 butir 构成，用于米粒、珍珠、子弹等小物，也可用于鸡蛋。
senses.en_definition: One grain, pellet, or small individual object, expressed with the classifier butir; also used for an egg.
senses.ms_definition: Satu unit benda yang dihitung dengan penjodoh bilangan butir, seperti beras, mutiara, peluru atau telur.
senses.nuances: 严格语法类别是数词加量词结构；此处 noun 为给定词性列表中的近似映射，不应解释成普通名词。其含义不限定为圆形颗粒，实际搭配受名词惯例约束；sebiji telur 也常见。依据：[DBP butir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=butir)。

etymology.historical_story: Sebutir brings together se-, expressing one, and butir, a word for small units that also functions as a classifier. Its familiar associations range from rice grains in the kitchen to pearls and bullets. The same lexical family includes butiran, meaning details, which provides a memorable connection between separate physical units and individual pieces of information.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 先记一个，butir 再想颗粒：sebutir beras 就是一粒米；两个则拆开写 dua butir。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词；词根末尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，接后缀后归入后一音节。词包把 saingan 标为词根，已依据 DBP 的 saing 派生词系列修正。

senses.zh_definition: 在同一目标、市场、比赛或能力比较中与某人或某方相抗衡的对手、竞争者或匹敌者。
senses.en_definition: A rival, competitor or person or thing that can match another.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang menjadi tandingan atau lawan dalam sesuatu persaingan.
senses.nuances: 可指人、球队、企业或产品，不一定表示敌意。pesaing 更明确指竞争参与者；saingan 也可强调匹敌关系，如 tiada saingan，意为“无可匹敌”。释义据 [DBP：saing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=saing) 转述。

senses.zh_definition: 竞争对手形成的挑战、抗衡或竞争压力。
senses.en_definition: Competition or a competitive challenge presented by a rival.
senses.ms_definition: Cabaran atau tentangan daripada pihak yang bersaing.
senses.nuances: 常见于 memberi saingan 和 menghadapi saingan，侧重对手带来的挑战。需要概括竞争机制或整体过程时，通常使用 persaingan。此为 [DBP：saingan 的 tandingan、lawan 义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=saing) 在常用结构中的语境区分。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 商业或体育语境中通常是中性词。直接称同事为 saingan saya 可能显得竞争意识很强；强调合作关系时可称 rakan sekerja。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合市场分析、赛事评论和竞争关系讨论。saingan 不等于 musuh（敌人）；表达良性竞争时可用 persaingan sihat。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records the relevant saing as a word of comparison: banding, imbang and tanding. With -an, saingan names a rival or match; related forms describe competing and competition. The family provides a memorable cultural lens: a rival is someone measured against you, which need not make that person an enemy. [DBP: saing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=saing).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saing 联想成“赛”：bersaing 是在竞争，saingan 是与你较量的对手；联想仅用于记忆。

etymology.historical_story: English story passed through Middle English storie and Anglo-French estoire from Latin historia. Its narrative meaning therefore shares an ancestry with history. In Malaysian conversation, the English word can appear inside a Malay sentence; social media gives it another familiar setting, while cerita remains the standard Malay counterpart. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/story)

etymology.historical_story: Station entered English through French from Latin statio, associated with standing, a post, or a position. That image helps connect its modern meanings: a place where transport stops, a facility serving a purpose, and an assigned position. English also uses it as a verb for placing people on duty at a particular location. [Dictionary.com: station](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/station).

etymology.historical_story: Malay santun connects refined manners with compassion: DBP records both courteous conduct and a willingness to help others. Its derivatives preserve these associations, with kesantunan naming courtesy and menyantuni expressing compassionate attention or assistance. This cultural connection explains the vocabulary family without claiming an unverified ancient source language or a particular date of origin. [DBP meanings and derivatives](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=santun)

etymology.historical_story: Selaju illustrates how identical spellings can conceal different lexical histories. Its everyday comparison meaning is transparently formed from se- and laju. Separately, Kamus Dewan records an Indonesian-labelled skating use associated with berselaju. That dictionary record establishes a usage distinction, but does not establish the ultimate historical origin of the skating term. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=selaju).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se- 联想 sama“相同”，laju 是“快”：selaju＝一样快。另把 berselaju“滑冰”单独记，避免混义。

etymology.historical_story: The documented Malay foothold of saber is a workshop term: gergaji saber. DBP describes a powered saw whose short, thin blade can cut curves and openings. The English headword also appears separately in its bilingual dictionary. This illustrates how technical vocabulary can enter Malay through a compound without establishing every foreign meaning as an independent Malay sense.

senses.zh_definition: 不直接点明、而以暗示或影射方式表达的讥讽、挖苦或责难；讽刺话。

senses.nuances: 重点在于间接表达批评或嘲弄，不一定使用反话，也不一定带有幽默感。可轻可重；不同于单纯的 gurauan（玩笑），也不完全等同于文学体裁 satira。[DBP：sindir 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=sindir)。

etymology.historical_story: Suffixed to sindir, -an names the indirect remark itself. The proverb pukul anak sindir menantu describes scolding one person while aiming the message at another. That image captures how criticism can travel sideways through an audience. It explains the word’s cultural resonance without assuming that every indirect Malay expression is sarcastic. [DBP: sindir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=sindir).

etymology.historical_story: Sembah connects bodily gestures with expressions of reverence. Comparable forms are documented in Old Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese, and other regional languages. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary groups these under loans, so their distribution alone does not prove common inheritance. In Malay, related forms developed uses involving homage, worship, respectful presentation, and public performance. [Comparative evidence](https://acd.clld.org/valuesets/18577-2bddad4bdf8302fa0a7720440bb09307)

etymology.historical_story: Scowler is an English agent noun built from scowl and the suffix -er: it names the person making the expression. Collins also records a Northern English dialect sense meaning a hooligan. These belong to English vocabulary; neither the transparent suffix nor the dialect meaning establishes that the word has become a standard Malay borrowing. [Collins: scowler](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/scowler)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: scowl 是“皱眉怒视”，-er 是“做这动作的人”：scowler 就是“皱眉怒视的人”。

etymology.historical_story: Sasuke belongs here as a Japanese proper name rather than an established Malay common word. The official Naruto site identifies Sasuke Uchiha, while TBS documents SASUKE as its obstacle-course television format. These distinct references explain why context is essential; neither source establishes a Malay lexical meaning or a Malay derivational family. Sources: [NARUTO](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1856), [TBS](https://www.tbscontents.com/jp/top/aboutus.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到Sasuke先想“名字”，再看上下文：Naruto指佐助，TBS或障碍挑战指节目。

etymology.historical_story: Sirip connects two familiar shapes: a fish's fin and the upright stabilizing surface on an aircraft's tail. The supplied dictionary records both meanings, making the word a useful bridge between biology and engineering. This semantic connection is clear, but the packet does not establish the word's earliest origin or when the aviation meaning entered Malay.

word_family.gloss: 施加折磨或虐待的行为
施虐者；造成折磨的事物

senses.zh_definition: 虐待；人为施加的折磨或残酷伤害。
senses.en_definition: Torture, torment, or cruel treatment inflicted on someone.
senses.ms_definition: Aniaya; penganiayaan.
senses.nuances: 可指肉体或精神上的折磨。词义强于一般的不便或普通处罚；与 penyeksaan 相近，后者更突出施加折磨的行为过程。[DBP：seksaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=seksaan)

senses.zh_definition: 剧烈的痛苦、煎熬或苦难；也可夸张地指令人难熬的经历。
senses.en_definition: Severe pain, suffering, or an experience felt to be agonizing.
senses.ms_definition: Kesakitan; kesusahan.
senses.nuances: 此义不要求存在故意施虐的人，可由疾病、困境或漫长等待造成。日常说 satu seksaan 常是“简直是种折磨”的夸张表达。

etymology.historical_story: Seksaan combines seksa with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. The base belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary, associated with punishment and chastisement. Crawfurd's nineteenth-century dictionary already records seksa with those meanings. Contemporary usage also covers suffering without a punisher, allowing the word to describe both inflicted cruelty and the agony of illness or an ordeal. [Historical dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: seksa 是“折磨、痛苦”，加 -an 把它变成可谈论的一种遭遇：seksaan＝折磨或煎熬。记住末尾 sa-an 分两拍。

etymology.historical_story: Strucker illustrates how names can enter a Malay text without becoming Malay vocabulary. Marvel uses Baron Strucker as a character name, providing one identifiable cultural reference. That occurrence does not establish the historical origin of the surname or identify every lowercase corpus token. Without the original passage, a more specific origin story would be speculative. [Marvel character index](https://www.marvel.com/comics/list/characters/1009169)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是表示第三人称所属关系的附着代词，按本结构归入 suffix，并非派生词缀；接合时词干不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。材料中的 سڤوڤو 是词干 sepupu 的爪夷文；完整形式为 سڤوڤوڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Malay sepupu names a relationship through shared grandparents, whereas Chinese commonly distinguishes the paternal and maternal branches. Adding -nya identifies whose cousin is meant without supplying gender, age, or family branch. The formation illustrates a productive Malay pattern: a kinship noun can take an attached third-person possessive pronoun while retaining its original meaning. [DBP: sepupu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=sepupu) [DBP: pronoun attachment](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kamu+nya)

etymology.historical_story: Malay sumpah connects solemn declarations, firm promises, and curses within one semantic field. Traditional narratives make an oath consequential: words can bind loyalty or bring misfortune when broken. Adding the emphatic particle -lah produces sumpahlah. In everyday conversation, this expression can retain the force of an oath or simply underline sincerity. Its ultimate linguistic ancestry is not asserted here.

etymology.historical_story: Ecuador introduced the sucre in 1884, naming it after independence leader Antonio José de Sucre. His portrait helped turn the currency into a national memorial carried in everyday pockets. Dollarization ended its monetary role in 2000, while surviving notes and coins became historical objects. See the [Central Bank's numismatic history](https://museodelamoneda.bce.fin.ec/index.php/colecciones/monedas-y-billetes/item/30-nacimiento-del-sucre-primeras-monedas-del-ecuador.html).

etymology.historical_story: Surat connects personal correspondence with Malay's wider world of writing: its dictionary family includes menyurat and persuratan. Suratnya adds an ordinary third-person attachment to that established noun; it does not introduce a separate historical root. This compact form lets a letter remain linked to someone already mentioned without repeating their name. See [DBP's word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=surat).

senses.zh_definition: 用于追问是否仅限于前述的人、事物、数量或方式，相当于“只是……吗”“就……而已吗”。
senses.en_definition: An interrogative combination meaning 'only …?' or 'just …?', questioning the limitation expressed by saja.
senses.ms_definition: Gabungan saja dengan partikel tanya -kah untuk menanyakan sama ada sesuatu itu terhad kepada perkara yang disebut.
senses.nuances: 这是 saja 与 -kah 的可分析组合，不宜冒称 DBP 已独立收录本词。saja 被 Kamus Dewan 标为口语；正式表达宜用 sahajakah。语气可中性求证，也可因重音而显出失望或质疑。此释义为组合分析。[DBP：saja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=saja)；-kah 须连写，参见 [DBP：马来语拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Sajakah combines the conversational form saja with the interrogative particle -kah. DBP records saja as a colloquial equivalent of sahaja. The combination illustrates how Malay builds questions by attaching a particle to the expression being questioned. Its meaning depends on what precedes it, while the fuller sahajakah suits more formal wording.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sa-ja 表“仅此”，句尾 -kah 加问号：sajakah＝“就这样而已吗？”

etymology.historical_story: Shahida appears in Malaysian institutional records as a woman's personal name. Such names belong to family and naming traditions rather than productive Malay word formation. A Roman spelling alone cannot establish the original Arabic spelling or distinguish every possible source form. Its precise etymology therefore remains unconfirmed without the bearer's original name spelling.

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是表示第三人称领属关系的后附代词，而非派生词缀；按本结构的字段约定记为 suffix。ny 读单一腭鼻音 /ɲ/，词根不变。原包音节字段为 null；完整词可读作 se.ko.lah.nya。原包爪夷文 سکوله 仅对应 sekolah，完整词按组合应为 سکولهڽ。

etymology.historical_story: The form sekolahnya combines the established noun sekolah with the attached pronoun -nya. Historically, sekolah developed meanings covering an institution, lesson time, and education itself; these remain visible in dictionary descriptions. The attached pronoun then anchors those meanings to a person already mentioned, creating a compact expression whose English translation usually requires a separate possessive word. [DBP: sekolah](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?cari=sekolah&spec=false&type=1), [DBP: -nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tatabahasa+nya)

etymology.historical_story: Sabuk evokes a clothing tradition in which fabric is wrapped and secured around the waist. Kamus Dewan illustrates it through a literary passage involving Tun Menida, placing the object within Malay storytelling. Javanese also records sabuk, but that parallel alone cannot establish a borrowing direction or date. Remember the shared object without inventing a migration story. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sabuk), [KBJI](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/sabuk).

etymology.historical_story: SUV comes from the English initials of sport utility vehicle. Malaysian Malay uses the international abbreviation alongside kenderaan utiliti sukan, including in government procurement notices. It illustrates how a borrowed abbreviation can function as a Malay noun without acquiring Malay affixes. Its letters identify a vehicle category; they do not guarantee four-wheel drive. [Malaysian government usage](https://www.nahrim.gov.my/perkhidmatan-penyewaan-sebuah-kenderaan-utiliti-sukan-suv-pacuan-empat-roda-4wd-awd-bagi-kegunaan-institut-penyelidikan-air-kebangsaan-malaysia-nahrim-untuk-tempoh-36-bulan/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 逐字母读 S-U-V，展开为 Sport Utility Vehicle：把“运动、多用途、汽车”三个概念装进一辆高车身汽车。

etymology.historical_story: Shone belongs to the inherited English verb shine, whose ancestry reaches Old English scīnan. Its changing vowel illustrates the older strong-verb pattern, rather than the familiar addition of -ed. Modern English also has shined, particularly for polishing. Keeping the meaning and sentence pattern together helps learners choose the appropriate form. [Merriam-Webster: shine](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shine)

morphology.formula: se- + kurang → sekurang；表达“至少”的完整形式为 se- + kurang-kurang + -nya → sekurang-kurangnya
morphology.pattern_note: se- 中 e 读 /ə/，词根首音 /k/ 保留。输入 sekurang 不宜直接当作标准独立副词使用；本条义项及例句展示完整形式 sekurang-kurangnya。输入 Jawi 仅为词根拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 至少；不少于某个数目、时长或程度。此义使用完整形式 sekurang-kurangnya。
senses.en_definition: At least; not less than a stated amount, duration, or degree, expressed by sekurang-kurangnya.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bentuk lengkap sekurang-kurangnya: tidak kurang daripada bilangan, tempoh atau takat yang dinyatakan.
senses.nuances: 不能把 kurang 的“不足”直接赋予完整表达，也不能把 sekurang 单独用作“至少”的教学范式。DBP 使用的完整形式见[语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekurang-kurangnya)。此处词性和释义针对完整形式，马来文为编辑释义；status 的 official 不表示截短形式已获规范认证。

senses.zh_definition: 至少还；好歹；用于指出不理想情况下仍然存在的积极因素。使用完整形式 sekurang-kurangnya。
senses.en_definition: At least; used to identify a reassuring or positive aspect of an otherwise unsatisfactory situation.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bentuk lengkap sekurang-kurangnya: setidak-tidaknya, untuk menyatakan sesuatu yang masih baik atau melegakan dalam keadaan yang kurang memuaskan.
senses.nuances: 这是完整形式的语用延伸，不一定涉及可计量的最低数值。用于安慰时须顾及对方感受，以免显得轻视其困难。

etymology.historical_story: This entry illustrates Malay word formation rather than a documented borrowing history. The root kurang concerns insufficiency or a smaller amount, but the established expression sekurang-kurangnya sets a minimum: at least. Reduplication and the surrounding elements must be learned together. The isolated input sekurang should therefore not replace the complete expression in standard teaching examples. [Source: DBP usage guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sekurang-kurangnya).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kurang 是“少”；把 sekurang-kurangnya 整体记成“再少也得有”＝至少，数学提示为 ≥。

etymology.historical_story: Stephanie is a feminine form of Stephen. Its deeper ancestry leads to Greek Stephanos, associated with a crown or wreath. The name illustrates how a historical image can survive inside a personal name after travelling between languages. In Malay conversation, Stephanie identifies a person rather than naming a crown. [Sources: Stephanie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stephanie), [Stephen](https://www.behindthename.com/name/stephen).

senses.zh_definition: 静止的；状态、数值或发展程度保持不变的；停滞的。
senses.en_definition: Stationary or unchanged; showing no movement, activity, or development.

senses.nuances: 可客观描述静态状态，也可批评发展停滞；不一定含有“稳定、安全”的褒义。技术搭配 elektrik statik 指静电，不是电台杂音。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=28648&keyword=statik)。

senses.zh_definition: 静力学：研究物体在力的作用下处于平衡状态的力学分支。

senses.ms_definition: Cabang mekanik yang mengkaji keseimbangan jasad di bawah tindakan daya.

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed statik from English static. Its deeper history leads through Latin to Greek statikos, associated with standing and weighing. That connection helps explain its scientific uses: balanced forces and bodies at rest. Malay also applies the image to everyday situations, such as salaries or markets that show no change. Sources: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=28648&keyword=statik), [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/static).

senses.zh_definition: 梵语词 sindhu：河流、水流，也可指海洋；作为名称 Sindhu 时可指印度河。输入词项在原文中的具体所指尚待核实。
senses.en_definition: A Sanskrit term meaning river, stream, or ocean; as a name, Sindhu also denotes the Indus. Its intended meaning in the supplied Malay data is unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah Sanskrit yang bermaksud sungai, aliran air atau laut; sebagai nama khas, Sindhu juga merujuk kepada Sungai Indus. Makna khusus dalam data yang diberikan belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 此处仅提供已知的梵语释义，不能据此认定它是正式马来语普通名词。它也可能出现在人名或地名中，因此不宜直接统一译成“海洋”。下列组合是解释性用语，频率未经核实；缺失的读音、音节、爪夷文及派生词不予编造。来源：[Sanskrit Dictionary](https://sanskritdictionary.com/?q=sindhu)。

etymology.historical_story: Sanskrit dictionaries record sindhu as a word for a river or stream, with additional meanings including the sea and the Indus. This range connects an ordinary landscape term with a geographical name. It does not, by itself, establish that the spelling became a standard Malay common noun. [Source: Sanskrit Dictionary](https://sanskritdictionary.com/?q=sindhu).

etymology.historical_story: English shot descends from Old English forms referring to shooting and things discharged. Its meanings later spread to sporting attempts and camera images. For Malay learners, an important distinction is spelling: DBP records syot for the cinematographic sense, while shot retains its English spelling in mixed-language conversation. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/shot), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=syot)

etymology.historical_story: The name salmon belongs to an international naming tradition reaching English through French from Latin salmo. Its familiar spelling can hide a pronunciation difference: English usually leaves the letter l silent, whereas the supplied Malay dictionary form divides it as sal.mon. Remember the Malay pronunciation when reading Malay aloud. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/salmon), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=salmon)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于词后的代词性成分，在此可回指前述整体；按字段类型归入 suffix，但不等同于普通派生后缀。连接时词基不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入的 root_word 是直接词基 sebahagian，更底层词根为 bahagi。所给 Jawi سبهاݢين 实际对应 sebahagian，未写出 -nya；此处保留原包值，不将其视为完整词形的已核定拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 其中的一部分；其中一些人或事物。所指整体通常由前文或现场语境确定。

senses.ms_definition: Sebahagian daripada benda, jumlah atau kumpulan yang telah disebut atau diketahui daripada konteks.
senses.nuances: 在 Sebahagiannya rosak 中，sebahagiannya 可作主语，意思是“其中一部分坏了”。它不必表示恰好二分之一；需要准确表达“一半”时可用 separuh。此释义由 sebahagian 的词义及 -nya 的回指功能综合编写。[DBP：bahagi 及其派生词](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=207250)；[DBP：-nya 的语法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hadir+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Sebahagiannya tells its story through Malay grammar: bahagi supplies the idea of division, bahagian names a portion, and sebahagian identifies part of a whole. The attached -nya then points back to something already understood. This lets speakers discuss money, food or groups without repeatedly naming the whole, making a compact bridge between sentences. [DBP](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Makna.aspx?kid=207250)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义串起来：bahagi“分”→ bahagian“部分”→ sebahagian“一部分”→ sebahagiannya“其中一部分”；听到尾音 /ɲa/，回头找它指的整体。

etymology.historical_story: If the token denotes the brand, its history leads to a pencil. Tokuji Hayakawa developed a metal mechanical pencil in 1915; an improved product received the name Ever-Ready Sharp Pencil in 1916. The company name and trademark derive from that product. This history does not establish the meaning of an isolated lowercase corpus token. [Sharp corporate history](https://global.sharp/corporate/info/outline/).

senses.en_definition: Sadly; used to introduce a statement that the speaker finds sorrowful or regrettable.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian penggunaan: digunakan pada awal ayat untuk menyatakan bahawa perkara yang menyusul menimbulkan rasa sedih atau dukacita.
senses.nuances: 如 Sedihnya, bantuan itu tiba terlalu lewat.，属于句子层面的评注用法。它通常不是英语 sadly 表示动作方式时的直接对应；“他伤心地说”宜用 Dia berkata dengan sedih。

etymology.historical_story: The story of sedihnya lies in Malay grammar: a familiar emotion word combines with the versatile ending -nya. Sedih names sadness, while the ending can turn that feeling into an exclamation or a contextually identified sorrow. The dictionary also records a separate sedih meaning sobbing, which should not replace the everyday emotional meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Seamus is the familiar unaccented spelling of Irish Séamus, a name corresponding to English James. Its international relatives include French Jacques and Italian Giacomo, illustrating how personal names change across languages. When Seamus appears in Malay writing, it normally identifies a person rather than acquiring a new Malay lexical meaning. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/shamus).

etymology.historical_story: Stagg belongs to an English surname tradition in which nicknames became inherited family names. Its historical source is Middle English stag or stagge, associated with a male deer and, in some dialects, a young horse. An animal comparison could suggest strength, but modern bearers inherit a surname rather than an animal description. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=stagg)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records suki with the regional label Mn, identifying Minangkabau usage, and connects its meaning specifically with plentiful food. etymology.historical_story: Sum survives in Kamus Dewan as an old literary name for a Siamese vessel. etymology.historical_story: Simón is the Spanish form of Simon, a name transmitted through Greek from Hebrew Shimʿon and traditionally associated with hearing. Its accent marks final-syllable stress in Spanish. When it appears in Malay writing, it identifies a person rather than a Malay lexical meaning; the original spelling helps preserve that person's linguistic identity. [Sources: Simón](https://www.behindthename.com/name/simo10n), [Simon](https://www.behindthename.com/name/simon-1).

etymology.historical_story: English superstar combines super-, expressing exceptional degree, with star in its figurative sense of a celebrated performer. Historical records place entertainment and sporting uses in the early twentieth century. In Malaysian contexts, the English expression is also visible in entertainment titles such as Muzikal Lawak Superstar, illustrating its appeal as a label of exceptional prominence. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/superstar), [Astro programme title](https://corporate.astro.com.my/mediaroom-releases/muzikal-lawak-superstar-kembali-untuk-musim-kedua).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: super 表示“超级”，star 是“明星”：把它想成一颗特别耀眼的明星，即“超级巨星”。这是英语内部的记忆拆分。

etymology.historical_story: Arabic salām means peace and also functions as a greeting. The spelling salaam represents the long Arabic vowel in some transcription traditions and is established in English. Malay uses salam. The shared origin connects the greeting with a wish for peace, but does not make every English meaning of salaam a Malay meaning. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=salaam)

senses.zh_definition: 免受危险、侵害或未经授权进入的安全状态，也指实现这种状态的防护措施。
senses.en_definition: Protection against danger, intrusion or harm, and the measures used to provide it.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan terlindung daripada bahaya atau pencerobohan, serta langkah yang diambil untuk memberikan perlindungan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 规范马来语通常用 keselamatan，某些语境也用 sekuriti。以下搭配保留英语成分，反映夹语用法；正式写作可改为 sistem keselamatan、pemeriksaan keselamatan。释义为编写的马来语说明，并非 security 的官方马来语原文释义。参见 [DBP：security 的马来语对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=security)。

senses.zh_definition: 负责保安工作的人员、团队或部门；口语中也可指一名保安员。
senses.en_definition: The personnel or department responsible for protection; informally, a security guard.
senses.ms_definition: Kakitangan atau bahagian yang menjaga keselamatan; dalam percakapan tidak rasmi, juga merujuk kepada pengawal keselamatan.
senses.nuances: 在叫人联系或询问 security 的口语中，通常指保安人员，而非抽象的安全状态。正式表达按对象用 pengawal keselamatan 或 bahagian keselamatan。参见 [DBP 英马词典：security](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=security)。

senses.zh_definition: 生活、收入或就业具有持续保障的状态，也指由此产生的安心感。
senses.en_definition: Stability or assurance concerning employment, livelihood or personal well-being.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan hidup atau pekerjaan yang terjamin, atau perasaan yakin bahawa keperluan dan kesejahteraan diri terlindung.
senses.nuances: 此义主要随完整英语短语进入夹语交流，不宜把 security 一律译为保安。job security 可按语境表达为 jaminan pekerjaan，financial security 可表达为 keadaan kewangan yang terjamin。参见 [Merriam-Webster：security](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/security)。

senses.zh_definition: 为保证偿还债务或履行义务而提供的财产、款项或其他担保。
senses.en_definition: Property, money or another guarantee provided to secure repayment or performance.
senses.ms_definition: Harta, wang atau jaminan lain yang diberikan untuk menjamin pembayaran balik hutang atau pelaksanaan sesuatu kewajipan.
senses.nuances: 马来语按语境用 cagaran、sandaran 或 jaminan。security deposit 指保证金或押金，不能仅因含有 security 就理解为保安费用。以下为英语金融词语夹用示例。对应词见 [DBP：security](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=security)。

senses.zh_definition: 代表所有权、债权或其他投资权益的金融工具，例如股票和债券；英语复数为 securities。

etymology.historical_story: English security goes back to Latin securitas, associated with being free from care or anxiety. Its meanings now include protection, reassurance and financial guarantees. In Malaysian usage, English security should be distinguished from the established Malay spelling sekuriti. Choosing keselamatan, jaminan or cagaran helps identify the intended meaning instead of treating every occurrence as a reference to guards. Sources: [Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/security), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=security).

etymology.historical_story: If the intended word is Japanese 仙人, its cultural background reaches into Chinese traditions of immortals who withdraw from ordinary life. These traditions entered Japan and developed into local accounts of mountain ascetics with extraordinary powers. This explains the Japanese term's background; it does not establish when, or whether, sennin became a Malay loanword. [Japanese dictionaries and encyclopedias: 仙人](https://kotobank.jp/word/%E4%BB%99%E4%BA%BA-550986).

etymology.historical_story: English safe came through Middle English and Old French from Latin salvus, meaning whole or unharmed. Its meanings connect protection from danger with the secure storage of valuables. In this entry, its appearance inside Malay conversation is treated as English code-switching, without assuming that it is an established standard Malay loanword. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/safe) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=safe).

etymology.historical_story: English snowy continues Old English snawig through Middle English snoui. Its ending belongs to the adjective-forming suffix now written -y, which expresses possession or a characteristic. The word therefore preserves an old, transparent relationship between snow and a landscape marked by it. For Malay learners, bersalji provides a useful semantic comparison, although its prefix belongs to a different language system. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/snowy)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听成两拍 snow-ee：snow 是雪，末尾 /i/ 像给景物披上一层雪，记住 snowy＝有雪的；马来语对应 bersalji。

etymology.historical_story: Sedekat illustrates a productive Malay way of expressing comparison: se- joins an adjective to indicate an equivalent degree. In sedekat mungkin, possibility supplies the limit, producing the meaning 'as close as possible'. This is a transparent Malay formation rather than a separate borrowed word. DBP explicitly accepts sedekat and notes the creative-writing setting of its example. [DBP usage guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=minta+maaf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se- 想成“同等刻度”，dekat 是“近”：sedekat＝近到同一刻度；加 mungkin，就把刻度推到“尽可能近”。

etymology.historical_story: Siapkannya is a transparent Malay formation rather than a separate borrowed word. Its base siap connects two familiar situations: something is ready, or a job is finished. Adding -kan expresses bringing something into that state; attached -nya points back to the object already under discussion. This structure links household preparation with modern workplace instructions.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三步记忆：siap＝好了；siapkan＝把它弄好；siapkannya＝把前面说的那个弄好。

etymology.historical_story: Sacks is an English inflected form rather than a Malay formation. In its ordinary container sense, it consists of sack plus the plural ending -s. etymology.historical_story: Sánchez began as a Spanish patronymic meaning 'son of Sancho'. Such names identified a person through a parent's given name before becoming inherited family names. Sanchez is a spelling without the written accent. Its appearance in Malay discourse reflects reference to people bearing that surname, rather than the creation of a Malay common noun. [Surname history](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/sa10nchez).

etymology.historical_story: The Sanskrit dictionary records saṃdhyā for twilight at either end of the night and also for religious observances associated with morning, noon, and evening. These meanings connect a transition in the day with a time for ritual. Their presence in Sanskrit does not, by itself, establish sandhya as an officially recognized Malay loanword.

etymology.historical_story: If the token represents the name Steinar, it belongs to a Nordic naming tradition rather than Malay word formation. Store norske leksikon traces the name to Old Norse Stein-arr, with a first element meaning stone and a second associated with warrior or spear. This history identifies an attested name, but cannot establish the identity of the lowercase token without context. [Source](https://snl.no/Steinar_-_mannsnamn)

etymology.historical_story: Malay syampu corresponds to English shampoo. The English word traces back to a Hindi and Urdu imperative meaning to press or massage, and its earlier English use referred to massage rather than a bottle of hair cleanser. The modern cleaning sense makes the connection memorable: a familiar bathroom product preserves the vocabulary of a hands-on treatment. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shampoo)

etymology.historical_story: DBP records setimpal under timpal, alongside menimpali and timpalan. The prefix se- contributes a sense of equality or correspondence, giving learners a useful image of two things matching in value or degree. This relationship explains why the adjective works with both rewards and punishments: what matters is whether the response matches the contribution or conduct. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=timpal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 se + timpal 的节奏读，想象天平两端相称：付出和回报对得上，就是 setimpal。

etymology.historical_story: Surname dictionaries associate Snowden with English place names, including locations in Yorkshire and Devon. The traditional explanation connects those place names with Old English words for snow and hill. Such a geographical origin does not identify every modern bearer's birthplace or ancestry. In Malay writing, the inherited surname remains a proper name rather than a translated landscape description. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/snowden)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan distinguishes two homonymous entries: an adjective for tight or obstructed movement, and a noun for fibre. It marks the fibre noun as Javanese in origin. Its examples connect plant strands with rope and sack making, while another sense concerns food. This dictionary history does not support splitting the word into se- and rat. etymology.historical_story: English sarge developed by shortening and respelling sergeant. Merriam-Webster records its earliest known use in 1867, although that date does not establish when it first entered Malaysian conversation. The shortened form turns a rank into a familiar spoken address; Malay already has sarjan for the rank itself. Source: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sarge).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sergeant 的称呼压缩成一声 sarge：短促地喊一声“长官”。这是英语截短形式，不要按马来语拼写逐字母读。

etymology.historical_story: Shotgun combines the English words shot and gun, with shot referring here to the pellets fired by the weapon. Merriam-Webster records the noun from 1776. Malaysian police reporting also uses the English form within Malay sentences, illustrating its local technical use alongside senapang patah without establishing when that usage began. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shotgun), [PDRM](https://www.rmp.gov.my/news-detail/2015/04/23/polis-tahan-pengawal-keselamatan-tnb-terlepas-tembakan-di-bayan-baru).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: shot 在这里联想“一粒粒霰弹”，gun 是“枪”：shot + gun → 霰弹枪。这是英语复合词，不是马来语词缀拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常为表示领属或回指的附着代词，不是派生词缀；按给定分类归入 suffix。ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/，词根不变。headword.jawi 按数据包保留，但 سايڤ 仅拼出 sayap；完整 sayapnya 应写作 سايڤڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 它的翅膀；某只已提及的鸟、昆虫等动物的翼。
senses.en_definition: Its wing or wings; the wings of an animal already identified.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tubuh haiwan yang digunakan untuk terbang, dengan -nya merujuk haiwan yang berkenaan.
senses.nuances: sayapnya 不自行标明单复数，可能指一侧翅膀，也可能指双翼；-nya 的所指由上下文确定。基本词义依据 [DBP 的 sayap 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sayap)。

senses.zh_definition: 它的机翼、侧翼或其他形状、功能类似翅膀的部分。
senses.en_definition: Its wing or lateral extension, especially an aircraft wing.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sesuatu benda yang menyerupai sayap atau terletak di sisinya, dengan rujukan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 可指飞机机翼或物体的侧向延伸部分。必须先明确所指物；并非所有建筑侧楼或侧面部分都必须称为 sayap。

senses.zh_definition: 某组织的分支、派别或侧翼力量。
senses.en_definition: Its organizational wing, faction, or supporting section.
senses.ms_definition: Golongan atau bahagian dalam sesebuah pertubuhan yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 属于 sayap 的组织比喻义。政党青年组织、妇女组织等可称为 sayap；它并不自动带有激进、军事或非法的含义。

senses.zh_definition: 某一方的左、右翼位置、边路队员或侧翼阵容。
senses.en_definition: Its wing position, winger, or flank in a team or formation.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian, barisan atau pemain di sebelah kanan atau kiri sesuatu pasukan yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 体育或阵形语境中，sayap 可指位置、队员或整条边路，具体译法取决于搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 在展翼比喻中，指某人或某机构可扩展的能力、活动范围或影响力。
senses.en_definition: Figuratively, its capacity, reach, or sphere of activity, represented as wings.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, kebolehan, kekuatan atau lingkungan kegiatan yang digambarkan sebagai sayap.
senses.nuances: 常见于 mengembangkan sayapnya，需整体理解为拓展事业、活动范围或发挥能力，不能一律按实体翅膀翻译。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records sayap both as an animal's wing and as a name for comparable structures and organizational sections. Sayapnya adds a reference to an already identified owner. The familiar image of spreading wings also supports figurative descriptions of growing ability or expanding operations. These connected meanings explain the expression without treating it as a separate historical root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分成 sayap“翅膀”＋nya“它的”：看到一只鸟，就把 sayapnya 读成“它的翅膀”；公司“展翼”就是拓展业务。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词在马来语交谈中的语码转换形式，不按马来语词缀拆分；规范马来语拼写为 serius。所列 IPA 为英语读音，马来西亚实际口语读音因说话者而异。输入音节及 Jawi 字段缺失，保留 null。

由 serius 派生：认真程度；严肃性；严重性

senses.zh_definition: 认真的；当真的；确实有某种意图而不是开玩笑的。
senses.en_definition: Earnest or sincere; genuinely intending something rather than joking.
senses.ms_definition: Bersungguh-sungguh atau benar-benar berniat melakukan sesuatu, bukan sekadar bergurau.
senses.nuances: 常见于马英混用聊天，规范马来语写 serius。问 Serious? 或 Serious ke? 时，常相当于“真的？”“你认真的？”，属于省略问句。参见 [Cambridge：serious](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/serious)及 [DBP/PRPM：serius](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=serius)。

senses.zh_definition: 神情或态度严肃的；不嬉笑的。
senses.en_definition: Solemn or thoughtful in expression or manner.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan air muka atau sikap yang tidak bergurau dan tidak riang.
senses.nuances: 描述表情时不一定表示生气，也可能是专注或沉思。muka serious 属非正式混用表达；正式写作宜用 wajah serius。参见 [Cambridge：serious](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/serious)。

senses.zh_definition: 严重的；后果重大、令人担忧或需要认真处理的。
senses.en_definition: Grave, worrying, or potentially harmful; requiring careful attention.
senses.ms_definition: Berat atau membimbangkan kesannya sehingga memerlukan perhatian dan tindakan yang sewajarnya.
senses.nuances: 可指问题、事件、疾病或伤势的严重程度。以下是聊天中的混用搭配，规范写作使用 masalah serius、kecederaan serius，或按语境用 teruk、parah。参见 [DBP/PRPM：serius](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=serius)。

etymology.historical_story: English serious appears in Malaysian conversations alongside its established Malay borrowing, serius. The distinction is visible in spelling: the English form retains ou, while the standard Malay form uses u. Both can convey earnestness, solemnity, or gravity, but only serius supplies the conventional Malay base for the derived noun keseriusan. [DBP/PRPM: serius](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=serius), [DBP spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 聊天看到 serious，先想“认真的／严重的”；写正式马来语时，把英语 ou 收成 u：serious → serius。
