etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels sok IB, linking its recorded usage to the Indonesian–Dutch lexical sphere. Its two meanings belong to clothing and pipework. The dictionary records both without explaining their relationship, so treating them as one historically proven metaphor would be speculative. Remembering a sleeve around a foot or pipe is a learning image, not an established etymology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sok)

etymology.historical_story: An older Malay–English dictionary records menyugar as passing the fingers through the hair, matching the action described in the supplied Kamus Dewan entry. This establishes historical continuity of the meaning, but does not establish a deeper origin. Treat sugar as a whole Malay root rather than connecting it to English sugar. senses.zh_definition: 施陶芬贝格，德国姓氏；在第二次世界大战史语境中，常指参与1944年7月20日刺杀希特勒及政变行动的德国军官克劳斯·冯·施陶芬贝格。
senses.en_definition: A German surname, often referring in Second World War contexts to Claus von Stauffenberg, an officer involved in the attempted assassination of Hitler on 20 July 1944.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Jerman; dalam konteks sejarah Perang Dunia Kedua, lazimnya merujuk kepada Claus von Stauffenberg, pegawai tentera yang terlibat dalam percubaan membunuh Hitler pada 20 Julai 1944.
senses.nuances: 词性具体为专有名词。保留输入的小写检索键，但正文应写 Stauffenberg。它不是普通马来语词汇；所给资料没有其官方爪夷文拼写。IPA 采用德语读法，实际语音中非重读音节可进一步弱化。以下为历史讨论中的自然组合，未核定语料频率。[德国历史博物馆](https://www.dhm.de/lemo/biografie/claus-stauffenberg).

etymology.historical_story: Stauffenberg is a German family name, not a Malay-derived expression. Its prominence in historical discussion comes especially from Claus von Stauffenberg, who placed a bomb at Hitler's headquarters on 20 July 1944. Hitler survived, and the associated coup failed. This historical association explains the name's recognition without establishing a literal etymology for the surname. [German Historical Museum](https://www.dhm.de/lemo/biografie/claus-stauffenberg).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按德语节奏记成“施陶芬—贝格”，联结“1944年7月20日行动”。这是人物记忆线索，不是姓名的字面释义。

senses.zh_definition: 感冒；通常伴随流鼻涕等症状的疾病，在 demam selesema 等表达中使用。

senses.ms_definition: Sakit sejuk; misalnya dalam ungkapan demam selesema.
senses.nuances: 对应《Kamus Dewan》的疾病义。日常英语可有人宽泛地译为 flu，但翻译时不应仅凭 selesema 就判定为医学上的 influenza；一般语境常译 cold。此处解释词义，不据此作疾病诊断。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=selesema).

collocations.en: a cold; a cold with fever

senses.nuances: 对应《Kamus Dewan》的 berhingus 义，可描述人的状态，如 anak itu selesema。此处按状态性用法标为 adjective；不能单凭这一症状义推断具体病因。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=selesema).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性常用词，可用于同事、家人或医患交流。正式请假可说 Saya menghidap selesema；朋友间说 Aku selesema 很自然。

etymology.historical_story: A comparative study of Sanskrit loanwords links Malay selesema with Sanskrit śleṣman, meaning mucus or phlegm. The connection helps explain why the Malay word covers both a cold and a runny-nose condition. This proposed ancestry belongs to historical language contact; modern learners should remember selesema as one complete word rather than analyse its opening as a productive prefix. [Comparative study](https://asianethnology.org/downloads/ae/pdf/a150.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 顺着 se.le.se.ma 四拍，想象“鼻水一滴接一滴”：先记住“感冒、流鼻涕”。不要把开头 se- 单独拆开。

etymology.historical_story: Two distinct histories meet in sabit. The curved cutting tool supplies the image behind bulan sabit, the crescent moon. Separately, Malay borrowed Arabic thābit, meaning established or firm, for the sense associated with proof and guilt. The distinction survives in derivation: menyabit concerns cutting, while mensabitkan concerns establishing guilt or convicting someone. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=sabit)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看形状：镰刀弯，月牙也弯，所以 bulan sabit 是月牙；再分词形：menyabit 割草，mensabitkan 定罪。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Seohyun → Seohyun（韩语专名整词使用）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是韩语姓名的罗马字写法，不按马来语词缀拆分；seo 不是马来语前缀 se-。IPA 标示韩语读音，实际马来语使用者的读法可能不同。

senses.zh_definition: Seohyun，韩语人名或艺名的罗马字写法；在韩国娱乐语境中通常指少女时代成员、歌手兼演员徐玄。
senses.en_definition: A romanized Korean personal or stage name, commonly referring to Seohyun, the singer and actress associated with Girls’ Generation.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas Korea yang ditulis dengan huruf Rumi; dalam konteks hiburan Korea, lazimnya merujuk kepada penyanyi dan pelakon anggota Girls’ Generation.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应写作 Seohyun。输入未提供上下文，不能断定每次出现都指同一位艺人，也不能据此推导姓名汉字或字面含义。本条不表示其为 DBP 收录的马来语普通词。艺人身份参见[韩国电影振兴委员会人物资料](https://www.koreanfilm.or.kr/eng/films/index/peopleView.jsp?peopleCd=20171900)。

etymology.historical_story: Seohyun represents the Korean name 서현 in Latin letters. Its appearance in Malay entertainment writing reflects the circulation of Korean popular culture, rather than Malay word formation. The spelling should therefore be learned as a complete name. The Korean Film Council identifies the performer as Seo Joo-hyun, professionally known as Seohyun. [Source](https://www.koreanfilm.or.kr/eng/films/index/peopleView.jsp?peopleCd=20171900)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 서현 的两个音节 seo-hyun 与人物面孔绑定；整体记名字，不把开头误认成马来语 se-。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词后的强调小品词，并非派生词缀；suffix 在此仅表示其后附位置。规范拼写连写，sakit 的词干不变。headword.jawi 沿用数据包的词干拼写 ساکيت；完整 sakitlah 可写作 ساکيتله。

senses.zh_definition: 疼啊；感到身体或某个部位疼痛，并带有强调、抱怨或提醒对方的语气。
senses.en_definition: Painful or hurting, with emphasis, complaint, or an appeal for the listener’s attention.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa sakit pada tubuh atau bahagiannya, dengan partikel -lah yang menegaskan rasa tersebut.
senses.nuances: 词汇意义来自 sakit，-lah 的效果随语调变化，不固定等于很，也不必然使话语更礼貌。它是可自由生成的组合，不宜当作意义独立的新词。参见[DBP：sakit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=sakit)及[DBP：强调小品词](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)。

senses.zh_definition: 生病了啊；身体不适，并强调这一情况，常用来解释无法参加某项活动的原因。
senses.en_definition: Ill or unwell, stated emphatically, often as an explanation.
senses.ms_definition: Berada dalam keadaan tidak sihat, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 如 Saya sakitlah 表示我身体不舒服啊。具体指患病还是局部疼痛，要看主语、身体部位及上下文；-lah 本身不表示病情严重。

senses.zh_definition: 难受啊；强调精神上的痛苦、生活的艰难或受到伤害的感受。
senses.en_definition: Distressed or suffering emotionally or through hardship, with emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, menanggung kesedihan, kesusahan atau kesengsaraan, dengan penegasan -lah.
senses.nuances: 属于 sakit 的比喻义。表达情绪受伤时往往说 sakit hati 或 sakitnya hati；不能把这些较固定表达机械改写成任何带 sakitlah 的语序。生活艰难的用法较有修辞色彩。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 轻柔语调可以表达求体谅，急促重读则可能显得烦躁。对医护人员或长辈，可说 Saya berasa sakit di sini，再说明具体位置。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合表达真实不适或熟人间的抱怨。正式报告通常用 sakit、berasa sakit 或 mengalami kesakitan；sakitlah 可保留在直接引语中。不要用涉及精神疾病的 sakit 搭配嘲讽他人。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 轻柔语调可以表达求体谅，急促重读则可能显得烦躁。对医护人员或长辈，可说 Saya berasa sakit di sini，再说明具体位置。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合表达真实不适或熟人间的抱怨。正式报告通常用 sakit、berasa sakit 或 mengalami kesakitan；sakitlah 可保留在直接引语中。不要用涉及精神疾病的 sakit 搭配嘲讽他人。

etymology.historical_story: Sakitlah combines the established Malay adjective sakit with the emphatic particle -lah. It does not introduce a separate kind of illness or pain. The interesting feature is conversational: the same statement can sound like a complaint, an explanation, or a request for consideration. Standard Malay spelling joins the particle to its preceding word. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sakit 是疼或病，后面加 lah，就像把感受说成“疼啊！”；语气更突出，病情不因此更严重。

morphology.formula: susul + -an → susulan（随后出现的事物；后续事项）
morphology.pattern_note: root_word 字段依要求保留数据包词目 susulan；实际构词词根是 susul（سوسول），因此 is_root 按构词分析记为 false。-an 构成表示事物或结果的名词；末尾 l 在音节划分中进入下一音节，形成 su.su.lan，词根没有辅音替换。参见 [DBP susul 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=susul)。

senses.zh_definition: 在先前事件、行动或安排之后出现的事物；后续事项、跟进活动。
senses.en_definition: Something that follows an earlier event or action; a follow-up.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menyusul atau datang kemudian.
senses.nuances: 现代常用于行政、医疗和新闻语境。在 tindakan susulan、rawatan susulan 等结构中，susulan 作名词性修饰语，表示“后续的、跟进的”，无需另判为形容词。句首 Susulan kejadian itu 常表达“该事件发生后、继该事件之后”，具体因果关系仍需看上下文。基本义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=234664&keyword=susulan)。

senses.zh_definition: 在原有文件、说明或内容之后补交的材料；补充件、附加内容。
senses.en_definition: An addition, supplement, or attachment supplied after earlier material.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang disusulkan, seperti lampiran atau tambahan.
senses.nuances: 强调补充先前内容，而非单纯表示时间在后。若只是泛指文件附件，lampiran 更明确；只有作为后补材料或与先前文件接续时，susulan 的意义才突出。

collocations.zh: 后补信息；后续补充资料

senses.zh_definition: 古语，主要见于 angin susulan：与船只前进方向相反、阻碍航行的逆风。
senses.en_definition: Archaic, chiefly in angin susulan: a headwind opposing a boat's direction of travel.
senses.ms_definition: Arkaik: angin yang berlawanan dengan arah perjalanan perahu dan sebagainya; angin sakal.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为古语。此义必须与现代“后续、跟进”义分开，不能望文生义理解为顺风。现代通常使用 angin sakal 或 angin dari hadapan。以下属于古义固定组合及其说明性扩展，不是现代高频搭配。

collocations.zh: 迎面逆风的吹袭（古义说明性组合）
collocations.en: the blowing of a headwind (illustrative archaic usage)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是行政和职场中的中性常用词。礼貌催办可说 Mohon maklum balas tentang tindakan susulan，意为“请反馈后续处理情况”；表达清楚所指事项和期限，比只写 Susulan? 更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 医疗语境中，janji temu susulan 指后续预约或复诊安排，不自动表示病情严重。工作中应说明跟进什么、由谁负责及何时完成，避免把 susulan 当作含糊的催促语。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是行政和职场中的中性常用词。礼貌催办可说 Mohon maklum balas tentang tindakan susulan，意为“请反馈后续处理情况”；表达清楚所指事项和期限，比只写 Susulan? 更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 医疗语境中，janji temu susulan 指后续预约或复诊安排，不自动表示病情严重。工作中应说明跟进什么、由谁负责及何时完成，避免把 susulan 当作含糊的催促语。

etymology.historical_story: Susulan is built from susul, the base associated with following, and the noun-forming suffix an. Its modern administrative meaning makes that sequence concrete: an earlier event is followed by another action, appointment, or document. Kamus Dewan also preserves an archaic nautical expression, angin susulan, meaning a headwind, a reminder that established expressions cannot always be interpreted from modern meanings. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=susul).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 susul 想成“跟上前一个”，加 -an 就把动作变成“跟在后面的事项”：tindakan susulan＝上一件事之后的跟进行动。别与 susunan“排列、安排”混淆。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，现代马来语中不拆分为词根与词缀；保留词首辅音组合 /sl/。

senses.zh_definition: 组织、运动或宣传活动用来表达宗旨、立场或号召的简短有力的话语；口号、宣传标语。
senses.en_definition: A short, memorable phrase expressing the aims, position, or message of an organization, campaign, or promotional activity.
senses.ms_definition: Kata-kata keramat yang dijadikan pegangan atau panduan sesuatu organisasi atau kempen; cogan kata atau kata semboyan.
senses.nuances: 强调便于记忆、反复传播和集体认同；不专指广告，也可用于公共宣传或社会运动。slogan 可随活动改变，moto 则常表示较稳定的宗旨。

je 是 sahaja 的口语形式，表示限定或弱化语气。

etymology.historical_story: Malay slogan is an English loan. Its earlier history leads through Scots to a Gaelic expression for an army's cry. A call once associated with rallying fighters developed into a memorable phrase expressing collective purpose. Modern campaign slogans retain that ability to gather people around a shared message. [Dictionary of the Scots Language](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/slogan).

etymology.historical_story: Sachiko illustrates how a Japanese name's pronunciation can remain the same while its written meaning changes. One established spelling is 幸子, combining characters associated with happiness or good fortune and child. Other kanji combinations are possible. Roman letters alone therefore cannot reveal the exact spelling or intended meaning of an individual's name. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sachiko).

etymology.historical_story: English snake continues Old English snaca through Middle English. Related Germanic forms connect the animal with crawling movement. This is an English word history, not evidence that Malay borrowed the word. In a Malay learning entry, the useful distinction is between English snake and Malay ular, even when both occur together in bilingual materials. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/snake).

etymology.historical_story: A Jawi teaching resource hosted by UiTM places subahat beside Arabic shubha, meaning doubt or suspicion. That connection helps explain the dictionary's uncertainty sense. Modern Malay also uses subahat for an accomplice, while legal texts use it for abetment. These meanings should be learned separately; the sources consulted do not establish the precise historical transition between them.

etymology.historical_story: DBP places sejajar in the family of jajar, meaning a row or line. That spatial image provides a useful bridge between its senses: objects occupy one line, people share a level, and plans follow a compatible direction. This explains the semantic connection without asserting an undocumented historical sequence. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sejajar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个 ja 想成并排的两根线：位置对齐、等级相当、方向一致，都能联系到 sejajar。

morphology.formula: saya → sye（非正式短信简写，无词缀）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的词根字段；语言分析上，此处是 saya 的非标准书写变体，并非独立派生词。字母组合 sy 不应在此机械读作 /ʃ/；朗读时恢复为 saya，具体语音随口音而异。

senses.zh_definition: 我：标准马来语 saya 的非正式短信拼写，用于指说话者本人；不是正式书面语拼写。
senses.en_definition: An informal texting spelling of saya, the first-person singular pronoun meaning I or me.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku dalam mesej ringkas bagi saya, iaitu kata ganti nama diri pertama tunggal yang merujuk kepada penutur.
senses.nuances: PRPM 收录的公众提问中可见 sye 与 saya 交替出现，支持此处的短信简写解释，但不构成 DBP 对该拼写的规范认可。[PRPM 公众提问用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bole)。标准词 saya 属第一人称代词，因此此处使用 pronoun，而非将它误归为名词或虚词。[PRPM：saya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=saya)。以下组合是教学示例，未核实频率。

collocations.zh: 我想要；我打算（标准写法：saya hendak）

etymology.historical_story: The spelling sye is attested in informal questions submitted to DBP, where its context identifies it with saya. It illustrates how digital writing can shorten familiar expressions without creating a new dictionary word. The available evidence does not establish its inventor, first appearance, or a single pronunciation, so no more specific origin is assigned.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 聊天里遇到 sye，先还原为 saya＝“我”；正式写作把完整拼写补回来。

morphology.pattern_note: 按外来形容词整词记忆；末尾 -ik 不宜当作本族语中可自由添加的后缀。实际音节为 stra.té.gik，é 读 /e/；syllables 保留输入的 null。

senses.zh_definition: 战略性的；依据整体策略制定，或对达成重要目标具有关键作用的。
senses.en_definition: Based on strategy or important to achieving an overall objective.
senses.ms_definition: Berasaskan strategi atau mempunyai kepentingan dalam usaha mencapai sesuatu matlamat.
senses.nuances: 适用于军事、政策、经营及组织规划；不只是泛指“聪明”或“有效”。常见结构为名词加 strategik，如 perancangan strategik。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=120608&keyword=strategik)

senses.zh_definition: 位置优越的；地点便于到达、开展活动或取得实际优势的。
senses.en_definition: Advantageously situated or conveniently located.
senses.ms_definition: Baik atau menguntungkan kedudukannya, terutama dari segi kemudahan dan akses.
senses.nuances: DBP 将“位置好”这一扩展义标为口语用法。地产广告、商铺选址和日常地点评价中常见；不一定涉及军事或宏观战略。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性且适合正式文件的形容词。向管理层汇报时，最好具体说明目标和优势，避免只用 strategik 作空泛赞语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 评价地点时很自然；评价人则通常改说 mempunyai pemikiran strategik（具有战略思维），不宜直接把 strategik 当作“人很聪明”的同义词。

etymology.historical_story: Strategik belongs to the international vocabulary of strategy. Its English counterpart, strategic, ultimately belongs to a Greek word family associated with military command. In modern Malay, that connection extends beyond warfare into administration, education and business. A useful cultural shift appears in everyday speech: a conveniently placed shop can also be called strategik. [Origin reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/strategik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strategik 与英语 strategic 配对：规划看“战略”，选店看“位置优势”；两者都在寻找有利条件。

headword.status_note: official 在此仅指 DBP《英巫词典》收录的英语词头，不表示 service 是规范马来语拼写。马来语按语境使用 perkhidmatan、khidmat、layanan 或 servis。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词；进入马来语的规范借词拼写为 servis。下列词族展示借入后的马来语形式，并非直接给英语拼写 service 添加马来语词缀。输入 syllables 的 various translations 不是音节划分；英语实际分为 ser.vice。

word_family.gloss: 保养；维修服务；体育发球

senses.zh_definition: 服务；为公众或客户提供的工作、帮助，以及接待顾客的方式。
senses.en_definition: Work or assistance provided to others, especially customers or the public.
senses.ms_definition: Khidmat atau perkhidmatan yang diberikan kepada orang lain; layanan kepada pelanggan mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义及其在马来西亚混合口语中的用法。正式马来语通常写 perkhidmatan；强调接待态度时可用 layanan。以下搭配保留口语中的英语拼写。[DBP《英巫词典》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=service)

senses.zh_definition: 车辆或设备的定期保养、检查与必要维修。
senses.en_definition: An inspection and maintenance procedure that keeps a vehicle or machine in good working order.
senses.ms_definition: Kerja pemeriksaan dan penyenggaraan kenderaan atau mesin supaya dapat digunakan dengan baik.
senses.nuances: 混合口语及非正式信息中可见 service；规范马来语拼写为 servis。保养可以包括换油、清洁和更换零件，不等于只在故障后修理。[DBP：servis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=servis)

senses.zh_definition: 检查、保养或检修车辆及设备，使其保持良好运行状态。
senses.en_definition: To inspect, maintain or repair a vehicle or machine.
senses.ms_definition: Memeriksa, menyenggara atau membaiki kenderaan dan mesin agar berfungsi dengan baik.
senses.nuances: nak service kereta 属于马来语句法中嵌入英语动词的口语表达。正式马来语用 menservis kereta，不能据此把 service 当作规范马来语动词。

senses.zh_definition: 网球、羽毛球等运动中开始一个回合的发球。
senses.en_definition: The stroke that puts the ball or shuttlecock into play.
senses.ms_definition: Pukulan atau hantaran permulaan untuk memulakan permainan atau sesuatu rali.
senses.nuances: 英语体育义；马来语规范术语为 servis。英语拼写可能出现在双语聊天中，正式马来语赛事报道应写 servis。

dual_scenarios.zh: 本报告中的英语术语 service 指客户服务。
dual_scenarios.en: The English term 'service' in this report refers to customer service.

nak 对应 mahu 或 hendak，kat 对应 di，tu 对应 itu。
aku 适用于熟人之间；正式交流可用 saya。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 本条聚焦马来西亚语境中的常见对应，不是英语 service 的全部义项。不要把宗教仪式、公共服务、车辆保养等不同意思一律译成 servis。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人聊天中夹用 service 通常自然；向客户、机关或学校提交正式马来语文本时，应按具体意思换用规范词。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 本条聚焦马来西亚语境中的常见对应，不是英语 service 的全部义项。不要把宗教仪式、公共服务、车辆保养等不同意思一律译成 servis。

etymology.historical_story: English service came through French from Latin servitium, a word associated with servitude. Its meanings broadened to include assistance, public provision and maintenance. In Malaysian multilingual conversation, the English form can appear inside Malay sentences. The adapted Malay spelling servis has established dictionary meanings, but perkhidmatan or layanan is often the appropriate translation of general service. [Etymology reference](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/1059809588)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住三条对应：客户 service → perkhidmatan／layanan；汽车 service → servis；做保养 → menservis。

morphology.pattern_note: ng 表示单一辅音 /ŋ/，如英语 sing 的尾音；音节划分为 sang.si。构成 menyangsikan 时，meN- 与词首 s 结合，s 被鼻音形式 ny 替代。

senses.zh_definition: 心存疑虑的；对真实性、可靠性、诚意或结果缺乏确信的。
senses.en_definition: Doubtful or suspicious; not fully convinced of something's truth or reliability.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa ragu-ragu atau menaruh syak terhadap seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可表示尚未确信，也可带不信任意味；本身不等于已经证实对方有错。常用 sangsi akan、sangsi terhadap 或 berasa sangsi。本条对应输入的 sangsi I；DBP 另列表示认可或制裁的同形名词 sangsi II，不能与本义混用。[DBP：sangsi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sangsi)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Jawatankuasa masih sangsi terhadap ketepatan angka tersebut dan meminta dokumen sokongan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 委员会仍对该数字的准确性存疑，并要求提供佐证文件。
dual_scenarios.en: The committee remained doubtful about the accuracy of the figure and requested supporting documents.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku sangsi lah, harga dia murah sangat.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya berasa sangsi kerana harganya terlalu murah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我有点怀疑啊，价格也太便宜了。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm a bit suspicious. The price is just too low.
spoken_features: aku 适用于熟人交流。
lah 在此突出说话人的保留态度。
harga dia 是口语结构，标准形式为 harganya。
口语以停顿表达因果关系，省略 kerana。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku sangsi lah dengan tawaran ni. Dia nak deposit dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya berasa sangsi terhadap tawaran ini kerana penjual meminta bayaran deposit terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 我对这个优惠有点怀疑啊，卖家要先付订金。
messages.en: I'm suspicious of this offer. The seller wants a deposit upfront.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kalau macam tu, jangan bayar dulu. Kita semak kedai dia je.
messages.ms_standard: Jika demikian, jangan membuat bayaran dahulu. Kita semak maklumat kedainya sahaja.
messages.zh: 这样的话先别付钱，我们先查查他的店就好。
messages.en: Then don't pay yet. Let's just check out the shop first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 saya sangsi terhadap kejujuran anda（我怀疑你的诚实）容易被理解为指责。职场可聚焦事实，说 saya masih sangsi tentang ketepatan maklumat ini（我仍对这项信息的准确性存疑）。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合表达对消息、承诺、交易或证据的保留。它表达疑虑，不应被当作认定他人欺骗的结论；也不要与 saksi（证人）混淆。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 saya sangsi terhadap kejujuran anda（我怀疑你的诚实）容易被理解为指责。职场可聚焦事实，说 saya masih sangsi tentang ketepatan maklumat ini（我仍对这项信息的准确性存疑）。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合表达对消息、承诺、交易或证据的保留。它表达疑虑，不应被当作认定他人欺骗的结论；也不要与 saksi（证人）混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Sangsi offers a useful lesson in dictionary homonyms. The supplied entry describes uncertainty and suspicion, while Kamus Dewan separately records another sangsi associated with approval and sanctions. Identical spelling therefore does not guarantee identical meaning. For learners, the doubt-related family is especially helpful: kesangsian names the uncertainty, and menyangsikan expresses doubting or causing doubt. [Dictionary reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sangsi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sangsi 联想到“尚需核实”：信息还没确认，所以心里 sangsi。只是记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不拆作 si- + nis；派生为 kesinisan 时加 ke-…-an，词根不发生鼻音同化。

word_family.gloss: 冷嘲、刻薄或怀疑他人善意的态度

senses.zh_definition: 倾向于怀疑他人的善意、诚实或动机的；持冷嘲式怀疑态度的。
senses.en_definition: Inclined to distrust other people's goodness, honesty, or motives; cynical.
senses.ms_definition: Cenderung meragui kebaikan, kejujuran atau keikhlasan orang lain.
senses.nuances: 重点是对善意或动机的不信任，通常带负面评价；不同于仅要求证据的审慎怀疑。释义依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=34488&keyword=sinis)，此处为展开缩写后的释义转述。

collocations.ms: sinis terhadap niat baik orang lain

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two connected meanings of sinis: distrust of people's goodness and speech that mocks or belittles. Together, they offer a useful cultural picture: suspicion can become audible in a cutting remark or visible in a smile. The supplied evidence does not establish the word's precise borrowing route, so no particular donor language is asserted here.

That attestation establishes a name bearer, not a Malay lexical meaning or the identity intended by this packet. senses.zh_definition: 【古语】火把或其他用于照明的物件；现代通常用 suluh。

senses.nuances: 词包中的 ark 表示古语，转见 suluh I。日常表达使用 suluh、obor 或 lampu suluh，依所指物件选择。以下采用现代对应词的常用搭配，不将古词 sulu 的组合冒称为现代高频搭配。大写专名 Sulu 不属于本义。[DBP：suluh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=suluh)

senses.en_definition: By reference to suluh I, a classical term for a spy or secret investigator.
senses.ms_definition: Melalui rujukan kepada suluh I: orang yang mencari rahsia, pengintip atau perisik; makna ini berlabel sastera lama pada entri suluh.
senses.nuances: 这是所转见词条 suluh I 的第二义，并非另有 sulu 用例证明其使用频率。古文中须根据上下文判断指照明物还是探子。以下为现代释义词的搭配。[DBP：suluh I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=suluh)

etymology.historical_story: The packet preserves sulu as an archaic cross-reference to suluh. The modern entry recalls illumination with burning materials, including dried coconut leaves, before extending to familiar expressions such as lampu suluh. Its classical spy sense evokes someone who uncovers secrets. These dictionary meanings provide cultural context; they do not establish a dated origin or a proven historical sound change.

etymology.historical_story: Syria enters this entry as an international country name, not as a Malay word assembled from smaller meaningful parts. Malaysian diplomatic writing uses the spelling Syria in accounts of humanitarian cooperation, including aid deliveries after the 2023 earthquake. This provides a documented cultural context for Malay readers, while the precise historical route by which the spelling entered Malay remains unestablished here. [Malaysian diplomatic account](https://www.kln.gov.my/web/guest/-/penyaluran-barang-barang-bantuan-kemanusiaan-ke-syria).

word_family.gloss: 把货物等偷运进去；偷偷引入

senses.zh_definition: 偷偷进入某处，避开他人察觉；也指非法进入某一地区或水域。
senses.en_definition: To enter secretly or unlawfully; to sneak into a place.
senses.ms_definition: Memasuki sesuatu tempat secara sembunyi atau tanpa kebenaran yang sah.
senses.nuances: 标准主动句通常用 menyeludup；潜入某处不一定涉及跨国边界。词根形式常见于口语或新闻标题。马来语释义据 DBP 改写。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup)

senses.zh_definition: 把货物、人员等秘密或非法运入某处；走私、偷运。
senses.en_definition: To smuggle goods or people into a place.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa barang atau orang ke sesuatu tempat secara sulit atau dengan melanggar peraturan.
senses.nuances: 正式及物表达可用 menyeludupkan；口语常省略词缀，如 seludup rokok。秘密引入某种成分的比喻用法也见于派生形式。词根本身不是表示“走私品”的名词，后者用 seludupan。[DBP 派生词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup)

senses.zh_definition: 头部朝前向下冲去；俯冲。
senses.en_definition: To plunge or dive headfirst.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak menjunam dengan bahagian kepala di hadapan.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 收录于 menyeludup 下的较少用义项；现代一般表达宜用 menjunam。不能把这种运动义理解成走私。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=seludup)

etymology.historical_story: Seludup links several dictionary meanings through concealed movement: entering unseen, crossing into a place unlawfully, and secretly bringing something inside. Its derivatives distinguish the person, the activity, and the concealed goods. These connections offer a useful semantic story, but they do not establish which meaning came first or identify a historical donor language.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个音节 se-lu-dup 想成三个动作：藏起来、溜进去、躲好。是记忆联想，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 按分层构词分析，直接基底为 sebati，最终加名词后缀 -an；词根仍为 bati。拼写不发生辅音交替，se- 中的 e 读央元音 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 使混合均匀；使融为一体

senses.zh_definition: 化合物；由两种或以上不同化学元素按一定比例以化学方式结合形成的物质。
senses.en_definition: A compound: a substance consisting of two or more different chemical elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan yang terdiri daripada dua unsur atau lebih yang berpadu secara kimia.
senses.nuances: 马来文释义展开自《Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua》的缩写。《Kamus Dewan》另以较宽泛的“多种元素合为一体”说明本词。现代化学语境须区分 sebatian（化合物）与 campuran（混合物），不能把单纯混合等同于化学结合。[释义来源：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=sebatian)。

dual_scenarios.context: 实验报告 / 科学说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Analisis makmal menunjukkan bahawa sampel tersebut mengandungi beberapa sebatian organik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 实验室分析显示，该样本含有数种有机化合物。
dual_scenarios.en: Laboratory analysis shows that the sample contains several organic compounds.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同学讨论化学功课
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Air tu sebatian, bukan campuran je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Air ialah sebatian, bukan sekadar campuran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 水是化合物，可不只是混合物。
dual_scenarios.en: Water is a compound, not just a mixture.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式
je 对应 sahaja，此处带“仅仅”的语气
dah 对应 sudah
口语可省略判断词 ialah

messages.speaker: Aina (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah siap latihan kimia? Air tu sebatian ke campuran?
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah menyiapkan latihan kimia? Adakah air merupakan sebatian atau campuran?
messages.zh: 你的化学习题做完了吗？水是化合物还是混合物啊？
messages.en: Have you finished the chemistry exercises? Is water a compound or a mixture?

messages.speaker: Hakim (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Sebatian. Hidrogen dengan oksigen tu bergabung secara kimia, bukan bercampur je.
messages.ms_standard: Air ialah sebatian. Hidrogen dan oksigen bergabung secara kimia, bukan sekadar bercampur.
messages.zh: 化合物。氢和氧是发生了化学结合，不是随便混在一起。
messages.en: A compound. Hydrogen and oxygen are chemically combined, not just mixed together.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的科学术语，适用于课堂、实验报告和专业交流。向初学者解释时，可搭配 air 或 garam 等熟悉实例。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 说明化学组成时使用；普通烹饪中的搅拌或配料混合通常用 campuran 或 gaul hingga sebati，不宜一概称作 sebatian。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的科学术语，适用于课堂、实验报告和专业交流。向初学者解释时，可搭配 air 或 garam 等熟悉实例。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 说明化学组成时使用；普通烹饪中的搅拌或配料混合通常用 campuran 或 gaul hingga sebati，不宜一概称作 sebatian。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary places sebatian under bati, alongside sebati, which describes things becoming closely united or thoroughly blended. This family gives learners a semantic bridge into chemistry: separate elements become a chemically united substance. Modern scientific usage makes that union precise, distinguishing a compound from a mixture even though the broader dictionary wording emphasizes combination.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sebati 是“融为一体”；再加 -an，记成“结合成的一种物质”——化合物。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，作为独立词素记忆；开头的 se- 不是马来语前缀。词包音标体现一种实际读法；DBP 的 sékrétaris 标注两个 e 为 e taling。

word_family.affix: 无（相关借词，非马来语词缀派生）

senses.zh_definition: 秘书；负责文书、往来函件、会议记录或组织行政事务的人。主要属于印度尼西亚用语，马来西亚通常称 setiausaha。
senses.en_definition: A secretary responsible for correspondence, records, or administrative work; chiefly Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Setiausaha, iaitu orang yang mengurus surat-menyurat, rekod dan urusan pentadbiran seseorang atau sesebuah organisasi.
senses.nuances: 词包中的 DBP 标签 IB 表明其具有印度尼西亚／荷兰语借词背景。词典收录不代表它是马来西亚公文的首选称谓；本地一般用 setiausaha。具体职位的职责与级别须按所属机构判断，不能一律理解为私人助理。

collocations.zh: 秘书长（印度尼西亚职称）

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Wakil syarikat itu mengadakan pertemuan dengan sekretaris organisasi berkenaan semasa lawatan kerja ke Indonesia.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sekretaris tu maksudnya setiausaha je, kan?

je 对应 sahaja，表示“就是／只是”。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dalam e-mel dari Jakarta tu, dia tulis sekretaris. Maksudnya setiausaha je, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Dalam e-mel dari Jakarta itu, dia menulis perkataan sekretaris. Maksudnya setiausaha sahaja, bukan?
messages.zh: 雅加达发来的那封邮件里，他写了 sekretaris。就是秘书的意思，对吧？
messages.en: The email from Jakarta says sekretaris. That just means secretary, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya. Kalau nak tulis surat rasmi kita, guna setiausaha lah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya. Jika hendak menulis surat rasmi kita, gunakan istilah setiausaha.
messages.zh: 对。我们自己写正式信函的话，就用 setiausaha 吧。
messages.en: Yes. Use setiausaha in our formal letters.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在马来西亚正式信函、职位表和会议记录中优先使用 setiausaha；引用印度尼西亚机构的原职称时可以保留 sekretaris。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 这是职业称谓，不限定性别，也不表示职位低微。称呼本人时使用姓名、Encik、Puan 或适当职衔，避免以职业称谓代替所有礼貌称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在马来西亚正式信函、职位表和会议记录中优先使用 setiausaha；引用印度尼西亚机构的原职称时可以保留 sekretaris。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 这是职业称谓，不限定性别，也不表示职位低微。称呼本人时使用姓名、Encik、Puan 或适当职衔，避免以职业称谓代替所有礼貌称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Sekretaris belongs to the vocabulary carried into Indonesian through Dutch administration. Its Dutch source, secretaris, belongs to the same historical word family as English secretary, associated with trusted written business. This helps explain its familiar international shape. Malaysian Malay normally uses setiausaha for the corresponding role. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sekretaris)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sekretaris 与英语 secretary 联想：都是处理文书的秘书；在马来西亚表达时，再配对记住 setiausaha。

headword.status_note: official 按所要求的条目模板保留；已核实的 sungguhan 义项属于印度尼西亚语口语用法，不据此认定为马来西亚正式书面语。
headword.jawi_note: 保留输入拼写；该拼写对应基词 sungguh，未包含 -an，不应作为完整词形 sungguhan 的已核实 Jawi 拼写。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根拼写保持不变；接 -an 后通常分音节为 sung.gu.han。此处按印度尼西亚语词条分析，不能把基词 sungguh 的所有义项直接移植给 sungguhan。

senses.zh_definition: 真的东西；实际存在而非仿制、玩具或假扮的事物。常置于名词之后，表示“真正的”。
senses.en_definition: The real thing, as opposed to an imitation, toy, or pretence; often used after a noun to mean real or genuine.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang sebenar, bukan tiruan atau mainan; bentuk percakapan bahasa Indonesia yang juga digunakan selepas kata nama untuk menerangkan sifat sebenar.
senses.nuances: 印度尼西亚语词典标为口语名词；不能因此把所有名词后置用法机械标成马来语形容词。马来西亚语境通常用 sebenar 或 betul-betul。该形式见于印尼官方出版的 [《印度尼西亚语—巽他语—井里汶语词典》](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/34665/1/Buku-Kamus19-Lengkap_compressed.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dalam video tu dia cakap 'uang sungguhan'. Maksudnya duit betul ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam video itu, dia menyebut 'uang sungguhan'. Adakah maksudnya wang sebenar?

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dalam video tu dia cakap 'uang sungguhan'. Maksudnya duit betul ke?
messages.ms_standard: Dalam video itu, dia menyebut 'uang sungguhan'. Adakah maksudnya wang sebenar?

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合印度尼西亚语口语、对白引用及跨地区交流说明。马来西亚公文和一般正式写作宜按意思使用 sebenar、benar-benar 或 sungguh-sungguh；不要把 sungguhan 误写成表示“认真态度”的 kesungguhan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这个词本身不失礼，关键是地区与语域是否合适。与印度尼西亚朋友交流时可自然理解和使用，不必纠正对方的本地表达。

etymology.historical_story: Sungguhan combines sungguh with -an and is documented in Indonesian dictionaries as a conversational expression for something real. It can distinguish an actual object from a toy or imitation. The supplied Malay definition belongs to sungguh, its base, rather than automatically establishing the derived form as standard Malaysian usage. This distinction matters when adapting Indonesian dialogue for Malaysian readers. [Official Indonesian dictionary](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/34665/1/Buku-Kamus19-Lengkap_compressed.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sungguh 抓住“真”，sungguhan 记成“来真的、真东西”；在马来西亚表达“真正的”，优先想到 sebenar。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词基处理；其历史成分不是现代马来语词缀。字母 c 读 /tʃ/，不是 /k/。

senses.zh_definition: 喜悦、欢欣或内心愉快的感受。

senses.nuances: 强调喜悦这种感受。dengan sukacita 整个介词短语可作状语，表示欣然或高兴地；这不要求把 sukacita 本身另立为副词。

普通随意聊天中，表达高兴通常更常用 gembira 或 seronok。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于传达好消息或令人欣慰的结果。朋友聊天中直接使用可能显得书面或故作郑重；通知不幸事件时应选择符合情境的措辞。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合正式通知、祝贺和表达欣慰。Sukacita dimaklumkan bahawa… 是常见礼貌句式，不必逐字译成强烈兴奋。

etymology.historical_story: Sukacita traces to Sanskrit sukhacitta, combining sukha, associated with happiness or ease, and citta, referring to the mind or heart. That older image of a contented mind remains useful for understanding the Malay word. Today, it expresses personal gladness and also supplies the courteous tone of announcements conveying welcome news. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sukacita)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 su-ka-ci-ta 连成一句提示：心里舒服，喜气来到。记住是内心欢喜；这里的 cita 不表示 cita-cita 的理想。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 实为附着代词，按本结构归入 suffix；与 senarai 连写，词根不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi 为词根拼写，完整构形为 سنارايڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或它的清单、名单或目录；也可指上文已提及事项的那份清单。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its list; the list associated with something already mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Senarai milik atau yang berkaitan dengan seseorang atau sesuatu yang telah disebut, iaitu catatan nama, perkara dan sebagainya yang disusun mengikut urutan tertentu.
senses.nuances: -nya 的指代由上下文决定，不标明性别，也不表示复数。用于承接已知事项时，中文常自然译为“清单”或“那份清单”，无需硬译成“它的”。本义项由 DBP 的词根释义及 -nya 的语法功能综合而成，并非独立词条原文。参见 [DBP：senarai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=senarai) 与 [DBP：-nya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hari+an+nya)。

etymology.historical_story: Snoopy first appeared in Peanuts on 4 October 1950. His creator, Charles M. Schulz, drew inspiration from dogs in his own life, especially his childhood dog Spike. The character's name travels into Malay conversation as a proper name, particularly when people discuss comics, cartoons, toys, and gifts. Sources: [Peanuts](https://www.peanuts.com/about/snoopy), [Schulz Museum](https://schulzmuseum.org/about-schulz/frequently-asked-questions/).

etymology.historical_story: Sanctuary entered English through French from Latin sanctuarium, a word connected with sanctus, meaning holy. Its religious background helps connect its modern meanings: a sacred place, somewhere offering refuge, and a protected area for wildlife. The common thread is a space set apart where its occupants should be safe from disturbance. [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries: sanctuary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/sanctuary)

senses.en_definition: The feeling or state of being unhappy or sorrowful.
senses.ms_definition: Perasaan sedih atau dukacita, misalnya akibat kehilangan, kekecewaan atau sesuatu yang tidak menyenangkan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语名词，不能据此视为标准马来语普通词。标准马来语通常用 kesedihan 或 dukacita。此处 official 仅沿用指定模板，不表示获得 DBP 马来语词项认证；马来语释义为编写的对译释义，搭配栏也提供马来语对应表达。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/sadness)。

senses.zh_definition: 令人悲伤或遗憾的事情、处境或某一方面。
senses.en_definition: An event, circumstance or aspect of a situation that causes sorrow or regret.
senses.ms_definition: Perkara, keadaan atau aspek sesuatu situasi yang menimbulkan kesedihan atau rasa dukacita.
senses.nuances: 英语中的可数用法，可用复数 sadnesses；比表示情绪的不可数用法少见。马来语通常改用 perkara yang menyedihkan 等表达。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/sadness)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场培训 / 英语词汇说明

dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份培训材料中，英语单词 sadness 译为“悲伤”。
dual_scenarios.en: In this training material, the English word sadness is translated into Malay as kesedihan.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sadness tu maksudnya rasa sedih, kan?

dual_scenarios.en: Sadness means feeling sad, right?

句末 kan 用于寻求确认
英语目标词以讨论对象的身份嵌入马来语

messages.zh: 我想确认一下 sadness 的意思，就是难过的感觉，对吧？
messages.en: I want to check what sadness means. It means feeling sad, right?

messages.en: Yes, that's right. In Malay, just use kesedihan.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式马来语沟通宜用 kesedihan 或 dukacita；与熟悉英语的朋友交流时可以切换语言，但应考虑对方是否理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 慰问时可说 Saya turut bersedih atas kehilangan anda。不要把别人表达的悲伤当作矫情，也不要用一个情绪词推断对方的健康状况。

etymology.historical_story: Sadness is an English formation combining sad with the noun-forming suffix -ness. Its adjective has a surprising history: Old English sæd referred to being full or having had enough. Later senses included seriousness and heaviness before the familiar emotional meaning became established. This history belongs to English, rather than demonstrating a Malay borrowing. See [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/sad).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先听出 sad /sæd/“难过”，再把 -ness /nəs/ 看作把状态装进名词盒子：sadness＝悲伤这种感觉。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 接在 senarai 后，词首 s 保留。常用于祈使句，也用于 saya senaraikan、anda senaraikan 等结构。带 meN- 的主动形式为 menyenaraikan，其中词首 s 被替换为 ny [ɲ]。输入的 سناراي 是词根 senarai 的爪夷文；完整派生词补写为 سنارايکن。

senses.zh_definition: 逐项列出；把姓名、事项或资料写成清单。
senses.en_definition: To list or itemize names, facts or other information.
senses.ms_definition: Menuliskan nama, perkara atau maklumat satu demi satu dalam bentuk senarai.
senses.nuances: 常见于考试题、表格和工作指示，要求逐项列举，通常不要求展开论述。它是 senarai 的 -kan 派生形式，不应把词根的名词释义直接套用为动词释义。马来语释义为依据输入 DBP 材料编写的规范释义，并非逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 把人或事物列入指定名单、名录或清单。
senses.en_definition: To include someone or something in a specified list or register.
senses.ms_definition: Memasukkan nama seseorang atau sesuatu perkara ke dalam senarai tertentu.
senses.nuances: 强调纳入某份名单，常用 dalam 或 ke dalam 指明名单。列入候选名单不等于最终获选，列入清单也不等于获得批准。相关派生词及列录义参见：[DBP PRPM：penyenaraian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyenaraian)。

etymology.historical_story: Senaraikan has a transparent modern structure: senarai, meaning a list, takes the verbal suffix -kan. The resulting form is useful wherever information must be organized item by item, including classroom instructions and administrative requests. This explains its present formation and function; it does not establish the deeper historical origin of senarai.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: senarai 是清单，接上 -kan 就是让内容成为清单：senarai + -kan → senaraikan，逐项列出来。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，无词缀变化；植物名见固定组合 bunga siam。专名 Siam 须大写。

word_family.gloss: 金合欢；固定植物名，非派生词
暹罗族社群；专名搭配，非派生词

senses.zh_definition: 用于植物名 bunga siam，指金合欢，亦称 pokok lasana。
senses.en_definition: In bunga siam, sweet acacia, also called pokok lasana.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam rangkai kata bunga siam, sejenis tumbuhan renek yang juga disebut pokok lasana, Acacia farnesiana.
senses.nuances: 本义须连同 bunga 理解，不宜把单独的 siam 当作通用的“花”或“灌木”。DBP 使用学名 Acacia farnesiana；Kew 现将其列为 Vachellia farnesiana 的异名。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=siam)、[Kew](https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn%3Alsid%3Aipni.org%3Anames%3A470307-1)。

senses.zh_definition: Siam：暹罗，泰国的历史国名；亦用于指称马来西亚的暹罗族社群。
senses.en_definition: Siam, the historical name of Thailand; also used in references to Malaysia's Siamese community.
senses.ms_definition: Siam ialah nama lama bagi Thailand; nama ini juga digunakan untuk merujuk kepada masyarakat Siam di Malaysia.
senses.nuances: 此义写作 Siam，与小写植物词条区分。现代国家名称通常写 Thailand；masyarakat Siam 可指马来西亚本地社群，不能一概译成“泰国移民”。[马来亚大学](https://studentsrepo.um.edu.my/7518/9/chaiwat.pdf)、[马来西亚国会](https://hansard.parlimen.gov.my/hansard/dewan-negara/2018-08-28)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay preserves siam in the plant name bunga siam, which Kamus Dewan identifies as sweet acacia. A geographical-looking plant name does not establish where a species originated: Kew places this species' native range in tropical and subtropical America. The precise naming history of bunga siam is not established by these sources. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=siam), [Kew](https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn%3Alsid%3Aipni.org%3Anames%3A1099713-2/general-information).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看搭档：bunga siam 记“金合欢”，大写 Siam 记“暹罗”；不要只凭 siam 猜意思。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling shan cannot support a reliable origin story by itself. A name, a foreign-language expression, and a transcription error can share the same letters while having unrelated histories. Here, the responsible lexicographic record preserves the supplied form and leaves its origin open until an original sentence, identifiable referent, or documented language source establishes what it represents.

senses.zh_definition: 童军运动的成员；此义英语常写作 Scout，标准马来语为 pengakap。
senses.en_definition: A member of a Scouting organization.

senses.zh_definition: 被派去实地侦察、观察并搜集情报的人员。
senses.en_definition: A person sent to observe an area or opponent and gather information.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang dihantar untuk meninjau sesuatu kawasan atau pihak lawan bagi mendapatkan maklumat.
senses.nuances: 标准马来语通常用 peninjau；不能一律译成带秘密刺探含义的 pengintip。义项依据 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/scout)。搭配为带英语词的说明性组合，未作马来语词频验证。

senses.zh_definition: 通过观察表现来发掘、评估并推荐人才的人，尤指体育或演艺领域的选才人员。
senses.en_definition: A person who identifies and evaluates promising talent, especially in sport or entertainment.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mencari dan menilai individu berbakat untuk disyorkan kepada pasukan atau organisasi.
senses.nuances: 可按情境译为 pencari bakat；足球语境中指球探。义项依据 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/scout)。下列含英语词的组合用于展示语境，不主张其为正式马来语术语。

senses.zh_definition: 实地查看、搜寻或物色，以获得资料或找到合适的人选、地点。
senses.en_definition: To search or inspect in order to obtain information or find suitable people or places.
senses.ms_definition: Meninjau atau mencari bagi mendapatkan maklumat, calon atau tempat yang sesuai.
senses.nuances: 在马英夹杂交流中可直接使用英语动词；正式马来语按对象选 meninjau、mencari 或 mencari bakat。英语动词义见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/scout)。

etymology.historical_story: English scout traces through Middle English and Anglo-French to a verb meaning to listen, ultimately connected with Latin auscultare. Listening and observation developed into reconnaissance, while the noun also came to name youth movement members. In Malaysia, pengakap names that movement locally. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/scout) and [Pengakap Malaysia](https://scoutmy.org/).

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian sersan comes from Dutch sergeant, reflecting contact with Dutch military terminology. Its deeper ancestry runs through Old French to a Latin word associated with serving. Malaysian Malay uses sarjan, while Kamus Dewan records sersan with an Indonesian label. The two forms show how neighboring languages can adapt related European military vocabulary differently. [Etymological study](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/26597/1/Bernd%20Nothofer_Pengantar%20Etimologi%20lengkap%20pdf.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 在前述事件、行动或时间之后；随后。
senses.en_definition: After that; subsequently, with reference to a previously mentioned event or time.
senses.ms_definition: Sesudah atau setelah selesai perkara yang disebut sebelumnya; selepas itu.
senses.nuances: 以 DBP 对 selepas 的释义为基础，整词释义按 selepas + -nya 组合解释。这里的 -nya 通常回指前文事件或时间，不表示“他的”。selepasnya 比日常口语的 lepas tu 更偏书面；它表示先后关系，本身不保证紧接着发生。[PRPM：selepas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=selepas)。

etymology.historical_story: Dewan lists selepas in the word family of lepas and defines it through temporal succession. In selepasnya, -nya points back to an event or time already mentioned. This makes the expression useful in connected narration: a writer can move the story forward without repeating the preceding event. Its formation remains transparent in modern Malay. [PRPM: selepas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=selepas).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 sə-lə-pas-ɲa 念，抓住最后的 nya：把它想成指向上一件事的小箭头，selepas + 那件事＝那之后。

etymology.historical_story: Separa illustrates how an ordinary expression of incompleteness can support precise technical vocabulary. Its dictionary meaning covers something partial rather than necessarily an exact mathematical half. In combinations concerning machines, consciousness, or skill, the following word identifies what is incomplete. These established combinations offer a reliable learning route without inventing an unsupported origin from the spelling.

senses.zh_definition: 盾牌：持在手中或臂前，用来抵挡武器攻击的防护器具。
senses.en_definition: A defensive object held before the body to block blows or weapons.
senses.ms_definition: Perisai yang dipegang untuk menangkis pukulan atau serangan senjata.
senses.nuances: 英语可数名词。马来语对应 perisai；本条搭配的 ms 提供马来语对应表达，en 保留英语实际搭配。参见 [Cambridge：shield](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/shield)。

senses.zh_definition: 防护罩、防护屏或其他隔绝伤害、热量、辐射等的保护装置。
senses.en_definition: A cover or barrier that protects against a harmful influence.
senses.ms_definition: Pelindung atau pengadang yang menghalang kesan berbahaya seperti haba atau sinaran.
senses.nuances: 按具体功能译为 pelindung、pengadang 或 perisai；不能把各种 shield 都理解成手持盾牌。[Merriam-Webster：shield](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shield)。

senses.zh_definition: 起保护作用的人、事物或安排；抵挡危险、批评或追责的屏障。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing that provides protection or defence.
senses.ms_definition: Orang, benda atau sesuatu yang menjadi pelindung daripada bahaya atau ancaman.
senses.nuances: 比喻义。human shield 通常译为“人盾”，涉及使他人暴露于危险，并非普通的帮助或保护。[Merriam-Webster：shield](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shield)。

senses.zh_definition: 盾形奖牌或奖座，尤其指竞赛中颁发的盾形奖。
senses.en_definition: A shield-shaped trophy awarded in a competition.
senses.ms_definition: Hadiah pertandingan berbentuk perisai.
senses.nuances: 英国及部分英联邦赛事用语；若为轮流争夺的奖项，马来语可用 perisai pusingan。参见 [PRPM：perisai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=perisai)。

senses.zh_definition: 盾形纹章底面或盾形标志，用于承载纹章图案或身份象征。
senses.en_definition: A shield-shaped field or emblem bearing heraldic or identifying designs.
senses.ms_definition: Bidang atau lambang berbentuk perisai yang memaparkan reka bentuk heraldik atau tanda pengenalan.
senses.nuances: 属于纹章及标志语境，不一定具有实际防护功能。[Merriam-Webster：shield](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shield)。

senses.zh_definition: 地盾：大陆古老、稳定的结晶基底大面积出露的区域。
senses.en_definition: An exposed region of ancient crystalline rocks forming part of a continental core.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan batuan hablur purba yang tersingkap dan membentuk sebahagian teras benua.
senses.nuances: 地质学专义，马来语对应 perisai。属于大陆基底概念，不是盾状火山。[Merriam-Webster：shield](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shield)。

senses.zh_definition: 遮护、保护，使某人或某物免受伤害、影响或不利后果。
senses.en_definition: To protect someone or something from harm or an adverse influence.
senses.ms_definition: Melindungi seseorang atau sesuatu daripada bahaya atau kesan buruk.
senses.nuances: 常用 shield someone/something from something；也可用 against。依语境可指身体遮挡或抽象保护。[Cambridge：shield](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/shield)。

collocations.en: shield one's eyes from the sun

senses.zh_definition: 遮挡，使某人或某物不易被看见或观察到。
senses.en_definition: To screen someone or something from view.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalang seseorang atau sesuatu daripada dilihat dengan jelas.
senses.nuances: 重点是阻隔视线；不必涉及危险。马来语可按语境使用 melindungi 或 menghalang pandangan。[Cambridge：shield](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/shield)。

etymology.historical_story: Shield descends through Middle English sheld from Old English scield. Its history reaches back to the physical armour carried for defence, while modern English also uses it for protective devices and people or things offering protection. The same spelling functions as a verb meaning to protect or screen. [Merriam-Webster：shield](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shield)。

etymology.historical_story: English stick preserves two old forms: the noun descends from Old English sticca, while the verb continues stician. Their histories connect rods, piercing and becoming fixed. For a Malay learner, this explains why the same English spelling can describe a wooden object or an action requiring entirely different Malay translations. [Oxford noun history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/stick_2), [Oxford verb history](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/stick_1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用一根 stick 把标签按牢：名词是“棍”，动词是“粘”；stick to a plan 则是“牢牢坚持计划”。这是情景联想，不是马来语构词。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中按不可拆分的外来专名处理，is_root 仅表示不作马来语词缀分析。通常应写作 Smitty。音节和 IPA 按英语人名读法补全；输入未提供语境，尚不能将此项确认为正式马来语普通词。

etymology.historical_story: English dictionaries identify Smitty as a personal name related to Smith, and nickname research discusses the Smith-to-Smitty pairing. senses.en_definition: A shortened form of second, a unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk pendek bahasa Inggeris bagi second, iaitu unit masa yang bersamaan dengan satu per enam puluh minit; dalam bahasa Melayu, saat.

senses.nuances: 常见于 one sec、a sec 等英语片段；标准马来语通常用 sebentar 或 sekejap。不可把 sec 当作 sekejap 的马来语构词缩写。以下搭配保留语码混用形式。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/sec)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 此处仅按英语时间义处理；数学中的 sec、带句点的其他缩写以及大写 SEC 需另依语境辨认。status 按指定格式保留 official，不表示 sec 已获确认为规范马来语词目。

etymology.historical_story: Sec is a shortened English form of second. English dictionaries distinguish the measurable time unit from the conversational meaning of a brief wait. This distinction explains why one sec can request patience without promising an exact duration. In a mixed Malay message, sebentar supplies the natural standard Malay equivalent for that conversational meaning. [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/sec)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: second 截短成 sec，像把等待也压缩成“一小会儿”；标准马来语中，计时用 saat，请人稍等用 sebentar。

senses.ms_definition: Minuman manis hasil bancuhan sirap dengan air.

senses.zh_definition: 木瓦；以薄木板片叠铺而成的屋面材料。

senses.zh_definition: 通常以 menyirap、menyirapkan、tersirap 出现：血液涌动，或因惊吓、愤怒而心悸、气血上涌；使人惊悸或发怒。
senses.en_definition: In derived forms, to surge, especially of blood; to startle or anger.
senses.ms_definition: Pada bentuk terbitan, menggambarkan darah yang menyusup atau rasa berdebar dan marah, termasuk menyebabkan perasaan tersebut.

etymology.historical_story: The beverage sense belongs to the international syrup word family, whose history ultimately reaches Arabic sharāb, meaning a drink. English syrup travelled through European forms including French sirop. This wider history does not establish the immediate donor language for Malay sirap, and it should not be extended automatically to the unrelated roofing and emotional homonyms. [Etymological background](https://www.etymonline.com/word/syrup).

etymology.historical_story: English six continues an Old English numeral recorded as siex. Its appearance in a multilingual Malaysian text does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing: it may simply be English material within that text. Malay has its own standard equivalent, enam, which DBP uses when translating this English headword. [Old English evidence](https://lrc.la.utexas.edu/eieol_base_form_dictionary/engol/14); [DBP translation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=enam).

etymology.historical_story: Malay spelling reform changed the older prefix spelling sa- to se- and removed its separating hyphen: sa-orang became seorang. This provides historical context for mixed spellings involving sa and se. The supplied sesaorang can be interpreted against that background, but its occurrence does not establish it as an approved historical spelling. Its modern standard equivalent is seseorang. [Spelling reform reference](https://repository.nie.edu.sg/server/api/core/bitstreams/26e4f656-c9e4-4e25-b4de-1432c479f037/content)

senses.nuances: 这里表示可计算的二分之一，例如二十份中的十份。马来语语法上属于带回指成分的数量表达；受给定词性枚举限制，以 noun 表示其名词短语功能。马来语释义为组合释义，依据 DBP 对 setengah 的“半数”义整理。[DBP：setengah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=setengah)

senses.zh_definition: 其中一些；所提到的人或事物中的一部分，不一定恰好占一半。

senses.nuances: 这是指代性数量表达，通常需要前文给出群体。不能仅凭这个词判断比例为百分之五十。文学文本中可见此用法；正式统计宜用 sebahagiannya 或明确数量，避免与“一半”混淆。[DBP 出版文本中的 setengahnya](https://pdigital.dbp.gov.my/storage/uploads/Seorang%20Tua%20di%20Kaki%20Gunung.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Setengahnya brings together two established Malay resources: setengah for a half or a portion, and -nya for reference to something already understood. Its numerical and indefinite readings explain why context matters so much. In a calculation it can mean exactly half; in a narrative it can identify only some members of a group. No specific coinage date is established here.

etymology.historical_story: The name Siberia is associated with Sibir, the name of a historical town and khanate in western Siberia. As Russian expansion proceeded eastward, the geographical name acquired a much wider reach. The deeper origin of Sibir remains disputed, with several linguistic proposals; no single picturesque translation should be treated as established fact. [Name history](https://journals.umcs.pl/public/journals/9/etnol_28a.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Sheldon belongs to the English tradition of surnames taken from places. Several English settlements bear this name, so its history does not reduce to one universal literal meaning. Different place-name analyses involve Old English words for a ledge, hill or valley. Its use as a given name continues the surname tradition. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=sheldon), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sheldon)

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this expression around layak, meaning suitable or qualified. The same base connects personal qualifications, kelayakan, with the judgment that someone deserves recognition. Selayaknya therefore packages a small social argument into one word: the person's position, conduct, or contribution makes a particular response appropriate. This describes its transparent Malay formation rather than asserting an unverified ancient borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 layak“够资格”：selayaknya 就是“够资格，所以理应得到”。

etymology.historical_story: Sharpe is a surname, and one well-documented route into technical vocabulary is through William F. Sharpe. In 1966 he introduced a mutual-fund performance measure under a different name; later writers called it the Sharpe ratio. This illustrates how a personal name can enter Malay technical discussion without becoming an ordinary Malay adjective. [Sharpe's account](https://web.stanford.edu/~wfsharpe/art/sr/sr.htm).

etymology.historical_story: Batu has both the concrete meaning stone and a separate dictionary sense naming a mile. Sebatu selects the measurement sense and adds se-, meaning one. The contrast is memorable: a stone is counted with an appropriate classifier, while a mile is measured directly. The shared spelling does not make every batu expression a reference to a physical stone.

etymology.historical_story: Simpankan is transparently formed from simpan and the suffix -kan. Its everyday usefulness lies in keeping something for somebody else: money for a child, food for a late arrival, or a document for a colleague. The dictionary also records entrusting something to another keeper, connecting preservation with delegated responsibility. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=simpan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 simpan＝存好；再加 -kan，想成“帮人存好”。听到 simpankan，脑中出现一份特意替别人留下的饭菜。

senses.nuances: 马来西亚体育报道与球迷交流中的英语借词，带赞赏意味；并非所有 pemain gantian 都是 supersub，也不要求该球员一定进球。此处马来语释义为综合释义，不冒称 DBP 原文。音标采用英语来源读音，实际借词发音有差异；资料包未提供的音节与爪夷文保留 null。用例与解释见：[Majoriti 体育报道](https://majoriti.com.my/sukan/2023/03/29/selain-malik-mat-arif-ini-3-lagi-bintang-layak-digelar-039supersub039-2023)。

etymology.historical_story: The English football expression combines super with sub, a shortening of substitute. Malaysian football reporting borrows it to celebrate players who make a major contribution after entering from the bench. A report about Syahmi Safari records the label alongside his goals as a substitute, showing how the borrowed expression operates within otherwise Malay sports journalism. Example: [Flash Sukan interview report](https://www.flashsukan.com.my/syahmi-tak-anggap-dirinya-supersub-sedia-sarung-jersi-harimau-malaya/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: super「超强」＋sub「替补」：坐在替补席，上场却能改写比赛，就是 supersub。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆成 sa- + ke。按输入中的 DBP 注音 sa.ké，末尾 e 读 /e/，不是 /ə/；它也不同于英语表示目的或缘故的 sake /seɪk/。

senses.zh_definition: 日本清酒；一种以米为主要原料酿成的含酒精饮料。
senses.en_definition: Sake: a Japanese alcoholic beverage brewed from rice.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis arak yang diperbuat daripada beras.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义展开自输入所附《Kamus Dewan》第四版定义。马来语中的该词指日本米酿酒；不承接英语 for the sake of 的意义。日本语境下 sake 可泛指酒类，具体的日本清酒也称 nihonshu。[日本国立国会图书馆相关介绍](https://jpsearch.go.jp/en/gallery/ndl-xVaJxvR9PWCrR9)

etymology.historical_story: Malay sake comes from Japanese sake. In Japanese, the word can refer broadly to alcoholic drinks, while nihonshu identifies the rice-based drink commonly called sake abroad. Brewing combines rice, koji and yeast: starch becomes sugar, then alcohol. The Malay dictionary meaning narrows this cultural borrowing to a Japanese alcoholic drink made from rice. [Japanese reference](https://jpsearch.go.jp/en/gallery/ndl-xVaJxvR9PWCrR9)
